=================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArraySet;

/**
 * Registry for background conversions: enqueue, cancel, observe, and recover.
 *
 * <p>Invariants the rest of the app relies on:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>Raw files under conversion are <b>never written to</b> — only read.
 *       Punch-in edits copy bytes out, so an edit can never invalidate an
 *       in-flight conversion. The only invalidations are delete and
 *       replace, which cancel the job first.</li>
 *   <li>One active job per raw file. Enqueueing for the same raw returns the
 *       existing job instead of doubling the work.</li>
 *   <li>Every state change is persisted to the job sidecar <em>and</em>
 *       fanned out to {@link Listener}s, so the library, notifications and
 *       share warnings stay in sync whether the app is open or not.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public final class ConversionJobs {

    public interface Listener {
        void onJobsChanged();
    }

    public static final class SaveResult {
        /** True when the file is ready now (incremental output adopted). */
        public final boolean adopted;
        public final File file;
        public final String label;
        public final long durationMs;
        public final String title;
        /** Non-null when the save went to the background worker. */
        public final ConversionJob job;

        private SaveResult(boolean adopted, File file, String label,
                           long durationMs, String title, ConversionJob job) {
            this.adopted = adopted;
            this.file = file;
            this.label = label;
            this.durationMs = durationMs;
            this.title = title;
            this.job = job;
        }

        static SaveResult adopted(File file, String label, long durationMs,
                                  String title) {
            return new SaveResult(true, file, label, durationMs, title, null);
        }

        static SaveResult background(ConversionJob job) {
            return new SaveResult(false, null, null, job.durationMs,
                    job.title, job);
        }
    }

    private ConversionJobs() {}

    /**
     * How long a save may spend finishing the incremental encoder inline
     * before giving up and converting in the background. Kept small on
     * purpose: a budget overrun is paid as visible latency on the UI thread,
     * and a backlog that cannot drain inside it is handed to the worker
     * anyway.
     */
    private static final long ADOPT_DRAIN_BUDGET_MS = 350L;

    /**
     * Largest unencoded backlog still worth draining inline (~1.5s of audio),
     * which encodes in well under the budget above.
     */
    private static final long MAX_INLINE_TAIL_FRAMES =
            RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE * 3L / 2L;

    private static final Map<String, ConversionJob> ACTIVE = new HashMap<>();
    private static final Set<Listener> LISTENERS = new CopyOnWriteArraySet<>();
    /** rawPath -> finished library take id, for replace-after-completion. */
    private static final Map<String, Long> COMPLETED = new HashMap<>();
    /**
     * raws with an in-flight reader. The worker defers its raw.delete() while
     * one is open, so an Edit on a converting card cannot have the file
     * pulled out from under AudioImporter mid-decode.
     */
    private static final Map<String, Integer> RAW_READERS =
            new HashMap<>();
    /** Synthetic (negative) take id -> raw path, for edit-replace lookup. */
    private static final Map<Long, String> NEG_TO_RAW = new HashMap<>();
    /**
     * rawPath -> latest user-chosen title from a rename requested while its
     * take was converting. Kept separately from {@link ConversionJob#title}
     * so a rename that arrives after the worker read the title but before the
     * finished take is visible can still be applied exactly once.
     */
    private static final Map<String, String> RENAMED_TITLES = new HashMap<>();

    public static synchronized void addListener(Listener l) {
        if (l != null) LISTENERS.add(l);
    }

    public static synchronized void removeListener(Listener l) {
        LISTENERS.remove(l);
    }

    private static void fireChanged() {
        for (Listener l : LISTENERS) {
            try {
                l.onJobsChanged();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public static synchronized List<ConversionJob> active() {
        return new ArrayList<>(ACTIVE.values());
    }

    public static synchronized ConversionJob get(String jobId) {
        return ACTIVE.get(jobId);
    }

    public static synchronized ConversionJob forRaw(String rawPath) {
        for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
            if (j.rawPath.equals(rawPath)) return j;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static synchronized ConversionJob forTakeId(long takeId) {
        for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
            if (j.takeId() == takeId) return j;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static synchronized void noteCompletion(String rawPath, long takeId) {
        COMPLETED.put(rawPath, takeId);
    }

    public static synchronized Long completedTakeIdForRaw(String rawPath) {
        return COMPLETED.get(rawPath);
    }

    /**
     * Atomically records a rename for a take that was (or still is)
     * converting. Updates the active job and sidecar when the job is still in
     * flight, remembers the override by raw path so the worker handoff cannot
     * miss it, and renames the finished take when the job already completed
     * while the rename dialog was open.
     *
     * <p>The repository rename happens after this class's lock is released:
     * the worker can hold the repository lock while calling back into this
     * registry, so nesting those two locks in the other order could deadlock.
     */
    public static String renameConvertingOrCompleted(String jobId,
                                                     long syntheticTakeId,
                                                     String rawPath,
                                                     String newTitle) {
        String clean = newTitle != null ? newTitle.trim() : "";
        if (clean.isEmpty()) return "";
        final String effectiveRaw;
        final Long doneId;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            ConversionJob job = null;
            if (jobId != null && !jobId.isEmpty()) {
                job = ACTIVE.get(jobId);
            }
            if (job == null && syntheticTakeId < 0) {
                for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
                    if (j.takeId() == syntheticTakeId) {
                        job = j;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (job == null && rawPath != null && !rawPath.isEmpty()) {
                for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
                    if (rawPath.equals(j.rawPath)) {
                        job = j;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            String eff = rawPath;
            if ((eff == null || eff.isEmpty()) && job != null) {
                eff = job.rawPath;
            }
            if ((eff == null || eff.isEmpty()) && syntheticTakeId < 0) {
                eff = NEG_TO_RAW.get(syntheticTakeId);
            }
            if (eff != null && !eff.isEmpty()) {
                RENAMED_TITLES.put(eff, clean);
            }
            if (job != null) {
                job.title = clean;
                if (job.replaceTitle != null) {
                    job.replaceTitle = clean;
                }
                job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
                job.write();
            }
            effectiveRaw = eff;
            doneId = (eff != null && !eff.isEmpty())
                    ? COMPLETED.get(eff) : null;
        }
        if (doneId != null) {
            TakesRepository.rename(doneId, clean);
        }
        fireChanged();
        return clean;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the most up-to-date title for {@code job}, honouring any rename
     * that arrived while the job was queued or running.
     */
    public static synchronized String latestTitle(ConversionJob job,
                                                  String fallback) {
        String cleanFallback = fallback != null ? fallback : "";
        if (job == null) return cleanFallback;
        String byRaw = RENAMED_TITLES.get(job.rawPath);
        if (byRaw != null && !byRaw.trim().isEmpty()) {
            job.title = byRaw.trim();
            return job.title;
        }
        if (job.title != null && !job.title.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return job.title.trim();
        }
        return cleanFallback;
    }

    /**
     * Takes and clears a pending rename override recorded by
     * {@link #renameConvertingOrCompleted}. The worker calls this after the
     * finished take is visible, then applies the result without holding this
     * class's lock.
     */
    public static synchronized String consumeRenamedTitle(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null || rawPath.isEmpty()) return null;
        String renamed = RENAMED_TITLES.remove(rawPath);
        if (renamed == null || renamed.trim().isEmpty()) return null;
        return renamed.trim();
    }

    /**
     * Reads a pending rename override without clearing it, so the worker can
     * decide which title a completion should carry while still honouring the
     * initial edit-replace title when no rename arrived.
     */
    public static synchronized String peekRenamedTitle(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null || rawPath.isEmpty()) return null;
        String renamed = RENAMED_TITLES.get(rawPath);
        if (renamed == null || renamed.trim().isEmpty()) return null;
        return renamed.trim();
    }

    public static synchronized void noteTakeRaw(long takeId, String rawPath) {
        NEG_TO_RAW.put(takeId, rawPath);
    }

    public static synchronized String rawForTakeId(long takeId) {
        return NEG_TO_RAW.get(takeId);
    }

    public static synchronized void forgetCompletion(String rawPath) {
        COMPLETED.remove(rawPath);
        RENAMED_TITLES.remove(rawPath);
    }

    /** Marks {@code rawPath} as being read. Pair every call with {@link #endRawRead}. */
    public static void beginRawRead(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null) return;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            Integer n = RAW_READERS.get(rawPath);
            RAW_READERS.put(rawPath, n == null ? 1 : n + 1);
        }
    }

    public static void endRawRead(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null) return;
        boolean lastReader;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            Integer n = RAW_READERS.get(rawPath);
            if (n == null) return;
            if (n <= 1) {
                RAW_READERS.remove(rawPath);
                lastReader = true;
            } else {
                RAW_READERS.put(rawPath, n - 1);
                lastReader = false;
            }
            if (lastReader && DEFERRED_RAW_DELETES.remove(rawPath)
                    && forRaw(rawPath) == null) {
                // The worker finished while this reader held the file and
                // deferred its deletion: no job owns the raw anymore, so
                // remove it now instead of leaking it into reconcile().
                try {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    new File(rawPath).delete();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
    }

    /** Raws whose deletion was deferred until their last reader finishes. */
    private static final java.util.Set<String> DEFERRED_RAW_DELETES =
            new java.util.HashSet<>();

    /** True while some thread is decoding this raw. */
    public static synchronized boolean rawIsBeingRead(String rawPath) {
        return RAW_READERS.containsKey(rawPath);
    }

    /**
     * Deletes a finished conversion's raw immediately, unless a reader
     * (preview playback or edit import) still holds it open — then the
     * deletion is deferred to {@link #endRawRead} so the file can neither be
     * pulled out from under the reader nor leaked into reconcile().
     */
    public static void deleteOrDeferRaw(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null) return;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            if (RAW_READERS.containsKey(rawPath)) {
                DEFERRED_RAW_DELETES.add(rawPath);
                return;
            }
        }
        try {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(rawPath).delete();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * Enqueues a background conversion for a finalized raw take. Returns the
     * existing job when one is already active for the same raw.
     */
    public static synchronized ConversionJob enqueue(Context ctx, File raw,
                                                     String title,
                                                     RecordPreset preset,
                                                     SaveFormat format,
                                                     long durationMs) {
        return enqueue(ctx, raw, title, preset, format, durationMs, -1, null);
    }

    /**
     * Same, carrying edit-replace lineage: when the job completes, the take
     * with {@code replaceTakeId} is replaced (under {@code replaceTitle})
     * instead of adding a duplicate.
     */
    public static synchronized ConversionJob enqueue(Context ctx, File raw,
                                                     String title,
                                                     RecordPreset preset,
                                                     SaveFormat format,
                                                     long durationMs,
                                                     long replaceTakeId,
                                                     String replaceTitle) {
        ConversionJob existing = forRaw(raw.getAbsolutePath());
        if (existing != null) return existing;
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        // AUDIT-3-02 fix: read the geometry from the `raw` file itself.
        // The engine may be idle/cleared (dataBytes 0, channels back to its
        // 2 default) at enqueue time, which recorded framesTotal = 1 and the
        // wrong channel count for a mono take.
        int ch = Math.max(1, e.channels);
        long bytes = e.dataBytes;
        try {
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
            ch = Math.max(1, info.channels);
            bytes = info.dataBytes;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        long framesTotal = Math.max(1, bytes / 4 / ch);
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob(
                UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                title != null ? title : "",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(),
                ConversionJob.partFor(raw).getAbsolutePath(),
                preset != null ? preset.id : RecordPreset.MEMO.id,
                format != null ? format.id : SaveFormat.AUTO.id,
                ch,
                preset != null ? preset.aacBitrate : 128000,
                Math.max(durationMs, 1000),
                framesTotal);
        job.replaceTakeId = replaceTakeId;
        job.replaceTitle = replaceTitle;
        ACTIVE.put(job.jobId, job);
        job.write();
        fireChanged();
        return job;
    }

    /**
     * Cancels a job: stops the worker, deletes partial output and — when
     * {@code deleteRaw} — the raw take itself. The sidecar always goes.
     * When the raw is kept it gets its pending marker back, so the next
     * launch offers the usual continue/discard recovery instead of leaking
     * an invisible file.
     */
    public static synchronized boolean cancel(String jobId, boolean deleteRaw) {
        ConversionJob job = ACTIVE.get(jobId);
        if (job == null) return false;
        job.cancelled = true;
        job.state = ConversionJob.CANCELLED;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        job.write();
        ACTIVE.remove(jobId);
        try {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(job.partPath).delete();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        job.deleteSidecar();
        if (deleteRaw) {
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                new File(job.rawPath).delete();
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                new File(job.rawPath + ".pending").delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            forgetCompletion(job.rawPath);
        } else {
            try {
                File raw = new File(job.rawPath);
                if (raw.exists()) {
                    RecordingEngine.writePendingMarker(raw, job.title,
                            job.channels);
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        fireChanged();
        return true;
    }

    /** Cancels by library card id (negative synthetic ids map to jobs). */
    public static synchronized boolean cancelByTakeId(long takeId,
                                                      boolean deleteRaw) {
        ConversionJob job = forTakeId(takeId);
        return job != null && cancel(job.jobId, deleteRaw);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves or cancels the source of an Edit -> Replace save BEFORE the
     * edited take is converted or adopted.
     *
     * <ul>
     *   <li>If {@code replaceTakeId < 0} and the original conversion job is
     *       still queued or running, cancels it immediately (marking it
     *       {@code superseded} and deleting its raw + part + sidecar) so the
     *       worker never wastes time finishing the obsolete original file,
     *       and returns {@code -1} because no finished library row exists to
     *       replace.</li>
     *   <li>If {@code replaceTakeId < 0} and the original conversion job
     *       already finished while the user was editing, returns the positive
     *       {@code Take.id} of that finished take so the replacement deletes
     *       it.</li>
     * </ul>
     */
    public static long cancelForReplace(Context ctx, long replaceTakeId) {
        if (replaceTakeId >= 0) return replaceTakeId;
        String jobIdToCancel = null;
        Long finishedId;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            ConversionJob srcJob = forTakeId(replaceTakeId);
            String srcRaw = srcJob != null ? srcJob.rawPath
                    : NEG_TO_RAW.get(replaceTakeId);
            if (srcJob != null) {
                srcJob.superseded = true;
                srcJob.cancelled = true;
                jobIdToCancel = srcJob.jobId;
                cancel(srcJob.jobId, true);
            }
            finishedId = (srcRaw != null) ? COMPLETED.get(srcRaw) : null;
        }
        if (jobIdToCancel != null && ctx != null) {
            ConversionService.cancelJob(ctx, jobIdToCancel);
            ConversionService.onRecordingStateChanged();
        }
        return finishedId != null ? finishedId : -1L;
    }

    static synchronized void updateProgress(ConversionJob job, int pct,
                                            long framesDone) {
        job.progress = pct;
        job.framesDone = framesDone;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if ((pct % 5) == 0 || pct >= 100) job.write();
        fireChanged();
    }

    static synchronized void markRunning(ConversionJob job) {
        job.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        job.write();
        if (!ACTIVE.containsKey(job.jobId)) ACTIVE.put(job.jobId, job);
        fireChanged();
    }

    static synchronized void markDone(ConversionJob job) {
        job.state = ConversionJob.DONE;
        job.progress = 100;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        ACTIVE.remove(job.jobId);
        job.deleteSidecar();
        fireChanged();
    }

    static synchronized void markFailed(ConversionJob job, String error) {
        job.state = ConversionJob.FAILED;
        job.error = error;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        ACTIVE.remove(job.jobId);
        job.deleteSidecar();
        fireChanged();
    }

    /**
     * Startup sweep: resurrect interrupted jobs, drop garbage. Returns the
     * jobs the worker should run. Stale sidecars (orphaned > 7 days) and
     * partial outputs without a sidecar are deleted.
     */
    public static synchronized List<ConversionJob> sweep(Context ctx) {
        List<ConversionJob> resume = new ArrayList<>();
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        File[] files;
        try {
            files = dir.listFiles();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            files = null;
        }
        if (files == null) return resume;
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        Set<String> liveParts = new HashSet<>();
        // A live capture owns a .part with no sidecar yet. Sweep used to
        // assume it only ran at cold start, but the service sweeps on every
        // start command, so this file was deleted out from under the running
        // StreamingEncoder mid-recording.
        File activeRaw = RecordingEngine.get().rawFile;
        if (activeRaw != null) {
            liveParts.add(ConversionJob.partFor(activeRaw).getAbsolutePath());
        }
        // Same protection for a session that is being written but not yet
        // finalized (a .pending marker sits beside it).
        for (File f : files) {
            if (f.isFile() && f.getName().endsWith(".pending")) {
                String rawName = f.getName().substring(0,
                        f.getName().length() - ".pending".length());
                liveParts.add(new File(dir, rawName + ".part")
                        .getAbsolutePath());
            }
        }
        for (File f : files) {
            if (!f.isFile() || !f.getName().endsWith(".conv.json")) continue;
            ConversionJob job = ConversionJob.read(f);
            if (job == null) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
                continue;
            }
            liveParts.add(job.partPath);
            // Already tracked in memory (RUNNING or QUEUED): keep the live
            // instance. Replacing it reset progress to 0 and let the queue run
            // the same jobId twice, the second run reporting a false failure
            // because the raw was already gone.
            ConversionJob inMem = ACTIVE.get(job.jobId);
            if (inMem != null) {
                resume.add(inMem);
                continue;
            }
            boolean stale = now - job.updatedAt > 7L * 24 * 3600_000L;
            File raw = new File(job.rawPath);
            if (stale || !raw.exists()
                    || ConversionJob.DONE.equals(job.state)
                    || ConversionJob.FAILED.equals(job.state)
                    || ConversionJob.CANCELLED.equals(job.state)) {
                try {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    new File(job.partPath).delete();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
                continue;
            }
            job.state = ConversionJob.QUEUED;
            job.cancelled = false;
            job.write();
            ACTIVE.put(job.jobId, job);
            resume.add(job);
        }
        // Partial outputs with no sidecar are crash garbage — except the one
        // a live capture may be writing right now (protected above).
        for (File f : files) {
            if (!f.isFile() || !f.getName().endsWith(".part")) continue;
            if (!liveParts.contains(f.getAbsolutePath())) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
            }
        }
        if (!resume.isEmpty()) fireChanged();
        return resume;
    }

    /**
     * The unified save dispatch: finalize the raw, then either adopt the
     * incremental output (fast path) or enqueue a background job. Never
     * blocks on conversion work beyond draining the incremental tail.
     */
    public static SaveResult dispatchSave(Context ctx, RecordPreset preset,
                                          SaveFormat format,
                                          StreamingEncoder.Progress cb) {
        return dispatchSave(ctx, preset, format, cb, -1, null);
    }

    /**
     * Same, carrying edit-replace lineage into the background job when the
     * fast path misses.
     */
    public static SaveResult dispatchSave(Context ctx, RecordPreset preset,
                                          SaveFormat format,
                                          StreamingEncoder.Progress cb,
                                          long replaceTakeId,
                                          String replaceTitle) {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        File raw = e.finalizeRaw();
        if (raw == null || !raw.exists()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("empty");
        }
        // If replacing a take that is still converting (replaceTakeId < 0),
        // cancel the original conversion job immediately so we never convert
        // the original file first and then convert the edited file second.
        if (replaceTakeId < 0) {
            replaceTakeId = cancelForReplace(ctx, replaceTakeId);
        }
        String title = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "";
        long dur = Math.max(e.durationMs(), 1000);
        StreamingEncoder sess = e.endStreamingDetach();
        SaveFormat eff = format.effective(preset);
        if (eff == SaveFormat.AUTO) eff = SaveFormat.M4A;
        // An enabled-but-unbaked FX chain invalidates the incremental output:
        // the pump encoded raw microphone frames, so its .part would ship
        // without a single effect. Drop it and let the worker convert the
        // FX-baked raw instead of silently losing the whole chain.
        if (e.isFxBakeRequired()) {
            if (sess != null) {
                try {
                    sess.abort();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                sess = null;
            }
            // Bake the active FX chain into `raw` here so saves triggered from
            // the notification shade (RecordingService calls dispatchSave
            // directly) or any other path that skipped StudioFragment's
            // doSaveSequence() bake still include the user's unbaked chain
            // instead of converting dry audio.
            try {
                if (ctx != null) {
                    DspChain.Config cfg = DspChain.Config.load(ctx);
                    if (cfg != null && cfg.isActive()) {
                        FormatConverter.WavInfo info =
                                FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
                        long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4
                                / Math.max(1, info.channels);
                        if (totalFrames > 0) {
                            DspChain chain = new DspChain(info.channels, cfg);
                            EditEngine.applyDspToRange(raw, 0, totalFrames,
                                    chain, null);
                            e.dataBytes = RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "dispatchSave fx bake failed: " + ex);
            }
            e.setFxBakeRequired(false);
        }
        // framesEncoded() > 0 is NOT evidence that the pump kept up: a
        // format switch restarts the encoder from the top of the raw file, so
        // it reports progress after its first chunk while nearly the whole
        // take is still unencoded. Only drain inline when the real backlog is
        // tiny; otherwise skip straight to the worker with no stall at all.
        boolean canAdoptInline = sess != null && sess.healthy()
                && sess.matches(preset, format)
                && sess.framesEncoded() > 0
                && sess.unencodedFrames() <= MAX_INLINE_TAIL_FRAMES;
        if (canAdoptInline) {
            try {
                if (!sess.finish(ADOPT_DRAIN_BUDGET_MS)) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("drain budget exceeded");
                }
                if (sess.finishedOk()) {
                    File part = sess.partFile();
                    // Same guard as the background path: a pass-through FLAC
                    // encoder hands back a near-full-size file under a
                    // lossless label. Fall through to the worker, which
                    // re-encodes as WAV24.
                    if (eff == SaveFormat.FLAC
                            && TakeSaver.flacLooksIneffective(part.length(),
                            raw.length())) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "flac ineffective; fallback to worker");
                    }
                    FormatConverter.validateFinal(part, eff);
                    File fin = TakeSaver.uniqueFinal(raw,
                            eff.extension());
                    if (!part.renameTo(fin)) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("adopt failed");
                    }
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    raw.delete();
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").delete();
                    return SaveResult.adopted(fin,
                            TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, format), dur, title);
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "stream adopt failed: " + ex);
            }
            // abort(), never a bare unlink: a timed-out finish() leaves the
            // pump running, and only abort() stops it. Enqueuing a job onto
            // the same part path while that thread still writes it corrupts
            // the container.
            sess.abort();
        } else if (sess != null) {
            sess.abort();
        }
        ConversionJob job = enqueue(ctx, raw, title, preset, format, dur,
                replaceTakeId, replaceTitle);
        if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(0);
        return SaveResult.background(job);
    }
}


=================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/ConversionService.java
=================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.concurrent.CancellationException;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedDeque;

/**
 * Foreground host for background conversions. Keeps converting after the
 * user leaves the studio — or the app entirely — with one persistent
 * progress notification per service (latest job shown), a completion notice,
 * and a broadcast the library listens for.
 *
 * <p>Jobs run serially on a single worker thread: encoders contend badly,
 * and serial order makes progress reporting and cancellation exact. A kill
 * mid-job loses only the in-memory encoder state — the raw, the sidecar and
 * any WAV partial survive, and {@link ConversionJobs#sweep} requeues on the
 * next launch (or via {@code START_REDELIVER_INTENT}).
 */
public class ConversionService extends Service {

    public static final String ACTION_CONVERT =
            "com.example.hello.CONV_RUN";
    public static final String ACTION_CANCEL_JOB =
            "com.example.hello.CONV_CANCEL";

    public static final String EXTRA_JOB_ID = "job_id";

    /** Broadcast when a background conversion finishes (ok or not). */
    public static final String BROADCAST_CONVERSION_DONE =
            "com.example.hello.CONV_DONE";
    public static final String EXTRA_OK = "ok";
    public static final String EXTRA_TITLE = "title";
    public static final String EXTRA_LABEL = "label";
    public static final String EXTRA_MESSAGE = "message";

    private static final String CHANNEL = "takeone_converting";
    private static final int NOTIF_ID = 42;
    private static final int DONE_NOTIF_ID = 43;

    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private final Deque<String> queue = new ConcurrentLinkedDeque<>();
    private Thread worker;
    private volatile boolean workerAlive;
    /**
     * Set when the platform enforces the foreground-service time budget
     * (onTimeout). The worker parks instead of cancelling so every job
     * survives for the next launch. Reset whenever a worker starts.
     */
    private volatile boolean serviceTimedOut;

    /** Thrown from the progress callback to park the job on timeout. */
    private static final class PausedForTimeoutException extends RuntimeException {
        PausedForTimeoutException() {
            super("service time budget expired");
        }
    }
    private volatile ConversionJob current;
    /** Set when a startForegroundService() start still owes a foreground. */
    private volatile boolean pendingFg;

    public static void startJob(Context ctx, String jobId) {
        Intent i = new Intent(ctx, ConversionService.class);
        i.setAction(ACTION_CONVERT);
        i.putExtra(EXTRA_JOB_ID, jobId);
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                ctx.startForegroundService(i);
            } else {
                ctx.startService(i);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            try {
                ctx.startService(i);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public static void cancelJob(Context ctx, String jobId) {
        ConversionJob job = ConversionJobs.get(jobId);
        if (job != null) job.cancelled = true;
        Intent i = new Intent(ctx, ConversionService.class);
        i.setAction(ACTION_CANCEL_JOB);
        i.putExtra(EXTRA_JOB_ID, jobId);
        try {
            ctx.startService(i);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    @Override
    public void onCreate() {
        CrashLog.install(this);
        super.onCreate();
        ensureChannel();
        // Death-resume: rebuild the queue from sidecars before doing any
        // work, so a redelivered intent can never strand a job.
        for (ConversionJob job : ConversionJobs.sweep(this)) {
            enqueueIfNeeded(job.jobId);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) {
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Adds a job to the queue at most once, and never re-adds the job that is
     * currently executing. {@code queue.contains()} alone was not enough: the
     * running job had already been polled off the queue, so a sweep could
     * insert it again and run it a second time.
     */
    private void enqueueIfNeeded(String id) {
        if (id == null) return;
        synchronized (this) {
            if (current != null && id.equals(current.jobId)) return;
            if (queue.contains(id)) return;
            if (ConversionJobs.get(id) == null) return;
            queue.addLast(id);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        if (intent == null) {
            pump();
            return START_REDELIVER_INTENT;
        }
        String a = intent.getAction();
        if (ACTION_CANCEL_JOB.equals(a)) {
            String id = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_JOB_ID);
            if (id != null) {
                ConversionJob job = ConversionJobs.get(id);
                if (job != null) job.cancelled = true;
                queue.remove(id);
                if (current != null && id.equals(current.jobId)) {
                    current.cancelled = true;
                } else {
                    // Queued but never started: drop it now.
                    ConversionJobs.cancel(id, false);
                }
            }
            if (queue.isEmpty() && current == null) {
                stopSelf();
            } else {
                refreshNotif();
            }
            return START_REDELIVER_INTENT;
        }
        // Started via startForegroundService(): the platform is now watching
        // for startForeground() before pump() decides what to do.
        pendingFg = true;
        // ACTION_CONVERT (or anything else): make sure the id is queued,
        // then pump. Sweep only when nothing is in flight: sweeping mid-run
        // used to re-queue the job that was already executing (its id had
        // been polled off the queue) and reset its state.
        if (queue.isEmpty() && current == null) {
            for (ConversionJob job : ConversionJobs.sweep(this)) {
                enqueueIfNeeded(job.jobId);
            }
        }
        if (intent.hasExtra(EXTRA_JOB_ID)) {
            enqueueIfNeeded(intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_JOB_ID));
        }
        pump();
        return START_REDELIVER_INTENT;
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        workerAlive = false;
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    // ---- worker ----

    private synchronized void pump() {
        // A4-04: when this service was launched with startForegroundService()
        // the framework requires startForeground() within ~5s or it throws
        // ForegroundServiceDidNotStartInTimeException. Answer every start,
        // including one that finds a worker already running or an empty
        // queue (both used to return/stop without ever foregrounding).
        if (pendingFg) {
            pendingFg = false;
            startFg(resolveCurrent());
        }
        if (workerAlive) return;
        if (queue.isEmpty()) {
            stopSelf();
            return;
        }
        workerAlive = true;
        serviceTimedOut = false;
        startFg(resolveCurrent());
        worker = new Thread(this::workLoop, "takeone-conv");
        worker.start();
    }

    /** Android 15 dataSync budget expiry: stop cleanly instead of being killed. */
    @Override
    public void onTimeout(int startId, int fgsType) {
        // Pause, don't destroy: cancelling the job here would delete its
        // sidecar and .part, and clearing the queue would strand the other
        // QUEUED jobs with no worker. Flag the timeout and wake any parked
        // worker; the progress callback parks the current job as QUEUED so
        // the next launch resumes everything intact.
        serviceTimedOut = true;
        synchronized (REC_PAUSE_LOCK) {
            REC_PAUSE_LOCK.notifyAll();
        }
        try {
            stopForeground(true);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        stopSelf();
        super.onTimeout(startId, fgsType);
    }

    private static final Object REC_PAUSE_LOCK = new Object();

    /**
     * Wakes a worker parked by {@link #awaitRecordingIdle}. Called by
     * {@link RecordingEngine} whenever capture state changes.
     */
    public static void onRecordingStateChanged() {
        synchronized (REC_PAUSE_LOCK) {
            REC_PAUSE_LOCK.notifyAll();
        }
    }

    /**
     * True while the mic is actually capturing. Background encoding then
     * yields so a live take never shares CPU, disk and MediaCodec with a
     * conversion already in flight.
     */
    private static boolean recordingInProgress() {
        try {
            return RecordingEngine.get().state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * True while this job must not make progress: while the mic is capturing,
     * or while the take is open for editing (an edit session holds its raw
     * open, so finishing the original conversion now would only waste the
     * work when the user taps Replace).
     */
    private boolean shouldPauseWorker(ConversionJob job) {
        if (recordingInProgress()) return true;
        if (job == null) return false;
        if (ConversionJobs.rawIsBeingRead(job.rawPath)) return true;
        try {
            if (RecordingEngine.get().hasSession()
                    && EditLink.id(getApplicationContext()) == job.takeId()) {
                return true;
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Parks the worker (polling, so a missed notify cannot wedge it) while
     * the user is recording.
     */
    private void awaitRecordingIdle(ConversionJob job) {
        if (!shouldPauseWorker(job)) return;
        handler.post(this::refreshNotif);
        synchronized (REC_PAUSE_LOCK) {
            while (workerAlive && !serviceTimedOut && shouldPauseWorker(job)
                    && (job == null || !job.cancelled)) {
                try {
                    REC_PAUSE_LOCK.wait(250L);
                } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        handler.post(this::refreshNotif);
    }

    private ConversionJob resolveCurrent() {
        ConversionJob job = current;
        if (job == null) {
            String id = queue.peekFirst();
            if (id != null) job = ConversionJobs.get(id);
        }
        return job;
    }

    private void workLoop() {
        try {
            while (true) {
                awaitRecordingIdle(null);
                String id;
                synchronized (this) {
                    id = queue.pollFirst();
                }
                if (id == null) break;
                ConversionJob job = ConversionJobs.get(id);
                if (job == null || job.cancelled) {
                    if (job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(id, false);
                    continue;
                }
                current = job;
                runJob(job);
                current = null;
                if (serviceTimedOut) break;
            }
        } finally {
            synchronized (this) {
                workerAlive = false;
                if (queue.isEmpty()) {
                    handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);
                    try {
                        stopForeground(true);
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    try {
                        NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager)
                                getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
                        if (nm != null) nm.cancel(NOTIF_ID);
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    stopSelf();
                } else {
                    pump();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void runJob(ConversionJob job) {
        Context app = getApplicationContext();
        ConversionJobs.markRunning(job);
        handler.post(this::refreshNotif);
        File raw = new File(job.rawPath);
        RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.of(job.presetId);
        SaveFormat format = SaveFormat.of(job.formatId);
        try {
            if (!raw.exists()) throw new IllegalStateException("raw gone");
            if (job.cancelled) throw new CancellationException();
            TakeSaver.Progress cb = pct -> {
                if (serviceTimedOut) throw new PausedForTimeoutException();
                if (job.cancelled) throw new CancellationException();
                // Yields between chunks too: the encoder must not hold the
                // codec while the user is capturing a new take.
                awaitRecordingIdle(job);
                if (job.cancelled) throw new CancellationException();
                ConversionJobs.updateProgress(job, pct,
                        pct * Math.max(1, job.framesTotal) / 100);
                handler.post(this::refreshNotif);
            };
            TakeSaver.Result r;
            File part = new File(job.partPath);
            // A4-08: judge the partial by its bytes, not by job.framesDone,
            // which is only flushed every 5% of progress. A kill at 2% left a
            // perfectly resumable part that this gate threw away.
            if (part.exists() && part.length() > 44
                    && isWavFormat(format.effective(preset))) {
                r = resumeWav(app, job, raw, part, preset, format, cb);
            } else {
                if (part.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    part.delete();
                }
                r = TakeSaver.convertRaw(app, raw, job.title, preset,
                        format, cb);
            }
            if (job.cancelled) throw new CancellationException();
            // A rename can arrive after encoding finished but before the
            // finished take is visible. It wins over every title captured
            // earlier; without one, the initial edit-replace title (or the
            // live job title, or the conversion result) stands as before.
            String renamed = ConversionJobs.peekRenamedTitle(job.rawPath);
            String liveTitle;
            if (renamed != null) {
                liveTitle = renamed;
            } else if (job.replaceTakeId != -1 && job.replaceTitle != null
                    && !job.replaceTitle.isEmpty()) {
                liveTitle = job.replaceTitle;
            } else if (job.title != null && !job.title.trim().isEmpty()) {
                liveTitle = job.title.trim();
            } else {
                liveTitle = r.title;
            }
            job.title = liveTitle;
            Take take;
            if (job.replaceTakeId != -1) {
                // Edit punch-in saved to the background worker: honour the
                // replace-vs-new choice made up front instead of duplicating.
                take = TakesRepository.replaceRecording(job.replaceTakeId,
                        r.file, r.durationMs, liveTitle, r.label);
            } else {
                take = TakesRepository.addRecording(r.file, r.durationMs,
                        liveTitle, r.label);
            }
            ConversionJobs.noteCompletion(job.rawPath, take.id);
            String lateRename = ConversionJobs.consumeRenamedTitle(job.rawPath);
            if (lateRename != null && !lateRename.equals(take.title)) {
                TakesRepository.rename(take.id, lateRename);
            }
            // STU-03: an Edit on the converting card decodes this same raw.
            // Delete now, or defer until its last reader finishes: dropping
            // the file here would corrupt the reader, and skipping the
            // delete would leak the raw into reconcile() as a duplicate.
            ConversionJobs.deleteOrDeferRaw(job.rawPath);
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(job.rawPath + ".pending").delete();
            ConversionJobs.markDone(job);
            doneNotif(true, job.title, r.label, null);
            broadcast(true, job, r.label, null);
        } catch (PausedForTimeoutException paused) {
            // The platform reclaimed our foreground time mid-job. Park the
            // job as QUEUED with its sidecar and valid .part intact — never
            // delete — so the next launch resumes it. Tell the user why
            // progress stopped.
            job.state = ConversionJob.QUEUED;
            job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
            job.write();
            timeoutPausedNotif(job);
        } catch (CancellationException cancelled) {
            if (job.superseded) {
                // Replaced by an edit while converting: the replacement job
                // owns the take now. Abort silently — no failure notification,
                // no toast, no .pending marker — and drop the raw the
                // replacement no longer needs.
                ConversionJobs.cancel(job.jobId, true);
                return;
            }
            ConversionJobs.cancel(job.jobId, false);
            doneNotif(false, job.title, null,
                    getString(R.string.conv_cancelled_msg, job.title));
            broadcast(false, job, null, "cancelled");
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            // Catch Throwable, not Exception: a native codec aborting throws
            // an Error, which slipped past the old handler and left the job
            // stuck in RUNNING forever - the library card never resolved and
            // the service never stopped.
            if (job.cancelled) {
                // A superseded job whose raw vanished mid-encode lands here
                // instead of the CancellationException branch: still silent.
                if (job.superseded) {
                    ConversionJobs.cancel(job.jobId, true);
                    return;
                }
                // Lost a race with an explicit cancel (e.g. the raw was
                // deleted under us): the canceller owns the UX, stay quiet.
                ConversionJobs.cancel(job.jobId, false);
                return;
            }
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(getApplicationContext(),
                    "convert worker THREW: " + t);
            android.util.Log.w("ConversionService",
                    "convert worker threw", t);
            ConversionJobs.markFailed(job, String.valueOf(t));
            // Keep the raw and re-arm its pending marker so the next launch
            // offers the usual continue/discard recovery for the take.
            RecordingEngine.writePendingMarker(raw, job.title, job.channels);
            doneNotif(false, job.title, null,
                    getString(R.string.convert_failed_msg, job.title));
            broadcast(false, job, null, String.valueOf(t));
        }
    }

    private static boolean isWavFormat(SaveFormat eff) {
        return eff == SaveFormat.WAV16 || eff == SaveFormat.WAV24;
    }

    /**
     * Appends the remaining raw frames to a partial WAV from an interrupted
     * attempt, then patches the header. Byte-exact resume: the cheapest
     * possible "minimum reconversion".
     */
    private TakeSaver.Result resumeWav(Context app, ConversionJob job,
                                       File raw, File part,
                                       RecordPreset preset, SaveFormat format,
                                       TakeSaver.Progress cb) throws Exception {
        return resumeWavConvert(app, raw, part, preset, format, job, cb);
    }

    /**
     * Byte-exact WAV resume: appends frames [job.framesDone, end) to a
     * partial output, then finalizes. A resumed file is bit-identical to a
     * from-scratch conversion, which is what makes "minimum reconversion"
     * more than a slogan. Static + headless so unit tests can prove it.
     */
    static TakeSaver.Result resumeWavConvert(Context app, File raw, File part,
                                             RecordPreset preset,
                                             SaveFormat format,
                                             ConversionJob job,
                                             TakeSaver.Progress cb)
            throws Exception {
        SaveFormat eff = format.effective(preset);
        boolean w24 = eff == SaveFormat.WAV24;
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
        int ch = Math.max(1, info.channels);
        int frameBytes = ch * (w24 ? 3 : 2);
        long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4 / ch;
        long expectLen = 44 + job.framesDone * frameBytes;
        if (!isWavHeaderValid(part, ch, info.sampleRate, w24 ? 24 : 16)) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            part.delete();
            return TakeSaver.convertRaw(app, raw, job.title, preset, format, cb);
        }
        if (part.length() != expectLen) {
            // AUDIT-3-02 fix: `job.framesDone` is only a 5%-rounded estimate
            // while converting, so it almost never lines up with the chunked
            // bytes actually on disk. Adopt the real frame-aligned payload
            // instead of throwing away a perfectly good partial.
            long diskPayload = part.length() - 44;
            if (diskPayload > 0 && (diskPayload % frameBytes) == 0
                    && isWavHeaderValid(part, ch, info.sampleRate,
                    w24 ? 24 : 16)
                    && (diskPayload / frameBytes) <= totalFrames) {
                job.framesDone = diskPayload / frameBytes;
            } else {
                // Partial does not line up: restart cleanly.
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                part.delete();
                return TakeSaver.convertRaw(app, raw, job.title, preset,
                        format, cb);
            }
        }
        try {
            if (job.framesDone >= totalFrames) {
                patchWavHeader(part, info.channels, info.sampleRate, w24,
                        totalFrames);
                FormatConverter.validateFinal(part, eff);
                return finishResumed(app, raw, part, job, eff, preset);
            }
        java.io.RandomAccessFile r = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "r");
        java.io.RandomAccessFile w = null;
        try {
            w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(part, "rw");
            long totalSamples = info.dataBytes / 4;
            long doneSamples = job.framesDone * info.channels;
            w.seek(w.length());
            byte[] in = new byte[65536 * 4];
            // Worst case (24-bit packs 3 bytes per sample).
            byte[] out = new byte[65536 * 3];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            int[] ints = w24 ? new int[65536] : null;
            java.nio.ShortBuffer sb = w24 ? null : java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(out)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asShortBuffer();
            int lastPct = -1;
            while (doneSamples < totalSamples) {
                if (job.cancelled) throw new CancellationException();
                int want = (int) Math.min(65536, totalSamples - doneSamples);
                r.seek(info.dataStart + doneSamples * 4L);
                r.readFully(in, 0, want * 4);
                if (w24) {
                    FormatConverter.toInt24(fb, want, ints);
                    int p = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < want; i++) {
                        int v = ints[i];
                        out[p++] = (byte) (v & 0xFF);
                        out[p++] = (byte) ((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
                        out[p++] = (byte) ((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
                    }
                    w.write(out, 0, want * 3);
                } else {
                    FormatConverter.toInt16(fb, want, sb);
                    w.write(out, 0, want * 2);
                }
                doneSamples += want;
                int pct = (int) (doneSamples * 100 / Math.max(1, totalSamples));
                if (pct != lastPct) {
                    lastPct = pct;
                    if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(pct);
                    job.framesDone = doneSamples / Math.max(1, info.channels);
                }
            }
            patchWavHeader(part, info.channels, info.sampleRate, w24,
                    totalFrames);
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (w != null) {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        FormatConverter.validateFinal(part, eff);
        return finishResumed(app, raw, part, job, eff, preset);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            // A failed resume must not leave its part behind: the job's
            // sidecar is deleted on failure, so nothing could ever resume
            // this part again. Exception: an Android 15 FGS timeout leaves
            // a byte-valid resumable WAV part behind on purpose.
            boolean keepWavPart = t.getClass().getSimpleName().contains("Timeout")
                    && (eff == SaveFormat.WAV16 || eff == SaveFormat.WAV24);
            if (!keepWavPart) {
                try {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    part.delete();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (t instanceof Error) throw (Error) t;
            if (t instanceof Exception) throw (Exception) t;
            throw new IllegalStateException(t);
        }
    }

    private static TakeSaver.Result finishResumed(Context app, File raw,
                                                   File part,
                                                   ConversionJob job,
                                                   SaveFormat eff,
                                                   RecordPreset preset)
            throws Exception {
        // Same bar as a fresh conversion (NEW-03): never expose an
        // unvalidated container under a final extension.
        FormatConverter.validateFinal(part, eff);
        File fin = TakeSaver.uniqueFinal(raw,
                eff == SaveFormat.WAV24 ? "wav" : "wav");
        if (!part.renameTo(fin)) throw new IllegalStateException("adopt");
        // AUDIT-3-01 fix: `fin` is integer PCM16/PCM24 (audioFormat 1), so
        // `TakeSaver.durationOf(fin)` (which calls `readFloatWav`) always
        // threw and returned 1000 ms. Read duration via `Dsp.wavDurationMs`.
        long dur = Dsp.wavDurationMs(fin);
        if (dur <= 0) {
            dur = Math.max(TakeSaver.durationOf(raw),
                    Math.max(job.durationMs, 1000));
        }
        return new TakeSaver.Result(fin, eff.badge, Math.max(dur, 1000),
                job.title);
    }

    /** True when the partial carries a real RIFF/WAVE header. */
    private static boolean isWavHeaderValid(File part) {
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile r =
                      new java.io.RandomAccessFile(part, "r")) {
            if (r.length() < 44) return false;
            byte[] h = new byte[12];
            r.readFully(h);
            return h[0] == 'R' && h[1] == 'I' && h[2] == 'F' && h[3] == 'F'
                    && h[8] == 'W' && h[9] == 'A' && h[10] == 'V'
                    && h[11] == 'E';
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * True when the partial is a real RIFF/WAVE file with exactly the geometry
     * a resume would append: integer PCM, expected channels, rate and depth. A
     * stale part from a different bit depth or channel count whose byte size
     * happens to divide evenly must never be adopted.
     */
    private static boolean isWavHeaderValid(File part, int expectedCh,
                                            int expectedSr, int expectedBits) {
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile r =
                     new java.io.RandomAccessFile(part, "r")) {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            return h.audioFormat == 1 && h.channels == expectedCh
                    && h.sampleRate == expectedSr && h.bits == expectedBits;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    // ---- notifications ----

    private void ensureChannel() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return;
        try {
            NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager)
                    getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm == null) return;
            NotificationChannel ch = new NotificationChannel(
                    CHANNEL, getString(R.string.conv_channel),
                    NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW);
            ch.setDescription(getString(R.string.conv_channel_desc));
            nm.createNotificationChannel(ch);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private void startFg(ConversionJob job) {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, buildNotif(job),
                        android.content.pm.ServiceInfo
                                .FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_DATA_SYNC);
            } else {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, buildNotif(job));
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this, "conv startForeground failed: " + e);
            try {
                stopSelf();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private void refreshNotif() {
        try {
            if (!workerAlive) return;
            ConversionJob job = resolveCurrent();
            if (job == null && queue.isEmpty()) return;
            NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager)
                    getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm != null) nm.notify(NOTIF_ID, buildNotif(job));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private Notification buildNotif(ConversionJob job) {
        String title;
        String text;
        String badge = null;
        int pct = -1;
        if (job != null) {
            pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, job.progress));
            badge = TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.of(job.presetId),
                    SaveFormat.of(job.formatId));
            title = getString(R.string.conv_notif_title, pct);
            text = getString(R.string.conv_notif_text, job.title, badge);
        } else {
            title = getString(R.string.conv_notif_idle_title);
            text = getString(R.string.conv_notif_idle_text);
        }
        Intent open = new Intent(this, MainActivity.class);
        PendingIntent content = null;
        try {
            content = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 30, open,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                            | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder b =
                new androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL);
        b.setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_wave);
        b.setColor(0xFFFF3B30);
        b.setColorized(false);
        if (badge != null) b.setSubText(badge);
        b.setContentTitle(title);
        b.setContentText(text);
        b.setCategory(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_PROGRESS);
        b.setVisibility(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC);
        b.setOngoing(true);
        b.setOnlyAlertOnce(true);
        b.setSilent(true);
        b.setShowWhen(false);
        if (content != null) b.setContentIntent(content);
        if (pct >= 0) b.setProgress(100, pct, false);
        if (job != null) {
            Intent cancel = new Intent(this, ConversionService.class);
            cancel.setAction(ACTION_CANCEL_JOB);
            cancel.putExtra(EXTRA_JOB_ID, job.jobId);
            PendingIntent pi = null;
            try {
                pi = PendingIntent.getService(this, 31 + job.jobId.hashCode(),
                        cancel, PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                                | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (pi != null) {
                b.addAction(0, getString(R.string.conv_cancel), pi);
            }
        }
        try {
            return b.build();
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            return new Notification();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Tells the user the platform paused background conversion (time budget),
     * and that it resumes on next launch. Informational only: no take state
     * changes and no worker action.
     */
    private void timeoutPausedNotif(ConversionJob job) {
        try {
            NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager)
                    getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm == null) return;
            androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder b =
                    new androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder(this,
                            CHANNEL);
            b.setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_wave);
            b.setColor(0xFFFF9F0A);
            b.setContentTitle(getString(R.string.conv_timeout_title));
            b.setContentText(getString(R.string.conv_timeout_msg,
                    job.title != null ? job.title : ""));
            b.setVisibility(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC);
            b.setAutoCancel(true);
            nm.notify(DONE_NOTIF_ID + (int) (System.currentTimeMillis() % 1000),
                    b.build());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private void doneNotif(boolean ok, String title, String label, String msg) {
        try {
            NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager)
                    getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm == null) return;
            Intent open = new Intent(this, MainActivity.class);
            PendingIntent content = null;
            try {
                content = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 32, open,
                        PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                                | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            boolean isCancel = "cancelled".equals(msg)
                    || (msg != null && msg.contains("cancelled"));
            androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder b =
                    new androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder(this,
                            CHANNEL);
            b.setSmallIcon(ok ? R.drawable.ic_check : R.drawable.ic_wave);
            b.setColor(ok ? 0xFF34C759 : 0xFFFF3B30);
            if (label != null && !label.isEmpty()) b.setSubText(label);
            b.setContentTitle(ok ? getString(R.string.convert_done_title)
                    : (isCancel ? getString(R.string.conv_cancelled)
                            : getString(R.string.convert_failed_title)));
            b.setContentText(ok
                    ? getString(R.string.convert_done_msg, title, label)
                    : (msg != null ? msg : ""));
            b.setVisibility(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC);
            b.setAutoCancel(true);
            if (content != null) b.setContentIntent(content);
            nm.notify(DONE_NOTIF_ID + (int) (System.currentTimeMillis() % 1000),
                    b.build());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        // NOTE: Do NOT call handler.post(this::refreshNotif) here!
        // Posting refreshNotif after the final job finishes races with
        // stopForeground(true) and leaves a permanent "Conversion ready"
        // notification stuck in the notification shade.
    }

    private void broadcast(boolean ok, ConversionJob job, String label,
                           String message) {
        try {
            Intent b = new Intent(BROADCAST_CONVERSION_DONE);
            b.putExtra(EXTRA_OK, ok);
            b.putExtra(EXTRA_TITLE, job.title);
            b.putExtra("job_id", job.jobId);
            if (label != null) b.putExtra(EXTRA_LABEL, label);
            if (message != null) b.putExtra("message", message);
            b.setPackage(getPackageName());
            sendBroadcast(b);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (!ok && "cancelled".equals(message)) {
            // The user cancelled this conversion on purpose: the Library
            // already treats it as a non-failure, so stay silent instead of
            // flashing "Something went wrong".
            return;
        }
        try {
            handler.post(() -> {
                try {
                    Toast.makeText(getApplicationContext(),
                            ok ? getString(R.string.convert_done_msg,
                                    job.title,
                                    label != null ? label : "")
                                    : getString(R.string.convert_failed_msg,
                                    job.title),
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            });
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static void patchWavHeader(File part, int ch, int sr, boolean w24,
                                       long frames) throws Exception {
        java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(part, "rw");
        try {
            w.seek(0);
            w.write(w24 ? Dsp.wav24Header(ch, sr, frames * ch * 3L)
                    : Dsp.wav16Header(ch, sr, frames * ch * 2L));
        } finally {
            try {
                w.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.Uri;

import androidx.core.content.FileProvider;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileWriter;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.io.StringWriter;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Last-resort diagnostics. The default uncaught-exception handler writes the
 * stack trace to {@code takeone-crash.txt} before delegating to the system
 * handler, and {@link #breadcrumb} appends lifecycle markers to
 * {@code takeone-breadcrumbs.txt} so a launch loop leaves a trail even when
 * the killer is native code (which no try/catch can observe).
 */
public final class CrashLog {

    private static final String CRASH_FILE = "takeone-crash.txt";
    private static final String CRUMB_FILE = "takeone-breadcrumbs.txt";
    private static final long MAX_CRUMB_BYTES = 64 * 1024;

    private static volatile boolean installed;

    private CrashLog() {}

    /** Idempotent. Call first in every process entry point. */
    public static void install(Context ctx) {
        if (installed) return;
        installed = true;
        final Context app;
        try {
            app = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return;
        }
        breadcrumb(app, "process start");
        final Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler prev =
                Thread.getDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler();
        Thread.setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler((thread, err) -> {
            try {
                breadcrumb(app, "CRASH on " + thread.getName() + ": " + err);
                File f = new File(app.getFilesDir(), CRASH_FILE);
                FileWriter w = new FileWriter(f, false);
                try {
                    w.write(stamp() + " thread=" + thread.getName() + "\n");
                    StringWriter sw = new StringWriter();
                    PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(sw);
                    try {
                        err.printStackTrace(pw);
                    } finally {
                        pw.close();
                    }
                    w.write(sw.toString());
                    w.write("\n--- breadcrumbs ---\n");
                    File crumbs = new File(app.getFilesDir(), CRUMB_FILE);
                    if (crumbs.exists()) {
                        java.io.FileInputStream in =
                                new java.io.FileInputStream(crumbs);
                        try {
                            byte[] buf = new byte[8192];
                            int n;
                            while ((n = in.read(buf)) != -1) {
                                w.write(new String(buf, 0, n, "UTF-8"));
                            }
                        } finally {
                            try {
                                in.close();
                            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                        }
                    }
                    // Flushed to the OS: process death doesn't lose it
                    // (only power loss would, and nothing can help that).
                    w.flush();
                } finally {
                    try {
                        w.close();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            } finally {
                if (prev != null) {
                    try {
                        prev.uncaughtException(thread, err);
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /** Append one marker line (flushed; cheap enough for startup stages). */
    public static void breadcrumb(Context ctx, String mark) {
        if (ctx == null || mark == null) return;
        try {
            Context app = ctx.getApplicationContext();
            File f = new File(app.getFilesDir(), CRUMB_FILE);
            if (f.exists() && f.length() > MAX_CRUMB_BYTES) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
            }
            FileWriter w = new FileWriter(f, true);
            try {
                w.write(stamp() + " " + mark + "\n");
                w.flush();
            } finally {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /** Crash report from a previous run, or null. */
    public static File recentCrash(Context ctx) {
        try {
            File f = new File(ctx.getApplicationContext().getFilesDir(), CRASH_FILE);
            return f.exists() && f.length() > 0 ? f : null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Last convert/finalize stage that started but never reported back.
     * A native encoder death leaves "convert start opus" as the tail with no
     * matching end — the one trace a segfault cannot erase.
     *
     * @return e.g. "convert opus", "finalize", or null when everything closed.
     */
    public static String unterminatedStage(Context ctx) {
        try {
            File f = new File(ctx.getApplicationContext().getFilesDir(), CRUMB_FILE);
            if (!f.exists()) return null;
            java.io.FileInputStream in = new java.io.FileInputStream(f);
            String tail;
            try {
                long len = f.length();
                long skip = Math.max(0, len - 8192);
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                in.skip(skip);
                byte[] buf = new byte[(int) Math.min(len, 8192) + 1];
                int n = in.read(buf);
                tail = n > 0 ? new String(buf, 0, n, "UTF-8") : "";
            } finally {
                try {
                    in.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            String pending = null;
            for (String line : tail.split("\n")) {
                int s = line.indexOf("convert start ");
                if (s >= 0) {
                    pending = "convert "
                            + line.substring(s + "convert start ".length()).trim();
                    continue;
                }
                if (line.contains("convert end")) {
                    pending = null;
                    continue;
                }
                if (pending != null && pending.startsWith("convert ")) {
                    // Switch lines carry the bare format id ("auto-switch
                    // flac->m4a") while pending holds the stage ("convert
                    // flac").
                    String fmt = pending.substring("convert ".length());
                    if (!fmt.isEmpty() && line.contains("auto-switch " + fmt)) {
                        pending = null;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                if (line.contains("finalize start")) {
                    pending = "finalize";
                    continue;
                }
                if (line.contains("finalize end")) {
                    pending = null;
                }
            }
            return pending;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static void clearCrash(Context ctx) {
        try {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(ctx.getApplicationContext().getFilesDir(), CRASH_FILE).delete();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /** Share intent for the crash report (email, chat, …). */
    public static void share(Context ctx, File crash) {
        try {
            Uri uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(ctx,
                    ctx.getPackageName() + ".fileprovider", crash);
            android.content.Intent i = new android.content.Intent(
                    android.content.Intent.ACTION_SEND);
            i.setType("text/plain");
            i.putExtra(android.content.Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, uri);
            i.putExtra(android.content.Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT,
                    "TakeOne crash report");
            i.addFlags(android.content.Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION);
            ctx.startActivity(android.content.Intent.createChooser(i,
                    "Share crash report"));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static String stamp() {
        try {
            return new SimpleDateFormat("MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS", Locale.US)
                    .format(new Date());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "?";
        }
    }
}
