package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.LinearGradient;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.graphics.Shader;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.View;

/**
 * Slim vertical dBFS meter (-60..0&nbsp;dB).
 *
 * <p>Designed to live as a thin rail beside the timer: a rounded capsule
 * track with a soft glow at the fill head, a single continuous colour ramp
 * rather than hard colour bands, and a peak-hold tick that decays slowly.
 */
public class DbMeterView extends View {

    private static final float FLOOR_DB = -60f;

    private final Paint trackPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint fillPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint glowPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint peakPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final RectF rect = new RectF();

    private float level; // 0..1 smoothed
    private float peak;  // 0..1 peak-hold
    private float radius;

    public DbMeterView(Context context) {
        super(context);
        init();
    }

    public DbMeterView(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
        super(context, attrs);
        init();
    }

    private void init() {
        trackPaint.setColor(0xFF171B21);
        glowPaint.setColor(0x66FFFFFF);
        peakPaint.setColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
    }

    /** Push one 0..1 peak sample; call at the studio tick cadence. */
    public void setLevel(float v) {
        v = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, v));
        // Fast attack so transients are not hidden, slow release so the bar
        // does not flicker between words.
        level = v > level ? v : level + (v - level) * 0.22f;
        peak = Math.max(v, peak - 0.010f);
        invalidate();
    }

    public void reset() {
        level = 0f;
        peak = 0f;
        invalidate();
    }

    private static float toDb(float v) {
        if (v <= 0.0001f) return FLOOR_DB;
        return Math.max(FLOOR_DB, 20f * (float) Math.log10(v));
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas);
        int w = getWidth();
        int h = getHeight();
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

        radius = Math.min(w / 2f, 6f);
        float inset = 0f;
        float top = inset;
        float bottom = h - inset;

        rect.set(0, top, w, bottom);
        canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, radius, radius, trackPaint);

        float db = toDb(level);
        float frac = (db - FLOOR_DB) / (0 - FLOOR_DB);
        float fillTop = bottom - frac * (bottom - top);
        if (fillTop >= bottom - 0.5f) return;

        // One smooth ramp across the full height: red at the top, amber
        // through the mids, green near the floor. No banding.
        fillPaint.setShader(new LinearGradient(0, top, 0, bottom,
                new int[]{0xFFFF453A, 0xFFFF9F0A, 0xFF34C759},
                new float[]{0f, 0.30f, 0.62f},
                Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
        rect.set(0, fillTop, w, bottom);
        canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, radius, radius, fillPaint);
        fillPaint.setShader(null);

        // Soft cap highlight at the fill head.
        glowPaint.setAlpha(70);
        float capH = Math.min(10f, Math.max(3f, h * 0.02f));
        rect.set(0, fillTop, w, fillTop + capH);
        canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, radius, radius, glowPaint);
        glowPaint.setAlpha(255);

        float pdb = toDb(peak);
        float pfrac = (pdb - FLOOR_DB) / (0 - FLOOR_DB);
        float py = bottom - pfrac * (bottom - top);
        if (py > top && py < bottom) {
            peakPaint.setStrokeWidth(Math.max(1.5f, w * 0.16f));
            peakPaint.setStrokeCap(Paint.Cap.ROUND);
            canvas.drawLine(w * 0.28f, py, w * 0.72f, py, peakPaint);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Pure DSP + file-math helpers. Zero Android imports on purpose so this
 * class (and the audio math that ships inside user files) is unit-testable
 * on plain JUnit.
 */
public final class Dsp {

    private Dsp() {}

    public static String sanitize(String name) {
        if (name == null) return "Take";
        String s = name.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_").trim();
        s = s.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
        if (s.isEmpty()) s = "Take";
        if (s.length() > 60) s = s.substring(0, 60).trim();
        return s;
    }

    /**
     * Library title from a session file name: strips the extension and the
     * trailing _yyyyMMdd_HHmmss stamp (plus any " (n)" uniquifier), turns
     * underscores into spaces. "Take_My_Song_20261011_101500.wav" -> "Take My Song".
     */
    public static String prettyFileTitle(String fileName) {
        if (fileName == null) return "Take";
        String s = fileName;
        int dot = s.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot > 0) s = s.substring(0, dot);
        s = s.replaceFirst("\\s*\\(\\d+\\)\\s*$", "");
        s = s.replaceFirst("_\\d{8}_\\d{6}$", "");
        s = s.replace('_', ' ').replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
        if (s.isEmpty()) s = "Take";
        return s;
    }

    /** Matches the library's historical size rendering. */
    public static String sizeLabel(long length) {
        long mbTenths = Math.max(1, length / 102400);
        return String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f MB", mbTenths / 10f);
    }

    /** 44-byte IEEE-float WAV header (audioFormat 3, 32-bit). */
    public static byte[] wavFloatHeader(int ch, int sampleRate, long bytes) {
        ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.allocate(44).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        b.put(new byte[]{'R', 'I', 'F', 'F'});
        b.putInt((int) Math.min(Integer.MAX_VALUE, 36 + bytes));
        b.put(new byte[]{'W', 'A', 'V', 'E'});
        b.put(new byte[]{'f', 'm', 't', ' '});
        b.putInt(16);
        b.putShort((short) 3); // IEEE float
        b.putShort((short) ch);
        b.putInt(sampleRate);
        b.putInt(sampleRate * ch * 4);
        b.putShort((short) (ch * 4));
        b.putShort((short) 32);
        b.put(new byte[]{'d', 'a', 't', 'a'});
        b.putInt((int) Math.min(Integer.MAX_VALUE, bytes));
        return b.array();
    }

    /** 44-byte PCM WAV header. bits must be 16 or 24. */
    public static byte[] wavPcmHeader(int ch, int sr, int bits, long pcmBytes) {
        if (bits != 16 && bits != 24) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("unsupported pcm depth: " + bits);
        }
        int bytesPerSample = bits / 8;
        int blockAlign = ch * bytesPerSample;
        ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.allocate(44).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        b.put(new byte[]{'R', 'I', 'F', 'F'});
        b.putInt((int) Math.min(Integer.MAX_VALUE, 36 + pcmBytes));
        b.put(new byte[]{'W', 'A', 'V', 'E'});
        b.put(new byte[]{'f', 'm', 't', ' '});
        b.putInt(16);
        b.putShort((short) 1); // integer PCM
        b.putShort((short) ch);
        b.putInt(sr);
        b.putInt(sr * blockAlign);
        b.putShort((short) blockAlign);
        b.putShort((short) bits);
        b.put(new byte[]{'d', 'a', 't', 'a'});
        b.putInt((int) Math.min(Integer.MAX_VALUE, pcmBytes));
        return b.array();
    }

    /** 44-byte PCM-16 WAV header (audioFormat 1). */
    public static byte[] wav16Header(int ch, int sr, long pcmBytes) {
        return wavPcmHeader(ch, sr, 16, pcmBytes);
    }

    /** 44-byte PCM-24 WAV header (audioFormat 1, 3 bytes per sample). */
    public static byte[] wav24Header(int ch, int sr, long pcmBytes) {
        return wavPcmHeader(ch, sr, 24, pcmBytes);
    }

    /** Hamming-windowed sinc lowpass; cutoff in cycles/sample (0..0.5). */
    public static float[] firLowpass(double cutoffNorm, int taps) {
        float[] h = new float[taps];
        // Center as a double: integer (taps-1)/2 truncates for even tap
        // counts and silently breaks symmetry (caught by unit test).
        double m = (taps - 1) / 2.0;
        double sum = 0;
        for (int n = 0; n < taps; n++) {
            double x = n - m;
            double sinc = x == 0 ? 2 * Math.PI * cutoffNorm
                    : Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * cutoffNorm * x) / x;
            double win = 0.54 - 0.46 * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * n / (taps - 1));
            h[n] = (float) (sinc * win);
            sum += h[n];
        }
        for (int n = 0; n < taps; n++) h[n] /= sum;
        return h;
    }

    /**
     * Duration of a float32 / PCM16 / PCM24 WAV in ms, read from its own
     * header (located through the chunk scanner, so extra RIFF chunks do
     * not confuse it).
     *
     * @return ms, or -1 when the file is not a readable WAV (callers fall
     * back to MediaMetadataRetriever for compressed containers).
     */    public static long wavDurationMs(File f) {
        RandomAccessFile r = null;
        try {
            r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
            WavHeader h;
            try {
                h = parseWavHeader(r);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                return -1;
            }
            int bytesPerSample;
            if (h.audioFormat == 3 && h.bits == 32) bytesPerSample = 4;
            else if (h.audioFormat == 1 && h.bits == 16) bytesPerSample = 2;
            else if (h.audioFormat == 1 && h.bits == 24) bytesPerSample = 3;
            else return -1;
            long onDisk = Math.max(0, r.length() - h.dataStart);
            long dataBytes = h.dataBytes;
            if (dataBytes <= 0 || dataBytes > onDisk) dataBytes = onDisk;
            long frames = dataBytes / bytesPerSample / h.channels;
            return frames * 1000L / h.sampleRate;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        } finally {
            if (r != null) {
                try {
                    r.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
    }

    // ---- RIFF/WAV chunk scanner (BUG-06) ----

    /** Parsed WAV header: format geometry plus the real data-chunk location. */
    public static final class WavHeader {
        public final int audioFormat;
        public final int channels;
        public final int sampleRate;
        public final int bits;
        public final long dataStart;
        public final long dataBytes;

        WavHeader(int audioFormat, int channels, int sampleRate, int bits,
                  long dataStart, long dataBytes) {
            this.audioFormat = audioFormat;
            this.channels = channels;
            this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
            this.bits = bits;
            this.dataStart = dataStart;
            this.dataBytes = dataBytes;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Locates the {@code fmt } and {@code data} chunks by walking RIFF
     * sub-chunks ({@code id + size + payload}, word-aligned) instead of
     * assuming the payload starts at byte 44. TakeOne's own writer emits a
     * minimal 44-byte header, but external files (and anything with
     * {@code fact}, {@code LIST}, {@code JUNK} or {@code bext} chunks) place
     * {@code data} later — a hardcoded offset decodes chunk garbage as audio.
     */
    public static WavHeader parseWavHeader(RandomAccessFile r)
            throws Exception {
        long len = r.length();
        if (len < 44) throw new IllegalStateException("too small");
        byte[] riff = new byte[12];
        r.seek(0);
        r.readFully(riff);
        if (riff[0] != 'R' || riff[1] != 'I' || riff[2] != 'F' || riff[3] != 'F'
                || riff[8] != 'W' || riff[9] != 'A'
                || riff[10] != 'V' || riff[11] != 'E') {
            throw new IllegalStateException("not wav");
        }
        int audioFormat = -1, ch = -1, sr = -1, bits = -1;
        long dataStart = -1, dataBytes = 0;
        byte[] hdr = new byte[8];
        long pos = 12, scanned = 0;
        while (pos + 8 <= len && scanned < 1048576L) {
            r.seek(pos);
            r.readFully(hdr);
            long size = ByteBuffer.wrap(hdr, 4, 4)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).getInt() & 0xFFFFFFFFL;
            long payload = pos + 8;
            if (hdr[0] == 'f' && hdr[1] == 'm'
                    && hdr[2] == 't' && hdr[3] == ' ') {
                if (size < 16) throw new IllegalStateException("bad fmt");
                byte[] fmt = new byte[(int) Math.min(size, 40)];
                r.seek(payload);
                r.readFully(fmt);
                ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.wrap(fmt)
                        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                audioFormat = b.getShort(0) & 0xFFFF;
                ch = b.getShort(2) & 0xFFFF;
                sr = b.getInt(4);
                bits = b.getShort(14) & 0xFFFF;
            } else if (hdr[0] == 'd' && hdr[1] == 'a'
                    && hdr[2] == 't' && hdr[3] == 'a') {
                dataStart = payload;
                dataBytes = Math.min(size, Math.max(0, len - payload));
                if (audioFormat != -1) break;
            }
            long step = 8 + size + (size & 1L);
            if (step <= 8) break;
            pos += step;
            scanned += step;
            if (audioFormat != -1 && dataStart != -1) break;
        }
        if (audioFormat == -1 || ch < 1 || sr <= 0 || bits <= 0
                || dataStart < 0) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("bad wav header");
        }
        return new WavHeader(audioFormat, ch, sr, bits, dataStart, dataBytes);
    }

    /**
     * Writes floats little-endian in bounded chunks. {@link RandomAccessFile}
     * {@code writeFloat} is big-endian, which silently byte-swaps every
     * sample of a WAV payload.
     */
    public static void writeFloatsLE(RandomAccessFile w, float[] v, int off,
                                     int n) throws Exception {
        byte[] tmp = new byte[8192 * 4];
        ByteBuffer bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(tmp).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        int done = 0;
        while (done < n) {
            int want = Math.min(8192, n - done);
            bb.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < want; i++) bb.putFloat(v[off + done + i]);
            w.write(tmp, 0, want * 4);
            done += want;
        }
    }

    /** 240 frames @ 48 kHz = 5.0 ms raised-cosine crossfade window. */
    public static final int CROSSFADE_FRAMES = 240;
    private static final float[] COS_FADE_IN = new float[CROSSFADE_FRAMES];
    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < CROSSFADE_FRAMES; i++) {
            COS_FADE_IN[i] = 0.5f * (1.0f - (float) Math.cos(
                    Math.PI * (i + 0.5) / CROSSFADE_FRAMES));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Blends `frames` of `outgoing` (fading 1 -> 0) with `incoming` (fading 0 -> 1)
     * into `dst`. Uses precomputed LUT when frames == CROSSFADE_FRAMES for zero
     * runtime trig overhead on low-end CPUs.
     */
    public static void crossfadeFrames(float[] outgoing, int outFrameOff,
                                       float[] incoming, int inFrameOff,
                                       float[] dst, int dstFrameOff,
                                       int frames, int ch) {
        if (frames <= 0 || ch < 1) return;
        boolean useLut = (frames == CROSSFADE_FRAMES);
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float wIn = useLut ? COS_FADE_IN[f]
                    : 0.5f * (1.0f - (float) Math.cos(Math.PI * (f + 0.5) / frames));
            float wOut = 1.0f - wIn;
            int oIdx = (outFrameOff + f) * ch;
            int iIdx = (inFrameOff + f) * ch;
            int dIdx = (dstFrameOff + f) * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                dst[dIdx + c] = outgoing[oIdx + c] * wOut
                        + incoming[iIdx + c] * wIn;
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies a short raised-cosine fade-in or fade-out in-place to `buf`
     * (interleaved `frames * ch` floats).
     */
    public static void applyFadeInPlace(float[] buf, int frameOff,
                                        int frames, int ch, boolean fadeIn) {
        if (frames <= 0 || ch < 1) return;
        boolean useLut = (frames == CROSSFADE_FRAMES);
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float w = useLut ? COS_FADE_IN[f]
                    : 0.5f * (1.0f - (float) Math.cos(Math.PI * (f + 0.5) / frames));
            if (!fadeIn) w = 1.0f - w;
            int idx = (frameOff + f) * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                buf[idx + c] *= w;
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Scans within +/- `radiusFrames` (default 240 = +/- 5ms) around `targetFrame`
     * in a 32-bit float WAV to find the frame with minimum absolute energy
     * (preferring rising zero-crossings on channel 0), eliminating splice clicks.
     */
    public static long snapToZeroCrossing(RandomAccessFile r, long dataStart,
                                          int ch, long targetFrame,
                                          long totalFrames, int radiusFrames) {
        if (totalFrames <= 0 || targetFrame <= 0) return 0;
        if (targetFrame >= totalFrames) return totalFrames;
        long lo = Math.max(0, targetFrame - radiusFrames);
        long hi = Math.min(totalFrames - 1, targetFrame + radiusFrames);
        int span = (int) (hi - lo + 1);
        if (span <= 1) return targetFrame;
        try {
            byte[] raw = new byte[span * ch * 4];
            r.seek(dataStart + lo * ch * 4L);
            r.readFully(raw);
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(raw)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            long bestFrame = targetFrame;
            float bestScore = Float.MAX_VALUE;
            float prev0 = fb.get(0);
            for (int f = 1; f < span; f++) {
                float s0 = fb.get(f * ch);
                float energy = Math.abs(s0);
                if (ch > 1) energy += Math.abs(fb.get(f * ch + 1));
                boolean zeroCross = (prev0 <= 0f && s0 >= 0f)
                        || (prev0 >= 0f && s0 <= 0f);
                // Bias strongly toward true zero crossings near targetFrame.
                float distPenalty = Math.abs((lo + f) - targetFrame) * 0.0002f;
                float score = (zeroCross ? energy * 0.1f : energy) + distPenalty;
                if (score < bestScore) {
                    bestScore = score;
                    bestFrame = lo + f;
                }
                prev0 = s0;
            }
            return bestFrame;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return targetFrame;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Peak envelope of a 32-bit float WAV for waveform display: at most
     * {@code maxBuckets} columns, each the max absolute sample across all
     * channels in its span. Pure I/O + math so it can run on any thread.
     */
    public static float[] loadPeaks(File wav, int maxBuckets) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(wav, "r");
        try {
            WavHeader h = parseWavHeader(r);
            if (h.audioFormat != 3 || h.bits != 32 || h.channels < 1) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("need 32-bit float wav");
            }
            long onDisk = Math.max(0, r.length() - h.dataStart);
            long dataBytes = h.dataBytes;
            if (dataBytes <= 0 || dataBytes > onDisk) dataBytes = onDisk;
            long totalFrames = dataBytes / 4 / h.channels;
            if (totalFrames <= 0) return new float[0];
            int buckets = (int) Math.min(Math.max(1, maxBuckets),
                    Math.max(1, totalFrames / 120));
            float[] peaks = new float[buckets];
            int framesPerRead = Math.max(1, 65536 / 4 / h.channels);
            byte[] in = new byte[framesPerRead * h.channels * 4];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            r.seek(h.dataStart);
            long frame = 0;
            while (frame < totalFrames) {
                int want = (int) Math.min(framesPerRead, totalFrames - frame);
                r.readFully(in, 0, want * h.channels * 4);
                fb.clear();
                fb.limit(want * h.channels);
                for (int f = 0; f < want; f++) {
                    float peak = 0f;
                    for (int c = 0; c < h.channels; c++) {
                        float s = fb.get(f * h.channels + c);
                        float a = s < 0f ? -s : s;
                        if (a > peak) peak = a;
                    }
                    int b = (int) ((frame + f) * buckets / totalFrames);
                    if (b >= buckets) b = buckets - 1;
                    if (peak > peaks[b]) peaks[b] = peak;
                }
                frame += want;
            }
            return peaks;
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    /**
     * Streaming sample-rate converter for import duty: arbitrary rates to the
     * fixed 48 kHz session format with bounded memory (a few KB of overlap
     * state, independent of duration).
     *
     * <p>Upsampling uses linear interpolation between adjacent frames.
     * Downsampling first band-limits with a streaming 64-tap windowed-sinc
     * lowpass at 80% of the destination Nyquist, then interpolates — so no
     * aliasing folds back into the session.
     */
    public static final class Resampler {
        private final int srcRate;
        private final int dstRate;
        private final int ch;
        private final boolean downsample;
        private final float[] fir;
        private final int taps;
        /** Overlap for the prefilter: last taps-1 raw frames (zero-padded). */
        private final float[] fCarry;
        /** Last postfilter frame per channel, for interpolation. */
        private final float[] prev;
        private boolean havePrev;
        /** Absolute position (postfilter-stream frames) of the next output. */
        private double nextPos;
        private long inFrames;
        private long outFrames;

        public Resampler(int srcRate, int dstRate, int channels) {
            if (srcRate <= 0 || dstRate <= 0 || channels < 1) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("bad resample geometry");
            }
            this.srcRate = srcRate;
            this.dstRate = dstRate;
            this.ch = channels;
            this.downsample = srcRate > dstRate;
            if (downsample) {
                this.taps = 64;
                this.fir = firLowpass(0.8 * (dstRate / 2.0) / srcRate, taps);
            } else {
                this.taps = 0;
                this.fir = null;
            }
            this.fCarry = downsample ? new float[(taps - 1) * channels] : null;
            this.prev = new float[channels];
            this.havePrev = srcRate == dstRate;
            this.nextPos = 0.0;
        }

        /**
         * Converts one chunk; returns the destination-rate frames produced
         * (possibly empty). Input is interleaved source-rate frames.
         */
        public float[] push(float[] in, int frames) {
            if (frames <= 0) return new float[0];
            if (srcRate == dstRate) {
                float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
                System.arraycopy(in, 0, out, 0, frames * ch);
                inFrames += frames;
                outFrames += frames;
                return out;
            }
            // Stage 1: optional streaming lowpass at the source rate.
            float[] stream;
            int streamFrames;
            if (downsample) {
                int ext = (taps - 1) + frames;
                float[] x = new float[ext * ch];
                System.arraycopy(fCarry, 0, x, 0, (taps - 1) * ch);
                System.arraycopy(in, 0, x, (taps - 1) * ch, frames * ch);
                stream = new float[frames * ch];
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        float acc = 0f;
                        for (int k = 0; k < taps; k++) {
                            acc += x[(f + k) * ch + c] * fir[taps - 1 - k];
                        }
                        stream[f * ch + c] = acc;
                    }
                }
                System.arraycopy(x, frames * ch, fCarry, 0, (taps - 1) * ch);
                streamFrames = frames;
            } else {
                stream = in;
                streamFrames = frames;
            }
            // Stage 2: linear interpolation onto the destination grid using a
            // primitive float[] buffer (no ArrayList<Float> boxing).
            double step = (double) srcRate / dstRate;
            long base = inFrames;
            double span = (base + streamFrames - 1) - nextPos;
            int estFrames = span >= 0 ? (int) Math.floor(span / step) + 2 : 1;
            float[] out = new float[Math.max(4, estFrames) * ch];
            int outPos = 0;
            while (true) {
                long i0 = (long) Math.floor(nextPos) - base;
                double frac = nextPos - Math.floor(nextPos);
                if (i0 + 1 >= streamFrames) break;
                if (outPos + ch > out.length) {
                    out = Arrays.copyOf(out, out.length * 2);
                }
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float s0 = i0 < 0
                            ? (havePrev ? prev[c] : stream[c])
                            : stream[(int) i0 * ch + c];
                    float s1 = stream[((int) i0 + 1) * ch + c];
                    out[outPos++] = (float) (s0 + (s1 - s0) * frac);
                }
                nextPos += step;
                outFrames++;
            }
            // Retain the last postfilter frame for the next chunk.
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                prev[c] = stream[(streamFrames - 1) * ch + c];
            }
            havePrev = true;
            inFrames += frames;
            return outPos == out.length ? out : Arrays.copyOf(out, outPos);
        }

        /**
         * Drains the tail: fades the last frame out so edge samples still
         * produce output, keeping the total duration exact to within a frame.
         */
        public float[] flush() {
            if (srcRate == dstRate) return new float[0];
            double step = (double) srcRate / dstRate;
            long target = (long) Math.floor(
                    (double) inFrames * dstRate / srcRate);
            int rem = (int) Math.max(0, target - outFrames);
            float[] out = new float[rem * ch];
            int outPos = 0;
            while (outFrames < target) {
                double frac = nextPos - Math.floor(nextPos);
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float s0 = havePrev ? prev[c] : 0f;
                    out[outPos++] = (float) (s0 * (1.0 - frac));
                }
                nextPos += step;
                outFrames++;
            }
            return outPos == out.length ? out : Arrays.copyOf(out, outPos);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Streaming symmetric-FIR decimator with the exact indexing of the old
     * batch AMR path (output {@code o} centres on input
     * {@code o * decim - taps / 2}, zero-padded outside the stream), so a
     * chunked conversion is bit-identical to a whole-file one — but the
     * retained window stays under ~17k samples no matter how long the take.
     */
    public static final class FirDecimator {
        private final int decim;
        private final int taps;
        private final int delay;
        private final int half;
        private final float[] fir;
        private float[] buf;
        private int bufLen;
        private long baseAbs;
        private long inAbs;
        private long outCount;

        public FirDecimator(int decim, float[] firTaps) {
            if (decim < 1 || firTaps == null || firTaps.length < 2) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("bad decimator");
            }
            this.decim = decim;
            this.fir = firTaps.clone();
            this.taps = firTaps.length;
            this.delay = taps / 2;
            this.half = taps / 2;
            this.buf = new float[16384 + taps];
        }

        private void ensure(int need) {
            if (bufLen + need <= buf.length) return;
            int cap = Math.max(buf.length * 2, bufLen + need);
            float[] bigger = new float[cap];
            System.arraycopy(buf, 0, bigger, 0, bufLen);
            buf = bigger;
        }

        private short emit(long o) {
            long center = o * decim - delay;
            float acc = 0f;
            for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                long i1 = center + k;
                long i2 = center + taps - 1 - k;
                // Only retained samples are real; anything compacted away or
                // past the buffered tail reads as zero (leading/trailing pad).
                float s1 = (i1 >= baseAbs && i1 < baseAbs + bufLen)
                        ? buf[(int) (i1 - baseAbs)] : 0f;
                float s2 = (i2 >= baseAbs && i2 < baseAbs + bufLen)
                        ? buf[(int) (i2 - baseAbs)] : 0f;
                acc += s1 * fir[k] + s2 * fir[taps - 1 - k];
            }
            if (acc > 1f) acc = 1f;
            else if (acc < -1f) acc = -1f;
            return (short) (acc * 32767f);
        }

        private void compact() {
            long needFrom = outCount * decim - delay;
            if (needFrom > baseAbs) {
                int drop = (int) Math.min(bufLen, needFrom - baseAbs);
                System.arraycopy(buf, drop, buf, 0, bufLen - drop);
                bufLen -= drop;
                baseAbs += drop;
            }
        }

        /**
         * Appends mono samples; emits every output whose filter window is
         * fully buffered. Returns shorts appended at {@code out[outPos..]}.
         */
        public int push(float[] in, int n, short[] out, int outPos) {
            if (n <= 0) return 0;
            ensure(n);
            System.arraycopy(in, 0, buf, bufLen, n);
            bufLen += n;
            inAbs += n;
            int made = 0;
            while (true) {
                long center = outCount * decim - delay;
                if (center + taps > baseAbs + bufLen) break;
                out[outPos + made++] = emit(outCount);
                outCount++;
            }
            compact();
            return made;
        }

        /**
         * Emits the tail (zero-padded past the end) so the total output count
         * is exactly {@code totalIn / decim}, matching a batch conversion.
         */
        public int flush(long totalIn, short[] out, int outPos) {
            long want = totalIn / decim;
            int made = 0;
            while (outCount < want) {
                out[outPos + made++] = emit(outCount);
                outCount++;
            }
            return made;
        }
    }

    // ---- trash dir (delete-undo safety net) ----

    /** Subdirectory of the takes dir holding soft-deleted audio. */
    public static File trashDir(File takesDir) {
        File t = new File(takesDir, ".trash");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        t.mkdirs();
        return t;
    }

    /**
     * Moves a backing file into the trash instead of deleting it, so
     * delete-undo can bring the audio back too — not just the entry.
     *
     * @return the trash location, or null when the move failed (caller then
     * falls back to a straight delete).
     */
    public static File moveToTrash(File takesDir, File target) {
        if (target == null || !target.exists()) return null;
        try {
            File trash = trashDir(takesDir);
            File dest = uniqueIn(trash, target.getName());
            if (target.renameTo(dest)) return dest;
            // Cross-volume fallback: copy + delete.
            java.io.FileInputStream in = new java.io.FileInputStream(target);
            java.io.FileOutputStream out = new java.io.FileOutputStream(dest);
            try {
                byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                int n;
                while ((n = in.read(buf)) != -1) out.write(buf, 0, n);
                out.getFD().sync();
            } finally {
                try {
                    in.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    out.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (dest.exists() && dest.length() == target.length()
                    && target.delete()) {
                return dest;
            }
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            dest.delete();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Moves a trashed file back to its recorded location.
     *
     * <p>A4-09: returns the file that actually landed. The destination is
     * uniquified when it is taken, so the caller must persist the real path
     * — the old boolean gave no way to learn it and the library row kept
     * pointing at a name that no longer exists. Falls back to copy+delete
     * across volumes, mirroring {@link #moveToTrash(File, File)}.
     *
     * @return the restored file, or null when the move failed.
     */
    public static File restoreFromTrash(File trashFile, File dest) {
        if (trashFile == null || dest == null || !trashFile.exists()) {
            return null;
        }
        try {
            if (dest.exists()) {
                dest = uniqueIn(dest.getParentFile(), dest.getName());
            }
            if (trashFile.renameTo(dest)) return dest;
            File in = new File(trashFile.getAbsolutePath());
            File out = new File(dest.getAbsolutePath());
            java.io.FileInputStream fis = new java.io.FileInputStream(in);
            java.io.FileOutputStream fos = new java.io.FileOutputStream(out);
            try {
                byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                int n;
                while ((n = fis.read(buf)) != -1) fos.write(buf, 0, n);
                fos.getFD().sync();
            } finally {
                try {
                    fis.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    fos.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (out.exists() && out.length() == in.length() && in.delete()) {
                return out;
            }
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            out.delete();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return null;
    }

    /** Boolean form for callers that only care whether it came back. */
    public static boolean restoreFromTrashOk(File trashFile, File dest) {
        return restoreFromTrash(trashFile, dest) != null;
    }

    private static File uniqueIn(File dir, String name) {
        File c = new File(dir, name);
        if (!c.exists()) return c;
        String base = name;
        String ext = "";
        int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot > 0) {
            base = name.substring(0, dot);
            ext = name.substring(dot);
        }
        int i = 2;
        while (true) {
            File n = new File(dir, base + " (" + i + ")" + ext);
            if (!n.exists()) return n;
            i++;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Deletes trash files older than maxAgeMs (storage hygiene for
     * long-forgotten deletes).
     *
     * @return bytes reclaimed.
     */
    public static long pruneTrash(File trashDir, long maxAgeMs) {
        long freed = 0;
        if (trashDir == null) return 0;
        File[] files;
        try {
            files = trashDir.listFiles();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return 0;
        }
        if (files == null) return 0;
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        for (File f : files) {
            try {
                if (f.isFile() && now - f.lastModified() > maxAgeMs) {
                    freed += f.length();
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    f.delete();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return freed;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;

/**
 * Pro Multi-Effect Rack & Real-Time/Offline 48 kHz Float DSP Engine.
 *
 * <p>All 8 effects in {@link EffectType} are 100% active, parameter-driven,
 * and audibly distinct:
 * <ol>
 *   <li><b>Low-Cut Filter (40–160 Hz)</b>: Dynamic 2nd-order Butterworth HPF
 *       whose biquad coefficients recompute live from the user's Hz setting.</li>
 *   <li><b>Noise Suppression (0–100%)</b>: 3-band adaptive Wiener floor gate
 *       with instant first-block noise calibration and up to -24 dB cut.</li>
 *   <li><b>Expander / Room Gate (0–100%)</b>: Dedicated downward expander that
 *       attenuates room noise and breaths below threshold (-52..-18 dBFS).</li>
 *   <li><b>Warmth & Chest Body (0–100%)</b>: 180 Hz low-mid contour boost (up
 *       to +9 dB) for rich broadcast fullness.</li>
 *   <li><b>Vocal Presence & Air (0–100%)</b>: 3.5 kHz articulation & air shelf
 *       boost (up to +10 dB) for crisp intelligibility.</li>
 *   <li><b>De-Esser (4.5–9.5 kHz)</b>: Split-band relative sibilance suppressor
 *       (up to -14 dB cut on harsh 'S'/'T' transients).</li>
 *   <li><b>Compressor & Leveler (0–100%)</b>: Soft-knee vocal compressor (up to
 *       6:1 ratio) with automatic makeup gain.</li>
 *   <li><b>Brickwall Ceiling Limiter (0–100%)</b>: Dedicated gain drive (up to
 *       +12 dB) into a zero-overshoot -0.2 dBFS soft-clip ceiling.</li>
 * </ol>
 */
public final class DspChain {

    /** Session sample rate every legacy stage is tuned for. */
    public static final int SAMPLE_RATE = 48000;

    /** Catalog of available effects for the searchable "+ Add Effect" menu. */
    public enum EffectType {
        NOISE_SUPPRESSION("noise", "Noise Suppression",
                "3-band adaptive floor gate for hiss & background hum",
                "Intensity", 0, 100, 5, 50, "%"),
        DE_ESSER("deess", "De-Esser (4.5–9.5 kHz)",
                "Split-band sibilance control for harsh 'S' & 'T' sounds",
                "Reduction", 0, 100, 5, 45, "%"),
        COMPRESSOR("comp", "Compressor & Leveler",
                "Soft-knee vocal leveler with auto makeup gain",
                "Compression", 0, 100, 5, 40, "%"),
        LOW_CUT_HPF("hpf", "Low-Cut Rumble Filter",
                "2nd-order Butterworth high-pass filter for mic rumble & plosives",
                "Cutoff", 40, 160, 10, 80, " Hz"),
        VOCAL_PRESENCE("presence", "Vocal Presence & Air",
                "Clarity boost in the 3.5 kHz articulation band",
                "Boost", 0, 100, 5, 45, "%"),
        WARMTH_BODY("warmth", "Warmth & Chest Body",
                "Rich low-mid contour around 180 Hz for thin mics",
                "Warmth", 0, 100, 5, 40, "%"),
        ROOM_GATE("gate", "Expander / Room Gate",
                "Attenuates room echo and breaths between phrases",
                "Threshold", 0, 100, 5, 40, "%"),
        BRICKWALL_LIMITER("limiter", "Brickwall Ceiling Limiter",
                " Loudness drive + zero-overshoot ceiling to prevent peaking",
                "Drive", 0, 100, 5, 50, "%");

        public final String id;
        public final String title;
        public final String description;
        public final String paramLabel;
        public final int minVal;
        public final int maxVal;
        public final int stepVal;
        public final int defaultVal;
        public final String unit;

        EffectType(String id, String title, String description,
                   String paramLabel, int minVal, int maxVal, int stepVal,
                   int defaultVal, String unit) {
            this.id = id;
            this.title = title;
            this.description = description;
            this.paramLabel = paramLabel;
            this.minVal = minVal;
            this.maxVal = maxVal;
            this.stepVal = stepVal;
            this.defaultVal = defaultVal;
            this.unit = unit;
        }

        public static EffectType byId(String id) {
            for (EffectType t : values()) {
                if (t.id.equals(id)) return t;
            }
            return NOISE_SUPPRESSION;
        }
    }

    /** Premade templates of effects and their settings for the Presets dropdown. */
    public enum Preset {
        CUSTOM("custom", "Custom Rack"),
        VOICE_POLISH("voice_polish", "Voice Polish (Default Pro)"),
        PODCAST_BROADCAST("podcast", "Podcast Broadcast Master"),
        NOISY_ROOM("noisy_room", "Noisy Room Cleanup"),
        WARM_VOCAL("warm_vocal", "Warm Studio Vocal"),
        CRISP_CLARITY("crisp", "Crisp Articulation"),
        CLEAR_ALL("clear", "Flat / No Effects");

        public final String id;
        public final String title;

        Preset(String id, String title) {
            this.id = id;
            this.title = title;
        }
    }

    /** One effect pill in the user's scrollable FX rack. */
    public static final class EffectSlot {
        public final EffectType type;
        /** Checkmark state: only applied when enabled == true. */
        public boolean enabled;
        /** Current parameter setting (e.g. 0..100% or 40..160 Hz). */
        public int value;
        /** UI state: whether the collapsible settings drawer is expanded. */
        public boolean expanded;
        /** Per-slot wet/dry mix, 0..1 (1 = fully wet, the legacy default). */
        public float wetDry = 1f;
        /**
         * Secondary processor parameters persisted per slot, keyed by
         * {@link FxParameter#id} (Stage 3+ effects; the legacy stages have
         * only their primary knob, so this stays empty for them).
         */
        public final Map<String, Integer> extraParams = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        public EffectSlot(EffectType type, boolean enabled, int value, boolean expanded) {
            this.type = type;
            this.enabled = enabled;
            this.value = Math.max(type.minVal, Math.min(type.maxVal, value));
            this.expanded = expanded;
        }
    }

    /** Configuration holding both the Pro EffectSlot list and legacy fields. */
    public static final class Config {
        public static final int MODE_OFF = 0;
        public static final int MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION = 1;
        public static final int MODE_CUSTOM = 2;

        public int mode = MODE_OFF;
        public boolean hpfEnabled = false;
        public int hpfCutoffHz = 80;
        public int noisePct = 0;
        public int deEssPct = 0;
        public int compPct = 0;
        public int presencePct = 0;
        public int warmthPct = 0;
        public int gatePct = 0;
        public int limiterPct = 0;

        public boolean customHpf = true;
        public int customNoisePct = 35;
        public int customDeEssPct = 30;
        public int customCompPct = 30;

        public String activePresetId = Preset.VOICE_POLISH.id;
        public final List<EffectSlot> slots = new ArrayList<>();

        public Config() {
            syncSlotsFromLegacyFields();
        }

        public Config(boolean hpf, int noise, int deEss, int comp) {
            this.hpfEnabled = hpf;
            this.hpfCutoffHz = 80;
            this.noisePct = clamp(noise);
            this.deEssPct = clamp(deEss);
            this.compPct = clamp(comp);
            if (!isActive()) {
                this.mode = MODE_OFF;
            } else if (hpf && this.noisePct == 50
                    && this.deEssPct == 45 && this.compPct == 40) {
                this.mode = MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION;
            } else {
                this.mode = MODE_CUSTOM;
                this.customHpf = hpf;
                this.customNoisePct = this.noisePct;
                this.customDeEssPct = this.deEssPct;
                this.customCompPct = this.compPct;
            }
            syncSlotsFromLegacyFields();
        }

        /** Populates the rack with a premade template of effects and settings. */
        public void applyPreset(Preset preset) {
            slots.clear();
            activePresetId = preset.id;
            switch (preset) {
                case VOICE_POLISH:
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF, true, 80, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, true, 50, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.DE_ESSER, true, 45, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, true, 40, false));
                    break;
                case PODCAST_BROADCAST:
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF, true, 90, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, true, 45, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.ROOM_GATE, true, 40, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.WARMTH_BODY, true, 45, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE, true, 35, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.DE_ESSER, true, 50, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, true, 55, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER, true, 55, false));
                    break;
                case NOISY_ROOM:
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF, true, 110, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, true, 80, true));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.ROOM_GATE, true, 55, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.DE_ESSER, true, 40, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, true, 35, false));
                    break;
                case WARM_VOCAL:
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF, true, 70, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.WARMTH_BODY, true, 55, true));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE, true, 35, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.DE_ESSER, true, 40, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, true, 45, false));
                    break;
                case CRISP_CLARITY:
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF, true, 90, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, true, 35, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE, true, 65, true));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.DE_ESSER, true, 55, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, true, 45, false));
                    break;
                case CLEAR_ALL:
                    break;
                case CUSTOM:
                default:
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, true, customNoisePct, true));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.DE_ESSER, true, customDeEssPct, false));
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, true, customCompPct, false));
                    break;
            }
            syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        }

        public EffectSlot addOrFocusSlot(EffectType type) {
            for (EffectSlot s : slots) {
                if (s.type == type) {
                    s.enabled = true;
                    s.expanded = true;
                    activePresetId = Preset.CUSTOM.id;
                    syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
                    return s;
                }
            }
            EffectSlot created = new EffectSlot(type, true, type.defaultVal, true);
            slots.add(created);
            activePresetId = Preset.CUSTOM.id;
            syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
            return created;
        }

        public void removeSlot(EffectSlot slot) {
            slots.remove(slot);
            activePresetId = Preset.CUSTOM.id;
            syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        }

        public void syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots() {
            hpfEnabled = false;
            hpfCutoffHz = 80;
            noisePct = 0;
            deEssPct = 0;
            compPct = 0;
            presencePct = 0;
            warmthPct = 0;
            gatePct = 0;
            limiterPct = 0;
            for (EffectSlot s : slots) {
                if (!s.enabled) continue;
                switch (s.type) {
                    case LOW_CUT_HPF:
                        hpfEnabled = s.value > 0;
                        hpfCutoffHz = Math.max(40, Math.min(160, s.value));
                        break;
                    case NOISE_SUPPRESSION:
                        noisePct = clamp(s.value);
                        break;
                    case DE_ESSER:
                        deEssPct = clamp(s.value);
                        break;
                    case COMPRESSOR:
                        compPct = clamp(s.value);
                        break;
                    case VOCAL_PRESENCE:
                        presencePct = clamp(s.value);
                        break;
                    case WARMTH_BODY:
                        warmthPct = clamp(s.value);
                        break;
                    case ROOM_GATE:
                        gatePct = clamp(s.value);
                        break;
                    case BRICKWALL_LIMITER:
                        limiterPct = clamp(s.value);
                        break;
                }
            }
            if (!isActive()) {
                mode = MODE_OFF;
            } else if (hpfEnabled && hpfCutoffHz == 80
                    && noisePct == 50 && deEssPct == 45 && compPct == 40
                    && presencePct == 0 && warmthPct == 0 && gatePct == 0 && limiterPct == 0) {
                mode = MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION;
            } else {
                mode = MODE_CUSTOM;
            }
        }

        private void syncSlotsFromLegacyFields() {
            Map<EffectType, EffectSlot> existingByType =
                    new EnumMap<>(EffectType.class);
            List<EffectType> previousOrder = new ArrayList<>(slots.size());
            for (EffectSlot s : slots) {
                if (s != null && s.type != null
                        && !existingByType.containsKey(s.type)) {
                    existingByType.put(s.type, s);
                    previousOrder.add(s.type);
                }
            }
            Map<EffectType, Integer> activeValues =
                    new LinkedHashMap<>();
            if (hpfEnabled) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF,
                        Math.max(40, Math.min(160, hpfCutoffHz)));
            }
            if (noisePct > 0) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, noisePct);
            }
            if (gatePct > 0) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.ROOM_GATE, gatePct);
            }
            if (warmthPct > 0) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.WARMTH_BODY, warmthPct);
            }
            if (presencePct > 0) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE, presencePct);
            }
            if (deEssPct > 0) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.DE_ESSER, deEssPct);
            }
            if (compPct > 0) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, compPct);
            }
            if (limiterPct > 0) {
                activeValues.put(EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER, limiterPct);
            }

            slots.clear();
            // Preserve user's relative ordering and per-slot wetDry/extraParams
            // for any slots that were already present in the rack.
            for (EffectType t : previousOrder) {
                Integer val = activeValues.remove(t);
                if (val != null) {
                    EffectSlot kept = existingByType.get(t);
                    kept.enabled = true;
                    kept.value = Math.max(t.minVal, Math.min(t.maxVal, val));
                    slots.add(kept);
                }
            }
            // Append any newly enabled legacy stages in canonical stage order.
            for (Map.Entry<EffectType, Integer> e : activeValues.entrySet()) {
                EffectType t = e.getKey();
                int val = e.getValue();
                EffectSlot kept = existingByType.get(t);
                if (kept != null) {
                    kept.enabled = true;
                    kept.value = Math.max(t.minVal, Math.min(t.maxVal, val));
                    slots.add(kept);
                } else {
                    slots.add(new EffectSlot(t, true, val, false));
                }
            }
        }

        public void applyMode(int targetMode) {
            if (targetMode == MODE_OFF) {
                this.mode = MODE_OFF;
                this.hpfEnabled = false;
                this.noisePct = 0;
                this.deEssPct = 0;
                this.compPct = 0;
                this.presencePct = 0;
                this.warmthPct = 0;
                this.gatePct = 0;
                this.limiterPct = 0;
                for (EffectSlot s : slots) s.enabled = false;
            } else if (targetMode == MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION) {
                this.mode = MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION;
                this.hpfEnabled = true;
                this.hpfCutoffHz = 80;
                this.noisePct = 50;
                this.deEssPct = 45;
                this.compPct = 40;
                this.presencePct = 0;
                this.warmthPct = 0;
                this.gatePct = 0;
                this.limiterPct = 0;
                syncSlotsFromLegacyFields();
            } else {
                this.mode = MODE_CUSTOM;
                if (!customHpf && customNoisePct <= 0
                        && customDeEssPct <= 0 && customCompPct <= 0) {
                    customHpf = true;
                    customNoisePct = 35;
                    customDeEssPct = 30;
                    customCompPct = 30;
                }
                this.hpfEnabled = customHpf;
                this.noisePct = clamp(customNoisePct);
                this.deEssPct = clamp(customDeEssPct);
                this.compPct = clamp(customCompPct);
                syncSlotsFromLegacyFields();
            }
        }

        public void onManualAdjustment() {
            onManualAdjustment(hpfEnabled, noisePct, deEssPct, compPct);
        }

        public void onManualAdjustment(boolean hpf, int noise, int deEss, int comp) {
            this.hpfEnabled = hpf;
            this.noisePct = clamp(noise);
            this.deEssPct = clamp(deEss);
            this.compPct = clamp(comp);
            if (!isActive()) {
                this.mode = MODE_OFF;
            } else {
                this.mode = MODE_CUSTOM;
                this.customHpf = this.hpfEnabled;
                this.customNoisePct = this.noisePct;
                this.customDeEssPct = this.deEssPct;
                this.customCompPct = this.compPct;
            }
            syncSlotsFromLegacyFields();
        }

        public boolean isActive() {
            return hpfEnabled || noisePct > 0 || deEssPct > 0 || compPct > 0
                    || presencePct > 0 || warmthPct > 0 || gatePct > 0 || limiterPct > 0;
        }

        public int enabledSlotCount() {
            int n = 0;
            for (EffectSlot s : slots) {
                if (s.enabled && s.value > 0) n++;
            }
            return n;
        }

        public String badgeSummary() {
            if (!isActive() || mode == MODE_OFF) return "FX Off";
            if (mode == MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION
                    || (hpfEnabled && hpfCutoffHz == 80
                    && noisePct == 50 && deEssPct == 45 && compPct == 40
                    && presencePct == 0 && warmthPct == 0 && gatePct == 0 && limiterPct == 0)) {
                return "FX • Polish";
            }
            return "FX • Custom";
        }

        public static Config voicePolish() {
            Config c = new Config(true, 50, 45, 40);
            c.mode = MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION;
            return c;
        }

        public static Config load(Context ctx) {
            Config c = new Config();
            if (ctx == null) return c;
            try {
                SharedPreferences p = ctx.getSharedPreferences("takeone",
                        Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
                c.hpfEnabled = p.getBoolean("dsp_hpf", false);
                c.hpfCutoffHz = Math.max(40, Math.min(160, p.getInt("dsp_hpf_hz", 80)));
                c.noisePct = clamp(p.getInt("dsp_noise", 0));
                c.deEssPct = clamp(p.getInt("dsp_deess", 0));
                c.compPct = clamp(p.getInt("dsp_comp", 0));
                c.customHpf = p.getBoolean("dsp_custom_hpf", true);
                c.customNoisePct = clamp(p.getInt("dsp_custom_noise", 35));
                c.customDeEssPct = clamp(p.getInt("dsp_custom_deess", 30));
                c.customCompPct = clamp(p.getInt("dsp_custom_comp", 30));
                c.activePresetId = p.getString("dsp_preset_id", Preset.VOICE_POLISH.id);

                String slotsJson = p.getString("dsp_slots_json", null);
                if (slotsJson != null && !slotsJson.isEmpty()) {
                    c.slots.clear();
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(slotsJson);
                    for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject o = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                        EffectType t = EffectType.byId(o.optString("id", "noise"));
                        boolean en = o.optBoolean("en", true);
                        int val = o.optInt("val", t.defaultVal);
                        boolean exp = o.optBoolean("exp", false);
                        EffectSlot slot = new EffectSlot(t, en, val, exp);
                        slot.wetDry = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f,
                                (float) o.optDouble("mix", 1.0)));
                        JSONObject pj = o.optJSONObject("params");
                        if (pj != null) {
                            java.util.Iterator<String> keys = pj.keys();
                            while (keys.hasNext()) {
                                String k = keys.next();
                                slot.extraParams.put(k, pj.optInt(k));
                            }
                        }
                        c.slots.add(slot);
                    }
                    c.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
                } else {
                    c.syncSlotsFromLegacyFields();
                    if (c.slots.isEmpty()) {
                        // Seed default starter pills for the UI rack
                        c.slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION, false, 50, false));
                        c.slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.DE_ESSER, false, 45, false));
                        c.slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.COMPRESSOR, false, 40, false));
                        c.slots.add(new EffectSlot(EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF, false, 80, false));
                    }
                }
                int savedMode = p.getInt("dsp_mode", -1);
                if (savedMode >= MODE_OFF && savedMode <= MODE_CUSTOM) {
                    c.mode = savedMode;
                    if (!c.isActive()) c.mode = MODE_OFF;
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            return c;
        }

        public void save(Context ctx) {
            if (ctx == null) return;
            try {
                JSONArray arr = new JSONArray();
                for (EffectSlot s : slots) {
                    JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
                    o.put("id", s.type.id);
                    o.put("en", s.enabled);
                    o.put("val", s.value);
                    o.put("exp", s.expanded);
                    o.put("mix", (double) s.wetDry);
                    if (!s.extraParams.isEmpty()) {
                        JSONObject p = new JSONObject();
                        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e
                                : s.extraParams.entrySet()) {
                            p.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
                        }
                        o.put("params", p);
                    }
                    arr.put(o);
                }
                ctx.getSharedPreferences("takeone", Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit()
                        .putInt("dsp_mode", mode)
                        .putBoolean("dsp_hpf", hpfEnabled)
                        .putInt("dsp_hpf_hz", hpfCutoffHz)
                        .putInt("dsp_noise", clamp(noisePct))
                        .putInt("dsp_deess", clamp(deEssPct))
                        .putInt("dsp_comp", clamp(compPct))
                        .putBoolean("dsp_custom_hpf", customHpf)
                        .putInt("dsp_custom_noise", clamp(customNoisePct))
                        .putInt("dsp_custom_deess", clamp(customDeEssPct))
                        .putInt("dsp_custom_comp", clamp(customCompPct))
                        .putString("dsp_preset_id", activePresetId)
                        .putString("dsp_slots_json", arr.toString())
                        .apply();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }

        private static int clamp(int v) {
            return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v));
        }
    }

    private final int channels;
    private final FxRackChain rack;

    public DspChain(int channels, Config cfg) {
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        this.rack = FxRackChain.fromLegacyConfig(this.channels, cfg);
        applySlotExtras(cfg);
    }

    /**
     * The modular processor rack backing this chain (Stage 2 architecture).
     * The legacy engine's eight stages are now {@link AudioProcessor}s in an
     * ordered rack; this chain is a backwards-compatible facade.
     */
    public FxRackChain getRack() {
        return rack;
    }

    public void updateConfig(Config cfg) {
        resetProcessorSlotExtras();
        rack.applyLegacyConfig(cfg);
        applySlotExtras(cfg);
    }

    /**
     * Resets per-slot wet/dry mixes and secondary parameters on all rack
     * processors before applying the active {@link Config} so removed or
     * reset slots never leave stale state behind.
     */
    private void resetProcessorSlotExtras() {
        for (AudioProcessor p : rack.processors()) {
            p.setWetDryMix(1.0f);
            for (FxParameter fp : p.getParameters()) {
                if (!isPrimaryLegacyParam(fp.id)) {
                    fp.resetToDefault();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean isPrimaryLegacyParam(String paramId) {
        return "amt".equals(paramId)
                || "cutoff".equals(paramId)
                || "drive".equals(paramId)
                || "warmth".equals(paramId)
                || "presence".equals(paramId);
    }

    /**
     * Pushes per-slot wet/dry mixes and any persisted secondary parameters
     * into the rack. The combined warmth+presence stage is one processor fed
     * by two slots, so it has no slot-level mix and stays fully wet.
     */
    private void applySlotExtras(Config cfg) {
        if (cfg == null) return;
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            AudioProcessor p = processorForSlot(s.type);
            if (p == null) continue;
            // When the Brickwall Limiter slot is unchecked, it may still run
            // as the automatic safety ceiling for upstream gain stages; keep
            // its mix at 100% when disabled so an unchecked slot's mix never
            // weakens safety limiting.
            if (s.type != EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER || s.enabled) {
                p.setWetDryMix(s.wetDry);
            }
            for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : s.extraParams.entrySet()) {
                if (isPrimaryLegacyParam(e.getKey())) continue;
                FxParameter fp = p.getParam(e.getKey());
                if (fp != null) fp.setCurrentRaw(e.getValue());
            }
        }
    }

    private AudioProcessor processorForSlot(EffectType type) {
        switch (type) {
            case LOW_CUT_HPF:
                return rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("hpf"));
            case NOISE_SUPPRESSION:
                return rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("noise"));
            case ROOM_GATE:
                return rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("gate"));
            case DE_ESSER:
                return rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("deess"));
            case COMPRESSOR:
                return rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("comp"));
            case BRICKWALL_LIMITER:
                return rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("limiter"));
            case WARMTH_BODY:
            case VOCAL_PRESENCE:
            default:
                // Combined tone stage (or unknown type): no slot-level mix.
                return null;
        }
    }

    public boolean isActive() {
        return rack.isActive();
    }

    public void reset() {
        rack.reset();
    }

    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames) {
        rack.processInPlace(buf, frames);
    }

    public static float fastLinToDb(float x) {
        if (x <= 1e-7f) return -140.0f;
        int bits = Float.floatToRawIntBits(x);
        int exp = ((bits >>> 23) & 0xFF) - 127;
        float m = Float.intBitsToFloat((bits & 0x007FFFFF) | 0x3F800000);
        float log2m = -0.34484843f * m * m + 2.02466578f * m - 1.67487759f;
        return (exp + log2m) * 6.0205999f;
    }

    public static float fastDbToLin(float db) {
        if (db <= -140.0f) return 0.0f;
        if (db > 36.0f) db = 36.0f;
        float p = db * 0.16609640f;
        int exp = (int) Math.floor(p);
        float f = p - exp;
        float mant = 0.33971f * f * f + 0.66029f * f + 1.0f;
        int bits = Float.floatToRawIntBits(mant);
        bits += (exp << 23);
        return Float.intBitsToFloat(bits);
    }
}
