package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator;
import android.view.animation.OvershootInterpolator;
import android.widget.ImageView;

import androidx.activity.OnBackPressedCallback;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate;
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

public class MainActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private View fabWrap;
    private View fabHalo;
    private ImageView fabIcon;
    private View fabStopWrap;
    private boolean inStudio = false;
    private int fabIconRes = R.drawable.ic_mic;
    private boolean recoveryChecked;
    private long lastFabPress;
    private long lastStopPress;
    private OnBackPressedCallback backCallback;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        CrashLog.install(this);
        AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode(AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES);
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main);

        fabWrap = findViewById(R.id.fabWrap);
        fabHalo = findViewById(R.id.fabHalo);
        fabIcon = findViewById(R.id.fabIcon);
        fabStopWrap = findViewById(R.id.fabStopWrap);

        // Smooth press animation: shrink on touch-down, spring back on release.
        fabWrap.setOnTouchListener((v, event) -> {
            if (event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
                v.animate().scaleX(0.9f).scaleY(0.9f).setDuration(120).start();
            } else if (event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP
                    || event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL) {
                v.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(160).start();
            }
            return false;
        });
        fabWrap.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            // Debounced: one tap, one transition. Guards against double
            // delivery that used to start-then-instantly-pause takes.
            long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            if (now - lastFabPress < 400) return;
            lastFabPress = now;
            if (!inStudio) {
                pulseHalo();
                openStudio();
            } else {
                StudioFragment st = studio();
                if (st != null) st.onFabPressed();
            }
        });
        PressAnim.apply(fabStopWrap);
        fabStopWrap.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            if (now - lastStopPress < 400) return;
            lastStopPress = now;
            StudioFragment st = studio();
            if (st != null) st.onStopPressed();
        });

        getOnBackPressedDispatcher().addCallback(this, backCallback =
                new OnBackPressedCallback(true) {
            @Override
            public void handleOnBackPressed() {
                if (inStudio) {
                    StudioFragment st = studio();
                    if (st != null) {
                        st.onBackPressed();
                    } else {
                        exitStudio();
                    }
                } else {
                    Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("LIB");
                    boolean consumed = f instanceof LibraryFragment
                            && ((LibraryFragment) f).onBackPressed();
                    if (!consumed) {
                        finish();
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        if (savedInstanceState != null) {
            inStudio = savedInstanceState.getBoolean("inStudio", false);
            recoveryChecked = savedInstanceState.getBoolean("recoveryChecked", false);
        } else {
            getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                    .replace(R.id.container, new LibraryFragment(), "LIB")
                    .commitAllowingStateLoss();
        }

        handleOpenStudioIntent(getIntent());
        // Library loads async (Room + disk reconcile). Recovery + first paint
        // wait for it so prompts see adopted orphans and pruned rows.
        TakesRepository.init(this);
        TakesRepository.onReady(() -> {
            if (!recoveryChecked) {
                recoveryChecked = true;
                fabWrap.post(this::checkUnfinishedTakes);
            } else {
                fabWrap.post(this::refreshLibraryIfShown);
            }
            maybeAnnounceRecovered();
            maybeHealCrashedEncoder();
            maybeShowCrashReport();
        });
        syncFabWithEngine();
    }

    /**
     * Self-healing after an encoder kills a save: the breadcrumbs name the
     * exact format that never finished. Step one rung down the reliability
     * ladder (exotic -> AAC -> pure-Java WAV) so the next recording can
     * actually save on this device.
     */
    private void maybeHealCrashedEncoder() {
        String stage;
        try {
            stage = CrashLog.unterminatedStage(this);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return;
        }
        if (stage == null || !stage.startsWith("convert ") || inStudio) return;
        String crashedId = stage.substring("convert ".length()).trim();
        SaveFormat crashed = SaveFormat.of(crashedId);
        SaveFormat current = SaveFormat.load(this);
        SaveFormat currentEff = current.effective(RecordPreset.load(this));
        // Only act while the user still has the killer selected: a manual
        // switch since the crash is respected, not overridden.
        if (currentEff != crashed) return;
        SaveFormat fallback = crashed.fallbackAfterCrash();
        if (fallback == null) return;
        try {
            fallback.save(this);
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this,
                    "auto-switch " + crashed.id + "->" + fallback.id);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        // A Java crash file already tells the story (breadcrumbs included):
        // don't stack a second dialog on top of its share prompt.
        boolean crashFile;
        try {
            crashFile = CrashLog.recentCrash(this) != null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            crashFile = false;
        }
        if (crashFile) return;
        final String from = crashed.badge;
        final String to = fallback.badge;
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showResult(this, false,
                        getString(R.string.convert_crash_title),
                        getString(R.string.convert_crash_msg, from, to),
                        () -> { });
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    /** One surfacing of the previous run's crash log, with share + dismiss. */
    private void maybeShowCrashReport() {
        File crash = CrashLog.recentCrash(this);
        if (crash == null || inStudio) return;
        // Stale reports auto-expire: only a fresh crash nags, and sharing
        // clears it. Cancelling keeps it for the next launch (bounded by
        // the same freshness window).
        if (System.currentTimeMillis() - crash.lastModified()
                > 7L * 24 * 3600_000L) {
            CrashLog.clearCrash(this);
            return;
        }
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showConfirm(this,
                        getString(R.string.crash_title),
                        getString(R.string.crash_msg),
                        getString(R.string.crash_share),
                        R.drawable.ic_close, false,
                        () -> {
                            CrashLog.share(this, crash);
                            CrashLog.clearCrash(this);
                        });
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    /** One summary popup when the startup sweep adopted orphaned files. */
    private void maybeAnnounceRecovered() {
        TakesRepository.ReconcileResult rr = TakesRepository.lastReconcile();
        if (rr == null || rr.adopted <= 0 || inStudio) return;
        // Posted: dialogs need a resumed activity, and onReady can fire
        // synchronously inside onCreate after a rotation.
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showResult(this, true,
                        getString(R.string.recovered_title),
                        getString(R.string.recovered_msg, rr.adopted));
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    private void refreshLibraryIfShown() {
        try {
            Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("LIB");
            if (f instanceof LibraryFragment && f.isVisible()) {
                ((LibraryFragment) f).refreshExternal();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    @Override
    protected void onNewIntent(Intent intent) {
        super.onNewIntent(intent);
        setIntent(intent);
        handleOpenStudioIntent(intent);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (backCallback != null) backCallback.setEnabled(true);
        syncFabWithEngine();
        for (ConversionJob j : ConversionJobs.active()) {
            if (ConversionJob.QUEUED.equals(j.state)) {
                ConversionService.startJob(this, j.jobId);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSaveInstanceState(Bundle outState) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState);
        outState.putBoolean("inStudio", inStudio);
        outState.putBoolean("recoveryChecked", recoveryChecked);
    }

    private void handleOpenStudioIntent(Intent intent) {
        if (intent == null) return;
        boolean open = intent.getBooleanExtra("open_studio", false)
                || "com.example.hello.OPEN_STUDIO".equals(intent.getAction());
        if (open && RecordingEngine.get().hasSession() && !inStudio) {
            openStudio();
        }
        try {
            intent.removeExtra("open_studio");
            intent.setAction(null);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    public void openStudio() {
        inStudio = true;
        syncFabWithEngine();
        getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                .setCustomAnimations(R.anim.slide_in_right, R.anim.fade_out,
                        R.anim.fade_in, R.anim.slide_out_right)
                .replace(R.id.container, new StudioFragment(), "STU")
                .commitAllowingStateLoss();
    }

    public void openStudioWithRecovery(File rawFile) {
        // Crash recovery reopens directly in the recording state.
        openStudioWithSession(rawFile.getAbsolutePath(), true, -1, null);
    }

    /** Edit punch-in: session pre-loaded, timer correct, waits for mic tap. */
    public void openStudioWithEdit(File rawFile, long sourceId, String sourceTitle) {
        openStudioWithSession(rawFile.getAbsolutePath(), false, sourceId, sourceTitle);
    }

    private void openStudioWithSession(String rawPath, boolean autostart,
                                       long editSourceId, String editSourceTitle) {
        inStudio = true;
        syncFabWithEngine();
        StudioFragment f = new StudioFragment();
        Bundle b = new Bundle();
        b.putString("recover_raw", rawPath);
        b.putBoolean("autostart", autostart);
        if (editSourceId != -1) {
            b.putLong("edit_source_id", editSourceId);
            b.putString("edit_source_title", editSourceTitle);
        }
        f.setArguments(b);
        getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                .setCustomAnimations(R.anim.slide_in_right, R.anim.fade_out,
                        R.anim.fade_in, R.anim.slide_out_right)
                .replace(R.id.container, f, "STU")
                .commitAllowingStateLoss();
    }

    public void exitStudio() {
        inStudio = false;
        syncFabWithEngine();
        getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                .setCustomAnimations(R.anim.fade_in, R.anim.slide_out_right,
                        R.anim.slide_in_right, R.anim.fade_out)
                .replace(R.id.container, new LibraryFragment(), "LIB")
                .commitAllowingStateLoss();
    }

    // ---- split record controls ----

    /**
     * Main FAB artwork morph (mic / pause / play) with a smooth shrink-swap-pop.
     * Scale-only: the old rotation accumulated 70° on every tap, visibly
     * twisting the icon over time. The split stop button is shown separately
     * while a take is active.
     */
    public void morphFabIcon(int resId) {
        if (fabIconRes == resId) return;
        fabIconRes = resId;
        fabIcon.animate().cancel();
        // Snap rotation back first so repeated morphs can never accumulate.
        fabIcon.setRotation(0f);
        fabIcon.animate()
                .scaleX(0.35f).scaleY(0.35f)
                .setDuration(110)
                .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                .withEndAction(() -> {
                    try {
                        fabIcon.setImageResource(resId);
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    fabIcon.setRotation(0f);
                    fabIcon.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .setDuration(230)
                            .setInterpolator(new OvershootInterpolator(2f))
                            .start();
                })
                .start();
    }

    /** Show/hide the split stop button with a pop. */
    public void setStopVisible(boolean visible) {
        if (visible && fabStopWrap.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) {
            fabStopWrap.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            PressAnim.pop(fabStopWrap);
        } else if (!visible && fabStopWrap.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) {
            fabStopWrap.animate().cancel();
            fabStopWrap.animate()
                    .scaleX(0.4f).scaleY(0.4f)
                    .alpha(0f)
                    .setDuration(150)
                    .withEndAction(() -> {
                        fabStopWrap.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        fabStopWrap.setScaleX(1f);
                        fabStopWrap.setScaleY(1f);
                        fabStopWrap.setAlpha(1f);
                    })
                    .start();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Drive both FABs from the engine state. Called on studio transitions and
     * on resume so a background recording re-attaches its controls.
     */
    public void syncFabWithEngine() {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        boolean active = inStudio && e.hasSession()
                && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED);
        boolean paused = e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED;
        if (active) {
            morphFabIcon(paused ? R.drawable.ic_play : R.drawable.ic_pause);
            setStopVisible(true);
            fabWrap.setContentDescription(
                    getString(paused ? R.string.action_resume : R.string.action_pause));
        } else {
            morphFabIcon(inStudio ? R.drawable.ic_mic : R.drawable.ic_mic);
            setStopVisible(false);
            fabWrap.setContentDescription(getString(R.string.cd_mic));
        }
    }

    /** Legacy hook: true once meant square-stop artwork; now drives split UI. */
    public void setFabStop(boolean stop) {
        syncFabWithEngine();
    }

    // ---- unfinished-take recovery (every app start) ----

    private void checkUnfinishedTakes() {
        // Never interrupt an attached studio session with its own UI.
        if (inStudio) return;
        // If the engine already holds a session (background recording), the
        // notification owns it — just offer to reopen the studio.
        if (RecordingEngine.get().hasSession()) {
            return;
        }
        List<RecordingEngine.Unfinished> found;
        try {
            found = RecordingEngine.scanUnfinished(this);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return;
        }
        if (found == null || found.isEmpty()) return;
        promptRecovery(0, found);
    }

    private void promptRecovery(int index, List<RecordingEngine.Unfinished> all) {
        if (index >= all.size()) return;
        RecordingEngine.Unfinished u = all.get(index);
        String dur = String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:%02d",
                (u.durationMs / 60000), (u.durationMs / 1000) % 60);
        java.util.List<OptionsSheet.Item> items = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_play,
                getString(R.string.action_continue), () -> {
                    try {
                        RecordingEngine.get().attachExisting(
                                getApplicationContext(),
                                u.rawFile, u.name, u.channels,
                                RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(u.rawFile));
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        OptionsSheet.showResult(this, false,
                                getString(R.string.convert_failed_title),
                                getString(R.string.couldnt_export));
                        promptRecovery(index + 1, all);
                        return;
                    }
                    openStudioWithRecovery(u.rawFile);
                }));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.danger(R.drawable.ic_trash,
                getString(R.string.action_discard), () -> {
                    boolean ok = RecordingEngine.deleteUnfinished(u.rawFile);
                    OptionsSheet.showResult(this, ok,
                            ok ? getString(R.string.delete_success_title)
                                    : getString(R.string.delete_failed_title),
                            ok ? getString(R.string.delete_success_one, u.name)
                                    : getString(R.string.delete_failed_msg),
                            () -> promptRecovery(index + 1, all));
                }));
        try {
            OptionsSheet.showOptions(this,
                    getString(R.string.unfinished_title),
                    getString(R.string.unfinished_msg, u.name, dur),
                    items);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private StudioFragment studio() {
        Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("STU");
        return (f instanceof StudioFragment && f.isVisible()) ? (StudioFragment) f : null;
    }

    private void pulseHalo() {
        fabHalo.animate().scaleX(1.22f).scaleY(1.22f).setDuration(150)
                .withEndAction(() -> fabHalo.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                        .setDuration(220).start())
                .start();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.media.AudioManager;
import android.media.MicrophoneInfo;
import android.os.Build;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * Capability check for true stereo capture. Counts physical microphones via
 * {@link AudioManager#getMicrophones()} (API 28+) so a stereo preset can
 * fall back to mono — with a warning — instead of recording dual-mono or
 * silence on single-mic hardware.
 */
public final class MicSupport {

    private MicSupport() {}

    /**
     * @return number of physical microphones, or -1 when the platform cannot
     * tell (below API 28 or query failed). Callers treat -1 as "try stereo,
     * fall back silently if the hardware refuses".
     */
    public static int physicalMicCount(AudioManager am) {
        if (am == null || Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 28) return -1;
        try {
            List<MicrophoneInfo> mics = am.getMicrophones();
            if (mics == null) return -1;
            return mics.size();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    public static boolean stereoLikely(AudioManager am) {
        int n = physicalMicCount(am);
        return n < 0 || n >= 2;
    }

    /** True only when we positively know dual mics are absent. */
    public static boolean dualAbsent(AudioManager am) {
        return physicalMicCount(am) == 1;
    }
}

 * bottom sheets. Sort options appear as distinct pills, rename is a centered

    public static final class Item {

        public final String label;
        public final String sub;

        public Item(int icon, String label, boolean destructive, boolean checked,
                    Runnable action) {

            this.sub = sub;

    public static void showOptions(Context ctx, String title, String subtitle,
                                   List<Item> items) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_options, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        TextView titleView = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle);
        titleView.setText(title);
        TextView subView = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogSubtitle);
        if (subtitle != null && !subtitle.isEmpty()) {

            subView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }

        LinearLayout container = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogOptions);
        LayoutInflater inflater = LayoutInflater.from(ctx);
        for (int i = 0; i < items.size(); i++) {
            final Item item = items.get(i);
            View pillWrap = new FrameLayout(ctx);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams wrapLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            if (i > 0) wrapLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 8);
            pillWrap.setLayoutParams(wrapLp);

            View row = inflater.inflate(R.layout.dialog_pill_row, (FrameLayout) pillWrap, false);
            row.setBackgroundResource(item.checked
                    ? R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected
                    : R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
            TextView label = row.findViewById(R.id.pillLabel);
            label.setText(item.label);
            if (item.destructive) {
                label.setTextColor(0xFFFF3B30);
            } else if (item.checked) {
                label.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            }
            TextView sub = row.findViewById(R.id.pillSub);
            if (sub != null) {
                if (item.sub != null && !item.sub.isEmpty()) {
                    sub.setText(item.sub);
                    sub.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                } else {
                    sub.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                }
            }
            ImageView iconView = row.findViewById(R.id.pillDot);
            if (item.icon != 0) {
                iconView.setImageResource(item.icon);
                iconView.setAlpha(item.checked ? 1f : 0.8f);
                iconView.setColorFilter(item.destructive
                        ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFFF2F4F7);
                iconView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            } else {
                iconView.setImageResource(R.drawable.bg_thumb);
                iconView.setColorFilter(item.checked ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFF5D6672);
                int inset = dp(ctx, 5);
                iconView.setPadding(inset, inset, inset, inset);
                iconView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            }
            ImageView check = row.findViewById(R.id.pillCheck);
            check.setVisibility(item.checked ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);

            PressAnim.apply(row);
            row.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                v.animate().scaleX(0.96f).scaleY(0.96f).setDuration(70).withEndAction(() -> {
                    dialog.dismiss();
                    if (item.action != null) item.action.run();
                }).start();
            });
            ((FrameLayout) pillWrap).addView(row);
            container.addView(pillWrap);

            // Staggered entrance: each pill slides up + fades in.
            row.setAlpha(0f);
            row.setTranslationY(dp(ctx, 14));
            row.animate()
                    .alpha(1f).translationY(0f)
                    .setStartDelay(60 + i * 55L)
                    .setDuration(260)
                    .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                    .start();
        }

        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());

        styleAsCentered(dialog);

    }

        presetPane.addView(sectionLabel(ctx, presetLabel, isLand ? 2 : 6));
        if (presetHint != null && !presetHint.isEmpty()) {
            TextView hint = new TextView(ctx);
            hint.setText(presetHint);
            hint.setTextSize(10.5f);
            hint.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams hlp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            hlp.bottomMargin = dp(ctx, 2);
            presetPane.addView(hint, hlp);
        }

        LayoutInflater inflater = LayoutInflater.from(ctx);
        java.util.List<View> pillRows = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.List<TextView> pillLabels = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.List<ImageView> pillChecks = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.List<Integer> pillDefaultColors = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final java.util.List<View> chipViews = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final java.util.List<TextView> chipNames = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final java.util.List<TextView> chipSizes = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final TextView formatHintView = new TextView(ctx);
        formatHintView.setTextSize(10.5f);
        formatHintView.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
        for (Item item : state.presets()) {
            final Item it = item;
            View row = inflater.inflate(R.layout.dialog_pill_row, presetPane, false);
            row.setMinimumHeight(dp(ctx, isLand ? 44 : 50));
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams rlp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            rlp.topMargin = dp(ctx, isLand ? 5 : 6);
            presetPane.addView(row, rlp);
            TextView label = row.findViewById(R.id.pillLabel);
            label.setText(it.label);
            if (isLand) label.setTextSize(13);
            TextView sub = row.findViewById(R.id.pillSub);
            if (sub != null) {
                if (it.sub != null && !it.sub.isEmpty()) {
                    sub.setText(it.sub);
                    if (isLand) sub.setTextSize(10.5f);
                    sub.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                } else {
                    sub.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                }
            }
            ImageView dot = row.findViewById(R.id.pillDot);
            dot.setImageResource(R.drawable.bg_thumb);
            int inset = dp(ctx, 5);
            dot.setPadding(inset, inset, inset, inset);
            dot.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            ImageView check = row.findViewById(R.id.pillCheck);
            pillRows.add(row);
            pillLabels.add(label);
            pillChecks.add(check);
            pillDefaultColors.add(label.getTextColors().getDefaultColor());
            PressAnim.apply(row);
            row.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (it.action != null) it.action.run();
                rebindSettings(state, pillRows, pillLabels, pillChecks,
                        pillDefaultColors, chipViews, chipNames, chipSizes,
                        formatHintView);
            });
        }

        // Populate Right / Bottom Half: Save Formats
        formatPane.addView(sectionLabel(ctx, formatLabel, isLand ? 2 : 8));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams flp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        flp.bottomMargin = dp(ctx, 4);
        formatPane.addView(formatHintView, flp);

        android.widget.GridLayout grid = new android.widget.GridLayout(ctx);
        grid.setColumnCount(3);
        grid.setUseDefaultMargins(false);
        formatPane.addView(grid, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        for (Chip chip : state.formats()) {
            final Chip c = chip;
            LinearLayout cell = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            cell.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            cell.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            cell.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_chip);
            int hPad = dp(ctx, 5);
            int vPadCell = dp(ctx, isLand ? 6 : 7);
            cell.setPadding(hPad, vPadCell, hPad, vPadCell);
            cell.setMinimumHeight(dp(ctx, isLand ? 40 : 44));

            name.setText(c.label);
            name.setTextSize(isLand ? 11 : 12);
            name.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
            name.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            name.setSingleLine(true);

            size.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);

            chipSizes.add(size);

            });

        done.setText(doneLabel);
        done.setTextSize(14);
        done.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
        done.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
        done.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);

        dialog.setContentView(scroll);

                pillDefaultColors, chipViews, chipNames, chipSizes,

        styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(dialog,
                isLand ? MAX_SETTINGS_LAND_WIDTH_DP : MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP);

    }

    private static TextView sectionLabel(Context ctx, String text, int topMarginDp) {

        tv.setText(text);
        tv.setTextSize(10);
        tv.setLetterSpacing(0.1f);
        tv.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);

                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);

    }

    private static void rebindSettings(SettingsState state,
                                       java.util.List<View> pillRows,
                                       java.util.List<TextView> pillLabels,
                                       java.util.List<ImageView> pillChecks,
                                       java.util.List<Integer> pillColors,
                                       java.util.List<View> chipViews,
                                       java.util.List<TextView> chipNames,
                                       java.util.List<TextView> chipSizes,
                                       TextView hintView) {
        java.util.List<Item> presets;
        java.util.List<Chip> formats;
        try {
            presets = state.presets();
            formats = state.formats();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < pillRows.size() && i < presets.size(); i++) {
            Item it = presets.get(i);
            pillRows.get(i).setBackgroundResource(it.checked
                    ? R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected
                    : R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
            pillLabels.get(i).setTextColor(it.checked
                    ? 0xFFF2F4F7 : pillColors.get(i));
            pillChecks.get(i).setVisibility(
                    it.checked ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
            ImageView dot = pillRows.get(i).findViewById(R.id.pillDot);
            if (dot != null) dot.setColorFilter(
                    it.checked ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFF5D6672);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < chipViews.size() && i < formats.size(); i++) {
            Chip c = formats.get(i);
            chipViews.get(i).setBackgroundResource(c.checked
                    ? R.drawable.bg_chip_selected
                    : R.drawable.bg_chip);
            int col = c.checked ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF9AA3AF;
            chipNames.get(i).setTextColor(col);
            chipSizes.get(i).setTextColor(col);
            chipSizes.get(i).setText(c.size);
            chipNames.get(i).setText(c.label);
        }
        try {
            hintView.setText(state.formatHint());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- centered rename / input modal ----

    public static void showInput(Context ctx, String title, String initial,
                                 String saveLabel, SaveCallback callback) {
        showInputInternal(ctx, title, initial, saveLabel, callback, null, false);
    }

    private static void showInputInternal(Context ctx, String title, String initial,
                                          String saveLabel, SaveCallback callback,
                                          Runnable onCancel, boolean allowSame) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_input, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle)).setText(title);
        EditText input = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogInput);
        TextView error = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogError);
        input.setText(initial == null ? "" : initial);
        input.setHint(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_hint));
        try {
            input.setSelection(input.getText().length());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        TextView save = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogSave);
        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        save.setText(saveLabel);
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        PressAnim.apply(save);

        final boolean[] settled = {false};
        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            hideKeyboard(ctx, input);
            settled[0] = true;
            dialog.dismiss();
            if (onCancel != null) onCancel.run();
        });
        try {
            dialog.setOnCancelListener(d -> {
                if (!settled[0] && onCancel != null) onCancel.run();
            });
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        save.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            String text = input.getText().toString().trim();
            if (text.isEmpty()) {
                error.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_empty_error));
                error.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                shake(input);
                return;
            }
            if (!allowSame && text.equals(initial != null ? initial.trim() : "")) {
                error.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_same_error));
                error.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                shake(input);
                return;
            }
            hideKeyboard(ctx, input);
            settled[0] = true;
            dialog.dismiss();
            if (callback != null) callback.onSave(text);
        });

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        if (dialog.getWindow() != null) {
            dialog.getWindow().setSoftInputMode(
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_STATE_VISIBLE
                            | WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE);
        }
        dialog.show();
        input.post(() -> {
            input.requestFocus();
            InputMethodManager imm = (InputMethodManager)
                    ctx.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
            if (imm != null) imm.showSoftInput(input, InputMethodManager.SHOW_IMPLICIT);
        });
    }

                                   String confirmLabel, boolean danger,

    public static void showConfirm(Context ctx, String title, String message,
                                   String confirmLabel, int iconRes,
                                   boolean danger, Runnable onConfirm) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_confirm, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle)).setText(title);
        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogMessage)).setText(message);
        ImageView icon = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon);
        icon.setImageResource(iconRes);
        View iconBg = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon).getParent() instanceof View
                ? (View) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon).getParent() : null;

        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        TextView confirm = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogConfirm);
        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        confirm.setText(confirmLabel);
        if (danger) {
            confirm.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
            confirm.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
        } else {
            confirm.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
        }
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        PressAnim.apply(confirm);

        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());
        confirm.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            v.animate().scaleX(0.94f).scaleY(0.94f).setDuration(70).withEndAction(() -> {
                dialog.dismiss();
                if (onConfirm != null) onConfirm.run();
            }).start();
        });

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
        if (iconBg != null) PressAnim.pop(iconBg);
    }

    // ---- success / failure result popup ----

    public static void showResult(Context ctx, boolean success,
                                  String title, String message) {
        showResult(ctx, success, title, message, null);
    }

    /** @return the shown dialog, so callers/tests can drive or dismiss it. */
    public static android.app.Dialog showResult(Context ctx, boolean success,
                                  String title, String message,
                                  Runnable onOk) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_result, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        FrameLayout iconBg = root.findViewById(R.id.resultIconBg);
        ImageView icon = root.findViewById(R.id.resultIcon);
        iconBg.setBackgroundResource(success
                ? R.drawable.bg_icon_success : R.drawable.bg_icon_danger);
        icon.setImageResource(success ? R.drawable.ic_check : R.drawable.ic_close);
        icon.setColorFilter(success ? 0xFF34C759 : 0xFFFF3B30);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.resultTitle)).setText(title);
        TextView msg = root.findViewById(R.id.resultMessage);
        if (message != null && !message.isEmpty()) {
            msg.setText(message);
            msg.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
        TextView ok = root.findViewById(R.id.resultOk);
        boolean needsButton = onOk != null;
        ok.setVisibility(needsButton ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (needsButton) {
            ok.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.ok_got_it));
            PressAnim.apply(ok);
            final boolean[] fired = {false};
            final Runnable fire = () -> {
                if (fired[0]) return;
                fired[0] = true;
                try {
                    onOk.run();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            };
            ok.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                dialog.dismiss();
                fire.run();
            });
            dialog.setOnDismissListener(dd -> fire.run());
        }

        dialog.setCancelable(true);
        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
        PressAnim.pop(iconBg);

        long delay = success ? 1600 : 2400;
        if (onOk == null) {
            new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed(() -> {
                try {
                    if (dialog.isShowing()) dialog.dismiss();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }, delay);
        } else {
            new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed(() -> {
                try {
                    if (dialog.isShowing() && !success) dialog.dismiss();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }, 8000);
        }
        return dialog;
    }

    // ---- helpers ----

    public static void styleAsCentered(Dialog dialog) {
        styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(dialog, MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP);
    }

    public static void styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(Dialog dialog, int maxWidthDp) {
        Window w = dialog.getWindow();
        if (w == null) return;
        Context ctx = dialog.getContext();
        DisplayMetrics dm = ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
        boolean isLand = dm.widthPixels > dm.heightPixels;
        w.setBackgroundDrawable(new ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT));
        w.setDimAmount(0.62f);
        WindowManager.LayoutParams lp = w.getAttributes();
        int maxW = dp(ctx, maxWidthDp);
        lp.width = Math.min(dm.widthPixels - dp(ctx, 48), maxW);
        lp.height = WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        lp.gravity = Gravity.CENTER;
        lp.horizontalMargin = 0f;
        w.setAttributes(lp);
        View decor = w.getDecorView();
        if (decor != null) {
            int vPad = dp(ctx, isLand ? 8 : 16);
            decor.setPadding(0, vPad, 0, vPad);
        }
    }

    private static void hideKeyboard(Context ctx, View v) {
        try {
            InputMethodManager imm = (InputMethodManager)
                    ctx.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
            if (imm != null) imm.hideSoftInputFromWindow(v.getWindowToken(), 0);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static void shake(View v) {
        v.animate().cancel();
        v.animate()
                .translationX(14f).setDuration(55)
                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(-12f).setDuration(55)
                        .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(8f).setDuration(55)
                                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(0f)
                                        .setDuration(80).start()).start()).start())
                .start();
    }

    private static int dp(Context ctx, int dp) {
        return Math.round(dp * ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.animation.PathInterpolator;

/**
 * Restrained press feedback for every tappable view.
 *
 * The effect is deliberately shallow — a small scale dip plus a barely-there
 * alpha change — and every transition runs on a falloff curve so the motion
 * decays quickly instead of flashing. Nothing here changes layout, so it can
 * safely coexist with the selection scale driven by the adapter.
 */
public final class PressAnim {

    /** Fast lift-off, long settle: the "falloff" easing used on release. */
    private static final PathInterpolator FALLOFF =
            new PathInterpolator(0.2f, 0f, 0f, 1f);
    /** Opposite curve for pressing in: moves a little, then eases. */
    private static final PathInterpolator SETTLE_IN =
            new PathInterpolator(0.4f, 0f, 0.6f, 1f);

    private PressAnim() {}

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    public static void apply(View v) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setOnTouchListener((view, ev) -> {
            switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(0.97f).scaleY(0.97f)
                            .alpha(0.9f)
                            .setDuration(70)
                            .setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                            .start();
                    break;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .alpha(1f)
                            .setDuration(240)
                            .setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN)
                            .start();
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            return false; // let click listeners still fire
        });
    }

    public static void applyAll(View... views) {
        if (views == null) return;
        for (View v : views) apply(v);
    }

    /**
     * Gentler variant for elements that already have their own emphasis
     * (icons, chips): scales a touch and never dips alpha, so there is no
     * visible flash — just a soft give.
     */
    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    public static void applySoft(View v, final float pressedScale) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setOnTouchListener((view, ev) -> {
            switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(pressedScale).scaleY(pressedScale)
                            .setDuration(70)
                            .setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                            .start();
                    break;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .setDuration(240)
                            .setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN)
                            .start();
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            return false;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Small confirmation pop for icons — a light nudge on the same falloff
     * curve. Used instead of a hard overshoot so nothing flashes.
     */
    public static void nudge(View v, float peak) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.animate().cancel();
        v.animate().scaleX(peak).scaleY(peak)
                .setDuration(90).setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate()
                        .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                        .setDuration(260).setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN).start())
                .start();
    }

    /** One-shot entrance pop used for dialog icons. */
    public static void pop(View v) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setScaleX(0.6f);
        v.setScaleY(0.6f);
        v.setAlpha(0f);
        v.animate()
                .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).alpha(1f)
                .setDuration(280)
                .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator(1.6f))
                .start();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.media.AudioAttributes;
import android.media.AudioFormat;
import android.media.AudioTrack;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Plays a 32-bit float WAV straight through {@link AudioTrack} with:
 * <ul>
 *   <li><b>Live dBFS Meter Level ({@link #level})</b>: Computes the real-time
 *       post-FX peak amplitude of every played chunk so {@link DbMeterView}
 *       shows live dBFS readings while previewing!</li>
 *   <li><b>Zero Playhead Jerk</b>: {@link #positionFrames()} tracks the
 *       monotonic hardware speaker head ({@code startFramePos + head}).</li>
 *   <li><b>Speaker Pre-Warming</b>: {@link #warmUpSpeaker(int)} primes a
 *       low-latency {@link AudioTrack} for instant start.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public final class RawFloatPlayer {

    public interface Listener {
        /** Called once when playback stops: true = reached the end. */
        void onDone(boolean completed);
    }

    private static final Object WARM_LOCK = new Object();
    private static AudioTrack warmTrack;
    private static int warmChannels;
    private static volatile boolean warmingSpeaker;

    /**
     * Pre-warms the hardware speaker sink on a background thread when the user
     * starts scrolling the waveform so pressing Resume/Preview plays immediately.
     */
    public static void warmUpSpeaker(final int channels) {
        final int ch = channels == 1 ? 1 : 2;
        synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
            if (warmTrack != null && warmChannels == ch
                    && warmTrack.getState() == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                return;
            }
            if (warmingSpeaker) return;
            warmingSpeaker = true;
        }
        new Thread(() -> {
            AudioTrack built = null;
            try {
                built = createLowLatencyTrack(ch, 32768);
                if (built.getState() == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                    built.play();
                    float[] silence = new float[128 * ch];
                    built.write(silence, 0, silence.length, AudioTrack.WRITE_NON_BLOCKING);
                    built.pause();
                    built.flush();
                } else {
                    built.release();
                    built = null;
                }
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                if (built != null) {
                    try { built.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored2) {}
                    built = null;
                }
            }
            synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
                warmingSpeaker = false;
                if (built != null) {
                    if (warmTrack != null) {
                        try { warmTrack.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                    }
                    warmTrack = built;
                    warmChannels = ch;
                }
            }
        }, "takeone-speaker-warm").start();
    }

    public static void releaseWarmSpeaker() {
        synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
            if (warmTrack != null) {
                try { warmTrack.stop(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                try { warmTrack.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                warmTrack = null;
            }
        }
    }

    private static AudioTrack obtainTrack(int channels, int desiredBytes) {
        synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
            if (warmTrack != null && warmChannels == channels
                    && warmTrack.getState() == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                AudioTrack t = warmTrack;
                warmTrack = null;
                return t;
            }
        }
        return createLowLatencyTrack(channels, desiredBytes);
    }

    private static AudioTrack createLowLatencyTrack(int channels, int desiredBytes) {
        int mask = channels == 2 ? AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_STEREO
                : AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO;
        int minBytes = AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(
                RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE,
                mask, AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT);
        if (minBytes <= 0) minBytes = 8192;
        int bufBytes = Math.max(minBytes, Math.min(32768, desiredBytes));
        AudioAttributes attrs = new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC)
                .build();
        AudioFormat af = new AudioFormat.Builder()
                .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT)
                .setSampleRate(RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE)
                .setChannelMask(mask)
                .build();
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
            try {
                return new AudioTrack.Builder()
                        .setAudioAttributes(attrs)
                        .setAudioFormat(af)
                        .setBufferSizeInBytes(bufBytes)
                        .setTransferMode(AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM)
                        .setPerformanceMode(AudioTrack.PERFORMANCE_MODE_LOW_LATENCY)
                        .build();
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        }
        return new AudioTrack(attrs, af, bufBytes, AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM, 0);
    }

    private final File file;
    private final int channels;
    private final long dataStart;
    private final long totalFrames;
    private final Listener listener;

    private Thread thread;
    private volatile boolean stop;
    private volatile boolean paused;
    private volatile long startFramePos;
    private volatile long framePos;
    private volatile long maxReportedFrame;
    private volatile long playStartedRealtimeMs;
    private volatile AudioTrack activeTrack;
    private volatile long generation;
    private volatile DspChain dspChain;
    private volatile long stopAtFrame = -1;

    /**
     * Real-time peak amplitude (0..1) of the audio currently playing through
     * the speaker (including live DspChain FX), driving DbMeterView during preview!
     */
    public volatile float level = 0f;

    public void setDspChain(DspChain chain) {
        this.dspChain = chain;
    }

    public RawFloatPlayer(File file, Listener listener) throws Exception {
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(file);
        if (info.channels < 1 || info.channels > 2) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("bad channels");
        }
        this.file = file;
        this.channels = info.channels;
        this.dataStart = info.dataStart;
        this.totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4 / info.channels;
        if (totalFrames <= 0) throw new IllegalStateException("empty");
        this.listener = listener;
    }

    public long durationMs() {
        return totalFrames * 1000L / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
    }

    public synchronized void play() {
        playFrom(framePos);
    }

    public synchronized void playFrom(long frame) {
        stopLocked();
        stop = false;
        paused = false;
        stopAtFrame = -1;
        framePos = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalFrames, frame));
        startFramePos = framePos;
        maxReportedFrame = framePos;
        playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        generation++;
        thread = new Thread(this::run, "takeone-raw-preview");
        thread.start();
    }

    /** Play a specific frame range `[startFrame, endFrame)` (e.g. selection preview). */
    public synchronized void playRange(long startFrame, long endFrame) {
        stopLocked();
        stop = false;
        paused = false;
        framePos = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalFrames, startFrame));
        startFramePos = framePos;
        maxReportedFrame = framePos;
        playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        stopAtFrame = (endFrame > framePos && endFrame <= totalFrames)
                ? endFrame : -1;
        generation++;
        thread = new Thread(this::run, "takeone-raw-preview");
        thread.start();
    }

    public synchronized void pause() {
        long cur = positionFrames();
        paused = true;
        stopLocked();
        framePos = cur;
        startFramePos = cur;
        maxReportedFrame = cur;
        level = 0f;
    }

    public synchronized void stop() {
        stopLocked();
        framePos = 0;
        startFramePos = 0;
        maxReportedFrame = 0;
        level = 0f;
    }

    public long positionFrames() {
        long limit = (stopAtFrame > 0 && stopAtFrame <= totalFrames)
                ? stopAtFrame : totalFrames;
        if (!stop && !paused) {
            AudioTrack t = activeTrack;
            if (t != null) {
                try {
                    long head = t.getPlaybackHeadPosition() & 0xFFFFFFFFL;
                    if (head > 0) {
                        long pos = Math.min(limit, startFramePos + head);
                        if (pos > maxReportedFrame) maxReportedFrame = pos;
                        return maxReportedFrame;
                    }
                    long elapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - playStartedRealtimeMs;
                    if (elapsed > 160L && framePos > startFramePos) {
                        long sim = Math.min(limit,
                                startFramePos + (elapsed * RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE / 1000L));
                        if (sim > maxReportedFrame) maxReportedFrame = sim;
                        return maxReportedFrame;
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            return maxReportedFrame;
        }
        return maxReportedFrame > 0 ? maxReportedFrame : framePos;
    }

    public long positionMs() {
        return positionFrames() * 1000L / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
    }

    public synchronized void seekToMs(long ms) {
        long f = ms * RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE / 1000L;
        boolean wasPlaying = thread != null && !paused;
        stopLocked();
        framePos = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalFrames, f));
        startFramePos = framePos;
        maxReportedFrame = framePos;
        if (wasPlaying) {
            stop = false;
            paused = false;
            playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            generation++;
            thread = new Thread(this::run, "takeone-raw-preview");
            thread.start();
        }
    }

    private synchronized void stopLocked() {
        generation++;
        stop = true;
        paused = true;
        level = 0f;
        AudioTrack t = activeTrack;
        if (t != null) {
            try {
                t.pause();
                t.flush();
                t.stop();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        Thread th = thread;
        thread = null;
        if (th != null) {
            try {
                th.join(800);
            } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private void run() {
        final long gen = generation;
        boolean completed = false;
        AudioTrack track = null;
        RandomAccessFile r = null;
        ConversionJobs.beginRawRead(file.getAbsolutePath());
        try {
            long limitFrame = (stopAtFrame > 0 && stopAtFrame <= totalFrames)
                    ? stopAtFrame : totalFrames;
            long framesToPlay = Math.max(1L, limitFrame - startFramePos);
            int spanBytes = (int) Math.min(32768L, framesToPlay * channels * 4L);
            track = obtainTrack(channels, spanBytes);
            if (track.getState() != AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) return;
            r = new RandomAccessFile(file, "r");
            float[] buf = new float[1024 * channels];
            byte[] raw = new byte[buf.length * 4];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(raw)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            track.play();
            activeTrack = track;
            long writtenFrames = 0;
            while (!stop && framePos < limitFrame) {
                int want = (int) Math.min(1024, limitFrame - framePos);
                r.seek(dataStart + framePos * channels * 4L);
                r.readFully(raw, 0, want * channels * 4);
                fb.clear();
                fb.limit(want * channels);
                fb.get(buf, 0, want * channels);
                DspChain chain = this.dspChain;
                if (chain != null && chain.isActive()) {
                    chain.processInPlace(buf, want);
                }
                // Compute post-FX peak level for the dBFS meter during preview!
                float chunkPeak = 0f;
                int totalSamples = want * channels;
                for (int i = 0; i < totalSamples; i++) {
                    float a = Math.abs(buf[i]);
                    if (a > chunkPeak) chunkPeak = a;
                }
                this.level = Math.min(1f, chunkPeak);

                int written = 0;
                while (written < totalSamples && !stop) {
                    int n = track.write(buf, written,
                            totalSamples - written,
                            AudioTrack.WRITE_BLOCKING);
                    if (n <= 0) break;
                    written += n;
                }
                framePos += want;
                writtenFrames += want;
            }
            if (!stop && framePos >= limitFrame && writtenFrames > 0) {
                long drainStart = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
                long maxDrainMs = Math.min(1500L,
                        (writtenFrames * 1000L / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE) + 350L);
                long lastHead = -1;
                long lastAdvanceAt = drainStart;
                while (!stop) {
                    long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
                    if (now - drainStart >= maxDrainMs) break;
                    long head = 0;
                    try {
                        head = track.getPlaybackHeadPosition() & 0xFFFFFFFFL;
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    if (head >= writtenFrames) break;
                    if (head != lastHead) {
                        lastHead = head;
                        lastAdvanceAt = now;
                    } else if (now - lastAdvanceAt > 180L) {
                        break;
                    }
                    try {
                        Thread.sleep(12);
                    } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!stop) {
                    maxReportedFrame = limitFrame;
                    completed = true;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        } finally {
            this.level = 0f;
            activeTrack = null;
            if (track != null) {
                try {
                    track.stop();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    track.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (r != null) {
                try {
                    r.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            ConversionJobs.endRawRead(file.getAbsolutePath());
            if (gen == generation && listener != null) {
                try {
                    listener.onDone(completed);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.media.MediaRecorder;

/**
 * The three recording presets. Each one is a distinct capture geometry —
 * mono vs stereo, processed mic vs unprocessed — so none overlaps another.
 * Containers live in {@link SaveFormat}: "Raw Studio" as a preset was just
 * Music-plus-WAV, and "Voice vs Standard" was one mono capture at two
 * bitrates, so both collapsed away. Everything is locked to 48&nbsp;kHz so
 * AudioFlinger never has to resample, and Music uses the UNPROCESSED source
 * to bypass AGC ducking and effects.
 */
public enum RecordPreset {
    MEMO("memo", R.string.preset_memo, R.string.preset_memo_sub,
            "MEMO 96k", 1, 96000, MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC),
    PODCAST("podcast", R.string.preset_podcast, R.string.preset_podcast_sub,
            "POD 256k", 2, 256000, MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC),
    MUSIC("music", R.string.preset_music, R.string.preset_music_sub,
            "MUS 320k", 2, 320000, MediaRecorder.AudioSource.UNPROCESSED, true);

    public final String id;
    public final int titleRes;
    public final int subRes;
    /** Short badge text, e.g. "MUS 320k". */
    public final String shortLabel;
    /** 1 = mono, 2 = stereo (before any mono fallback). */
    public final int channels;
    /** AAC bitrate for the save conversion. */
    public final int aacBitrate;
    public final int audioSource;
    /**
     * True when the capture should be kept lossless by default. Only the
     * unprocessed stereo master qualifies: AAC is transparent for speech but
     * discards real detail in a music take, so AUTO saves Music as FLAC
     * rather than squeezing it through a lossy codec.
     */
    public final boolean autoSavesLossless;

    RecordPreset(String id, int titleRes, int subRes, String shortLabel,
                 int channels, int aacBitrate, int audioSource) {
        this(id, titleRes, subRes, shortLabel, channels, aacBitrate,
                audioSource, false);
    }

    RecordPreset(String id, int titleRes, int subRes, String shortLabel,
                 int channels, int aacBitrate, int audioSource,
                 boolean autoSavesLossless) {
        this.id = id;
        this.titleRes = titleRes;
        this.subRes = subRes;
        this.shortLabel = shortLabel;
        this.channels = channels;
        this.aacBitrate = aacBitrate;
        this.audioSource = audioSource;
        this.autoSavesLossless = autoSavesLossless;
    }

    public boolean wantsStereo() {
        return channels == 2;
    }

    public boolean wantsUnprocessed() {
        return audioSource == MediaRecorder.AudioSource.UNPROCESSED;
    }

    public static RecordPreset of(String id) {
        if (id != null) {
            for (RecordPreset p : values()) {
                if (p.id.equals(id)) return p;
            }
            // Retired presets map to their closest surviving capture.
            if ("voice".equals(id) || "standard".equals(id)) return MEMO;
            if ("raw".equals(id)) return MUSIC;
        }
        return MEMO;
    }

    public static RecordPreset[] all() {
        return values();
    }

    private static final String PREFS = "takeone";
    private static final String KEY = "rec_preset";

    public static RecordPreset load(Context ctx) {
        try {
            SharedPreferences p = ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
            return of(p.getString(KEY, MEMO.id));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return MEMO;
        }
    }

    public void save(Context ctx) {
        try {
            ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .edit().putString(KEY, id).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}
