package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * WAV resume is byte-exact: a conversion interrupted halfway and resumed
 * must produce a file identical to an uninterrupted conversion. That is the
 * mechanism behind "minimum reconversion".
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class ConversionResumeTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    private File makeRaw(String name, int frames) throws Exception {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), name);
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 4));
            java.util.Random rnd = new java.util.Random(11);
            byte[] chunk = new byte[65536];
            long left = (long) frames * 2 * 4;
            while (left > 0) {
                int n = (int) Math.min(chunk.length, left);
                rnd.nextBytes(chunk);
                w.write(chunk, 0, n);
                left -= n;
            }
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    private static byte[] slurp(File f) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            byte[] out = new byte[(int) r.length()];
            r.readFully(out);
            return out;
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void resumedWav16IsByteIdentical() throws Exception {
        File raw = makeRaw("resume-src.wav", 48000);
        try {
            // Uninterrupted reference conversion.
            TakeSaver.Result full = TakeSaver.convertRaw(ctx(), raw,
                    "Resume", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16, null);
            byte[] expect;
            try {
                expect = slurp(full.file);
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                full.file.delete();
            }
            // Interrupted attempt: convert the first 12000 frames by hand
            // into a partial file, exactly as the pump would leave it
            // (12000 stereo frames = 24000 samples).
            File part = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "resume.part");
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            part.delete();
            RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(part, "rw");
            try {
                w.setLength(0);
                w.write(Dsp.wav16Header(2, 48000, 0));
                RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "r");
                try {
                    byte[] in = new byte[12000 * 2 * 4];
                    byte[] out = new byte[12000 * 2 * 2];
                    java.nio.FloatBuffer fb =
                            java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                    .asFloatBuffer();
                    java.nio.ShortBuffer sb =
                            java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(out)
                                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                    .asShortBuffer();
                    r.seek(44);
                    r.readFully(in);
                    FormatConverter.toInt16(fb, 12000 * 2, sb);
                    w.write(out);
                } finally {
                    r.close();
                }
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("resume-1", "Resume",
                    raw.getAbsolutePath(), part.getAbsolutePath(),
                    "memo", "wav16", 2, 96000, 1000, 48000);
            job.framesDone = 12000;
            TakeSaver.Result resumed = ConversionService.resumeWavConvert(
                    ctx(), raw, part, RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16,
                    job, null);
            byte[] got;
            try {
                got = slurp(resumed.file);
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                resumed.file.delete();
            }
            assertEquals("resumed length differs",
                    expect.length, got.length);
            assertTrue("resumed bytes differ",
                    Arrays.equals(expect, got));
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void misalignedPartialRestartsCleanly() throws Exception {
        File raw = makeRaw("resume-src2.wav", 48000);
        try {
            File part = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "resume2.part");
            RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(part, "rw");
            try {
                // Garbage length: cannot line up with any frame count.
                w.write(new byte[100]);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("resume-2", "Resume",
                    raw.getAbsolutePath(), part.getAbsolutePath(),
                    "memo", "wav16", 2, 96000, 1000, 48000);
            job.framesDone = 12000;
            TakeSaver.Result r = ConversionService.resumeWavConvert(
                    ctx(), raw, part, RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16,
                    job, null);
            try {
                assertTrue(r.file.length() > 1000);
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                r.file.delete();
            }
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
        }
    }

    /**
     * AUDIT-3-01: a resumed WAV16/WAV24 take is integer PCM, so the duration
     * must come from a PCM-aware reader. Before the fix every resumed take
     * landed in the library as 00:01.
     */
    @Test
    public void resumedWavKeepsRealDuration() throws Exception {
        File raw = makeRaw("resume-dur.wav", 48000 * 3);
        try {
            File part = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "resume-dur.part");
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            part.delete();
            ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("resume-dur", "Dur",
                    raw.getAbsolutePath(), part.getAbsolutePath(),
                    "memo", "wav16", 2, 96000, 1000, 144000);
            job.framesDone = 144000; // already fully encoded
            TakeSaver.Result r = ConversionService.resumeWavConvert(
                    ctx(), raw, part, RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16,
                    job, null);
            try {
                assertTrue("resumed take duration " + r.durationMs
                                + "ms (expected ~3000)",
                        r.durationMs > 2500L && r.durationMs < 3500L);
                assertEquals(3000L, Dsp.wavDurationMs(r.file));
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                r.file.delete();
            }
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
        }
    }

    /**
     * AUDIT-3-02(b): `job.framesDone` is only a 5%-rounded estimate while a
     * conversion runs, so it must not be trusted over a valid, frame-aligned
     * partial already on disk.
     */
    @Test
    public void resumeAdoptsFrameAlignedPartialDespiteStaleFramesDone()
            throws Exception {
        File raw = makeRaw("resume-est.wav", 48000);
        try {
            File part = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "resume-est.part");
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            part.delete();
            int doneFrames = 12000;
            // Fill the partial with a marker value that a fresh conversion
            // could never produce, so "was the partial adopted?" is directly
            // observable in the result.
            final short MARK = 9999;
            RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(part, "rw");
            try {
                w.setLength(0);
                w.write(Dsp.wav16Header(2, 48000, 0));
                byte[] out = new byte[doneFrames * 2 * 2];
                java.nio.ShortBuffer sb =
                        java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(out)
                                .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                .asShortBuffer();
                for (int i = 0; i < doneFrames * 2; i++) sb.put(i, MARK);
                w.write(out);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            // Deliberately wrong (rounded) estimate, as saved by updateProgress.
            ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("resume-est", "Est",
                    raw.getAbsolutePath(), part.getAbsolutePath(),
                    "memo", "wav16", 2, 96000, 1000, 48000);
            job.framesDone = 11900; // != 12000 on disk
            TakeSaver.Result r = ConversionService.resumeWavConvert(
                    ctx(), raw, part, RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16,
                    job, null);
            try {
                FormatConverter.validateFinal(r.file, SaveFormat.WAV16);
                assertEquals(1000L, Dsp.wavDurationMs(r.file));
                // The marker must survive at the very front: proof the
                // on-disk partial was adopted instead of being discarded.
                RandomAccessFile r2 =
                        new RandomAccessFile(r.file, "r");
                short first;
                try {
                    byte[] head = new byte[8];
                    r2.seek(44);
                    r2.readFully(head);
                    first = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(head)
                            .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                            .getShort(0);
                } finally {
                    r2.close();
                }
                assertEquals("stale estimate discarded the partial",
                        MARK, first);
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                r.file.delete();
            }
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
        }
    }

    /**
     * AUDIT-3-02(a): enqueue must read geometry from the raw file, not from
     * an idle engine (which reports dataBytes 0 -> framesTotal 1).
     */
    @Test
    public void enqueueReadsGeometryFromRawFile() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        File raw = makeRaw("enqueue-geom.wav", 48000);
        try {
            ConversionJob job = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), raw,
                    "Geom", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16, 1000);
            assertEquals("channels must come from the raw header",
                    2, job.channels);
            assertEquals("framesTotal must come from the raw header",
                    48000L, job.framesTotal);
            assertTrue(ConversionJobs.cancel(job.jobId, true));
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.view.View;

import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Drives the library adapter through appear/progress/disappear of a
 * converting card exactly like the live jobs listener does, catching
 * RecyclerView bookkeeping crashes without an emulator round trip.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class ConvertingCardsBindTest {

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    private static class NopListener implements TakesAdapter.Listener {
        public void onCardClick(Take take) {}
        public void onCardLongPress(Take take) {}
        public void onPlay(Take take) {}
        public void onFavorite(Take take) {}
        public void onRename(Take take) {}
        public void onExport(Take take) {}
        public void onEdit(Take take) {}
        public void onDelete(Take take) {}
        public void onCancelConversion(Take take) {}
        public void onSeek(Take take, long posMs) {}
    }

    private static Take roomTake(long id, String title) {
        return new Take(id, title, 60_000L, System.currentTimeMillis(),
                "1.0 MB", "M4A", false, "/tmp/" + title + ".m4a");
    }

    private static Take convertingTake(long id) {
        Take t = new Take(id, "Converting", 60_000L,
                System.currentTimeMillis(), "", "M4A", false, "");
        t.converting = true;
        t.convProgress = 10;
        t.convFormat = "M4A";
        t.convJobId = "job-x";
        t.convRawPath = "/tmp/x.wav";
        t.dateLabel = "Converting to M4A • 10%";
        return t;
    }

    @Test
    public void appearProgressDisappearSurvivesLayouts() {
        Activity a = activity();
        RecyclerView rv = new RecyclerView(a);
        a.setContentView(rv);
        rv.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(a));
        TakesAdapter adapter = new TakesAdapter(new NopListener());
        rv.setAdapter(adapter);

        List<Take> room = new ArrayList<>();
        room.add(roomTake(101, "One"));
        room.add(roomTake(102, "Two"));
        room.add(roomTake(103, "Three"));

        layout(rv);
        adapter.setTakes(new ArrayList<>(room));
        layout(rv);

        // Job appears: converting card pinned at top.
        Take conv = convertingTake(-4294967297L);
        List<Take> withConv = new ArrayList<>();
        withConv.add(conv);
        withConv.addAll(room);
        adapter.setTakes(withConv);
        layout(rv);

        // Progress ticks: direct paints + field updates, like the listener.
        for (int pct = 20; pct <= 90; pct += 10) {
            conv.convProgress = pct;
            adapter.paintConvProgress(rv, conv.id, pct, "Converting");
            layout(rv);
        }

        // Job completes: card gone, finished row on top.
        List<Take> done = new ArrayList<>();
        done.add(roomTake(104, "Converting"));
        done.addAll(room);
        adapter.setTakes(done);
        layout(rv);

        assertTrue("survived all layouts", rv.getChildCount() > 0);
    }

    private static void layout(RecyclerView rv) {
        rv.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(320, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(640, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        rv.layout(0, 0, 320, 640);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;

/** Parser for the breadcrumb trail: finds stages that never closed. */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class CrashLogTest {

    private void clearCrumbs(Context ctx) {
        File f = new File(ctx.getApplicationContext().getFilesDir(),
                "takeone-breadcrumbs.txt");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        f.delete();
    }

    @Test
    public void unterminatedConvertIsFound() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        clearCrumbs(ctx);
        assertNull(CrashLog.unterminatedStage(ctx));
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "finalize start");
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "finalize end");
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert start opus");
        assertEquals("convert opus", CrashLog.unterminatedStage(ctx));
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert end opus");
        assertNull(CrashLog.unterminatedStage(ctx));
    }

    @Test
    public void autoSwitchConsumesPending() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        clearCrumbs(ctx);
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert start flac");
        assertEquals("convert flac", CrashLog.unterminatedStage(ctx));
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "auto-switch flac->m4a");
        assertNull(CrashLog.unterminatedStage(ctx));
    }

    @Test
    public void laterSuccessClearsEarlierStart() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        clearCrumbs(ctx);
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert start m4a");
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert end m4a");
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert start wav16");
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert end wav16");
        assertNull(CrashLog.unterminatedStage(ctx));
    }
}

FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/DspAudioFixTest.java

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;
import static org.junit.Assert.fail;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Regression tests for the audit fixes: RIFF chunk scanning (BUG-06),
 * streaming resampling (BUG-01), bit-exact chunked decimation (BUG-03),
 * little-endian sample I/O (BUG-09) and waveform peak loading (BUG-04).
 */
public class DspAudioFixTest {

    @Rule
    public TemporaryFolder tmp = new TemporaryFolder();

    // ---- BUG-06: chunk walker ----

    private static void writeChunk(RandomAccessFile w, String id, byte[] payload)
            throws Exception {
        w.write(new byte[]{(byte) id.charAt(0), (byte) id.charAt(1),
                (byte) id.charAt(2), (byte) id.charAt(3)});
        ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.allocate(4).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        b.putInt(payload.length);
        w.write(b.array());
        w.write(payload);
        if ((payload.length & 1) == 1) w.write(0); // word alignment
    }

    @Test
    public void parseWavHeaderFindsDataAfterJunk() throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile("junky.wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.write(new byte[]{'R', 'I', 'F', 'F', 0, 0, 0, 0,
                    'W', 'A', 'V', 'E'});
            writeChunk(w, "JUNK", new byte[16]);
            ByteBuffer fmt = ByteBuffer.allocate(16)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
            fmt.putShort((short) 3);
            fmt.putShort((short) 1);
            fmt.putInt(48000);
            fmt.putInt(48000 * 4);
            fmt.putShort((short) 4);
            fmt.putShort((short) 32);
            writeChunk(w, "fmt ", fmt.array());
            writeChunk(w, "LIST", new byte[12]);
            byte[] pcm = new byte[480 * 4];
            ByteBuffer.wrap(pcm).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                    .asFloatBuffer().put(new float[480]);
            writeChunk(w, "data", pcm);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        Dsp.WavHeader h;
        try {
            h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
        assertEquals(3, h.audioFormat);
        assertEquals(1, h.channels);
        assertEquals(48000, h.sampleRate);
        assertEquals(32, h.bits);
        // 12 (riff) + 24 (junk) + 24 (fmt) + 20 (list) + 8 (data hdr).
        assertEquals(88, h.dataStart);
        assertEquals(480 * 4L, h.dataBytes);
        // Duration must agree through the scanner too.
        assertEquals(10L, Dsp.wavDurationMs(f));
    }

    @Test
    public void parseWavHeaderRejectsNonWav() throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile("nope.wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.write(new byte[100]);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            fail("non-wav parsed");
        } catch (IllegalStateException expected) {
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    // ---- BUG-01: resampler ----

    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, int rate, double freq,
                                float amp) {
        float[] s = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float v = (float) (amp * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * f / rate));
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) s[f * ch + c] = v;
        }
        return s;
    }

    private static float[] concat(float[]... parts) {
        int n = 0;
        for (float[] p : parts) n += p.length;
        float[] out = new float[n];
        int p = 0;
        for (float[] part : parts) {
            System.arraycopy(part, 0, out, p, part.length);
            p += part.length;
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Zero-crossing pitch estimate on channel 0. */
    private static double pitchHz(float[] s, int ch, int rate) {
        int crossings = 0;
        int n = s.length / ch;
        float prev = s[0];
        for (int f = 1; f < n; f++) {
            float cur = s[f * ch];
            if ((prev <= 0f && cur > 0f) || (prev >= 0f && cur < 0f)) {
                crossings++;
            }
            prev = cur;
        }
        double seconds = (double) n / rate;
        return crossings / 2.0 / seconds;
    }

    @Test
    public void resamplerUpsamplePreservesDurationAndPitch() {
        // 8 kHz AMR-geometry mono -> 48 kHz session, fed in uneven chunks.
        float[] in = sine(8000, 1, 8000, 440.0, 0.5f);
        Dsp.Resampler r = new Dsp.Resampler(8000, 48000, 1);
        float[] a = r.push(in, 1000);
        float[] b = r.push(java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(in, 1000, 4000), 3000);
        float[] c = r.push(java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(in, 4000, 8000), 4000);
        float[] tail = r.flush();
        float[] out = concat(a, b, c, tail);
        assertEquals(48000, out.length, 4);
        assertEquals(440.0, pitchHz(out, 1, 48000), 3.0);
        float peak = 0f;
        for (float v : out) {
            if (Float.isNaN(v)) fail("NaN in resampled output");
            peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(v));
        }
        assertEquals(0.5f, peak, 0.06f);
    }

    @Test
    public void resamplerChunkingMatchesOneShot() {
        float[] in = sine(4410, 2, 44100, 440.0, 0.4f);
        Dsp.Resampler one = new Dsp.Resampler(44100, 48000, 2);
        float[] o1 = concat(one.push(in, 4410), one.flush());
        Dsp.Resampler two = new Dsp.Resampler(44100, 48000, 2);
        float[] p1 = two.push(java.util.Arrays.copyOf(in, 2000), 1000);
        float[] p2 = two.push(
                java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(in, 2000, 8820), 3410);
        float[] o2 = concat(p1, p2, two.flush());
        assertArrayEquals(o1, o2, 0f);
    }

    @Test
    public void resamplerDownsampleKillsAliases() {
        // 96 kHz stereo: 440 Hz tone + 30 kHz tone above the 24 kHz Nyquist.
        int frames = 9600;
        float[] in = new float[frames * 2];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float v = (float) (0.4 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 440 * f / 96000)
                    + 0.4 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 30000 * f / 96000));
            in[f * 2] = v;
            in[f * 2 + 1] = v;
        }
        Dsp.Resampler r = new Dsp.Resampler(96000, 48000, 2);
        float[] out = concat(r.push(in, frames), r.flush());
        int outFrames = out.length / 2;
        assertEquals(4800, outFrames, 4);
        // Skip the FIR leading-edge transient (first 128 frames): any
        // finite filter rings while its delay line fills, which is normal
        // and inaudible, but it would pollute a crossing count.
        int skip = 128;
        float[] steady = java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(out,
                skip * 2, out.length);
        int steadyFrames = outFrames - skip;
        assertEquals(440.0, pitchHz(steady, 2, 48000), 5.0);
        // Fit the 440 Hz amplitude delay-independently (any FIR delays by
        // its group delay): quadrature correlation gives the true passband
        // gain, and the residual proves the 30 kHz alias is (nearly) gone.
        double ss = 0, sc = 0, cc = 0, ys = 0, yc = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < steadyFrames; f++) {
            double ph = 2 * Math.PI * 440 * (f + skip) / 48000;
            double s = Math.sin(ph);
            double c = Math.cos(ph);
            double y = steady[f * 2];
            ss += s * s;
            sc += s * c;
            cc += c * c;
            ys += y * s;
            yc += y * c;
        }
        double det = ss * cc - sc * sc;
        double ampA = (ys * cc - yc * sc) / det;
        double ampB = (ss * yc - sc * ys) / det;
        double amp = Math.sqrt(ampA * ampA + ampB * ampB);
        assertEquals(0.4, amp, 0.05);
        double resid = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < steadyFrames; f++) {
            double ph = 2 * Math.PI * 440 * (f + skip) / 48000;
            double d = steady[f * 2]
                    - (ampA * Math.sin(ph) + ampB * Math.cos(ph));
            resid += d * d;
        }
        assertTrue("alias leaked, residual rms="
                        + Math.sqrt(resid / steadyFrames),
                Math.sqrt(resid / steadyFrames) < 0.06);
    }

    @Test
    public void resamplerPassthroughIsIdentity() {
        float[] in = sine(1000, 2, 48000, 440.0, 0.3f);
        Dsp.Resampler r = new Dsp.Resampler(48000, 48000, 2);
        assertArrayEquals(in, r.push(in, 1000), 0f);
        assertEquals(0, r.flush().length);
    }

    // ---- BUG-03: chunked decimation is bit-exact vs batch ----

    @Test
    public void firDecimatorMatchesBatchExactly() {
        Random rnd = new Random(1234);
        int frames = 4800;
        int decim = 6;
        int taps = 64;
        float[] fir = Dsp.firLowpass(3400.0 / 48000, taps);
        float[] mono = new float[frames];
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            mono[i] = rnd.nextFloat() * 2f - 1f;
        }
        // Batch reference: the old whole-file loop, verbatim math.
        int delay = taps / 2;
        int half = taps / 2;
        int outLen = frames / decim;
        short[] expect = new short[outLen];
        for (int o = 0; o < outLen; o++) {
            float acc = 0f;
            int center = o * decim - delay;
            for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                int i1 = center + k;
                int i2 = center + taps - 1 - k;
                float s1 = (i1 >= 0 && i1 < frames) ? mono[i1] : 0f;
                float s2 = (i2 >= 0 && i2 < frames) ? mono[i2] : 0f;
                acc += s1 * fir[k] + s2 * fir[taps - 1 - k];
            }
            if (acc > 1f) acc = 1f;
            else if (acc < -1f) acc = -1f;
            expect[o] = (short) (acc * 32767f);
        }
        // Streamed: odd-sized pushes plus a flush.
        Dsp.FirDecimator dec = new Dsp.FirDecimator(decim, fir);
        short[] got = new short[outLen + 64];
        int p = 0;
        p += dec.push(mono, 1000, got, p);
        float[] rest = java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(mono, 1000, frames);
        p += dec.push(rest, frames - 1000, got, p);
        p += dec.flush(frames, got, p);
        assertEquals("output count " + p + " != batch " + outLen,
                outLen, p);
        assertArrayEquals(expect, java.util.Arrays.copyOf(got, p));
    }

    @Test
    public void firDecimatorOutputCountMatchesBatchRule() {
        // Non-multiple length: total outputs must be totalIn/decim.
        Dsp.FirDecimator dec =
                new Dsp.FirDecimator(6, Dsp.firLowpass(3400.0 / 48000, 64));
        int total = 25 * 6 + 3;
        float[] zeros = new float[total];
        short[] out = new short[total];
        int p = dec.push(zeros, total, out, 0);
        p += dec.flush(total, out, p);
        assertEquals(total / 6, p);
    }

    // ---- BUG-09: little-endian I/O ----

    @Test
    public void writeFloatsLERoundTrips() throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile("le.wav");
        float[] vals = {0f, 1f, -1f, 0.5f, -0.25f, 1e-7f, 3.14159f, -2.5f};
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, vals, 0, vals.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            byte[] raw = new byte[vals.length * 4];
            r.readFully(raw);
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(raw)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            for (int i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
                assertEquals("sample " + i, vals[i], fb.get(), 0f);
            }
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    // ---- BUG-04: peak loading ----

    @Test
    public void loadPeaksReflectsEnvelope() throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile("env.wav");
        int frames = 48000;
        float[] s = new float[frames * 2];
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            float amp = i < frames / 2 ? 0.5f : 0.1f;
            float v = amp * (float) Math.sin(i * 0.05);
            s[i * 2] = v;
            s[i * 2 + 1] = v * 0.5f;
        }
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 4));
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, s, 0, s.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        float[] peaks = Dsp.loadPeaks(f, 8192);
        assertTrue("no peaks", peaks.length > 10);
        float first = 0f, second = 0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < peaks.length / 2; i++) {
            first = Math.max(first, peaks[i]);
        }
        for (int i = peaks.length / 2; i < peaks.length; i++) {
            second = Math.max(second, peaks[i]);
        }
        assertEquals(0.5f, first, 0.06f);
        assertEquals(0.1f, second, 0.03f);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * Roadmap Phase 2 DSP chain: fast-math accuracy, inactive no-op guarantee,
 * bounded active processing, badge text and persisted configuration.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class DspChainTest {

    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, float amp) {
        float[] buf = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) Math.sin(f * 0.03) * amp;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return buf;
    }

    @Test
    public void fastMathSanity() {
        assertEquals(0.0f, DspChain.fastLinToDb(1.0f), 0.5f);
        assertEquals(-20.0f, DspChain.fastLinToDb(0.1f), 1.0f);
        assertEquals(1.0f, DspChain.fastDbToLin(0f), 0.05f);
        assertEquals(0.0f, DspChain.fastDbToLin(-140f), 0.0f);
        float rt = DspChain.fastDbToLin(DspChain.fastLinToDb(0.25f));
        assertEquals(0.25f, rt, 0.03f);
    }

    @Test
    public void inactiveChainIsBitIdenticalNoOp() {
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, new DspChain.Config());
        assertFalse(chain.isActive());
        float[] buf = sine(1024, 2, 0.7f);
        float[] before = buf.clone();
        chain.processInPlace(buf, 1024);
        for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
            assertEquals("touched @" + i, before[i], buf[i], 0.0f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void polishChainStaysBoundedAndAudible() {
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, DspChain.Config.voicePolish());
        assertTrue(chain.isActive());
        float[] buf = sine(4800, 2, 0.9f);
        chain.processInPlace(buf, 4800);
        float peak = 0f;
        boolean changed = false;
        float[] orig = sine(4800, 2, 0.9f);
        for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
            assertTrue("non-finite @" + i, Float.isFinite(buf[i]));
            peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(buf[i]));
            if (Math.abs(buf[i] - orig[i]) > 1e-4f) changed = true;
        }
        assertTrue("silenced, peak=" + peak, peak > 0.05f);
        assertTrue("unbounded, peak=" + peak, peak <= 1.0f);
        assertTrue("chain did nothing", changed);
    }

    @Test
    public void monoChainWorks() {
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, DspChain.Config.voicePolish());
        float[] buf = sine(512, 1, 0.5f);
        chain.processInPlace(buf, 512);
        for (float v : buf) assertTrue(Float.isFinite(v));
    }

    @Test
    public void badgeSummaries() {
        assertEquals("FX Off", new DspChain.Config().badgeSummary());
        assertEquals("FX • Polish", DspChain.Config.voicePolish()
                .badgeSummary());
        assertEquals("FX • Custom",
                new DspChain.Config(false, 30, 0, 0).badgeSummary());
    }

    @Test
    public void configPersists() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        DspChain.Config c = new DspChain.Config(true, 50, 45, 40);
        c.save(ctx);
        DspChain.Config back = DspChain.Config.load(ctx);
        assertTrue(back.hpfEnabled);
        assertEquals(50, back.noisePct);
        assertEquals(45, back.deEssPct);
        assertEquals(40, back.compPct);
    }

    @Test
    public void threeModesSwitchInterchangeably() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        DspChain.Config c = new DspChain.Config();
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_OFF, c.mode);
        assertFalse(c.isActive());

        // 1) Off -> Noise Suppression
        c.applyMode(DspChain.Config.MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION, c.mode);
        assertTrue(c.isActive());
        assertEquals(50, c.noisePct);
        assertEquals(45, c.deEssPct);
        assertEquals(40, c.compPct);

        // 2) Noise Suppression -> Custom (previously broken!)
        c.applyMode(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM, c.mode);
        assertTrue(c.isActive());
        assertEquals("FX • Custom", c.badgeSummary());

        // Adjust a custom slider and switch back to Noise Suppression, then Custom
        c.noisePct = 75;
        c.onManualAdjustment();
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM, c.mode);

        c.applyMode(DspChain.Config.MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION, c.mode);
        assertEquals(50, c.noisePct);

        c.applyMode(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM, c.mode);
        assertEquals(75, c.noisePct);

        // 3) Custom -> Off -> Custom
        c.applyMode(DspChain.Config.MODE_OFF);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_OFF, c.mode);
        assertFalse(c.isActive());

        c.applyMode(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM, c.mode);
        assertEquals(75, c.noisePct);

        c.save(ctx);
        DspChain.Config loaded = DspChain.Config.load(ctx);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM, loaded.mode);
        assertEquals(75, loaded.noisePct);
    }

    @Test
    public void proFxRackPresetsCheckmarksAndDeletionWork() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.PODCAST_BROADCAST);
        assertTrue(cfg.isActive());
        assertTrue(cfg.enabledSlotCount() >= 5);

        // Unchecking all slots disables processing
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            s.enabled = false;
        }
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        assertFalse(cfg.isActive());

        // Adding a single slot enables it
        DspChain.EffectSlot added = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY);
        assertTrue(added.enabled);
        assertTrue(cfg.isActive());

        // Deleting the slot removes it from the rack
        cfg.removeSlot(added);
        assertFalse(cfg.isActive());
    }

    @Test
    public void allEightEffectsModifySignalWhenEnabled() {
        for (DspChain.EffectType type : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
            cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
            cfg.addOrFocusSlot(type);
            assertTrue("Effect " + type.id + " should be active", cfg.isActive());

            DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
            // A loud sustained tone keeps the physical noise gate fully open
            // (envelope >> threshold), which is gate-correct — feed the gate
            // a quiet tone below its threshold instead.
            float amp = (type == DspChain.EffectType.ROOM_GATE) ? 0.003f : 0.5f;
            // The de-esser only processes the 4.5–9.5 kHz sibilance band BY
            // DESIGN, so a low tone never moves it — feed it a bright 6 kHz
            // sibilant tone instead.
            float[] buf;
            if (type == DspChain.EffectType.DE_ESSER) {
                buf = new float[4800 * 2];
                for (int f = 0; f < 4800; f++) {
                    float s = (float) Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 6000.0
                            * f / 48000.0) * amp;
                    buf[f * 2] = s;
                    buf[f * 2 + 1] = s;
                }
            } else {
                buf = sine(4800, 2, amp);
            }
            float[] orig = buf.clone();
            chain.processInPlace(buf, 4800);
            boolean modified = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
                if (Math.abs(buf[i] - orig[i]) > 1e-4f) {
                    modified = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            assertTrue("Effect " + type.id + " produced no audio change", modified);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * Roadmap Phase 2 splice helpers: raised-cosine crossfades, edge fades and
 * zero-crossing snap that keep Trim/Cut/Punch-In click-free.
 */
public class DspSpliceTest {

    @Rule
    public TemporaryFolder tmp = new TemporaryFolder();

    @Test
    public void crossfadeBlendsOneToZero() {
        int frames = Dsp.CROSSFADE_FRAMES;
        float[] out = new float[frames];
        float[] in = new float[frames];
        float[] dst = new float[frames];
        Arrays.fill(out, 1f);
        Dsp.crossfadeFrames(out, 0, in, 0, dst, 0, frames, 1);
        assertTrue("head=" + dst[0], dst[0] > 0.99f);
        assertTrue("tail=" + dst[frames - 1], dst[frames - 1] < 0.01f);
        assertTrue("mid=" + dst[frames / 2],
                Math.abs(dst[frames / 2] - 0.5f) < 0.02f);
        for (int f = 1; f < frames; f++) {
            assertTrue("not monotonic at " + f, dst[f] <= dst[f - 1] + 1e-6f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void crossfadeStereoTracksMonoPerChannel() {
        int frames = 64;
        int ch = 2;
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        float[] in = new float[frames * ch];
        float[] dst = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int i = 0; i < out.length; i += 2) {
            out[i] = 1f;
            out[i + 1] = 0.5f;
        }
        Dsp.crossfadeFrames(out, 0, in, 0, dst, 0, frames, ch);
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            assertEquals(dst[f * 2] * 0.5f, dst[f * 2 + 1], 1e-6f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void fadeInAndOutShapeEdges() {
        int frames = 240;
        float[] up = new float[frames];
        Arrays.fill(up, 1f);
        Dsp.applyFadeInPlace(up, 0, frames, 1, true);
        assertTrue("fade-in head=" + up[0], up[0] < 0.01f);
        assertTrue("fade-in tail=" + up[frames - 1], up[frames - 1] > 0.99f);
        float[] down = new float[frames];
        Arrays.fill(down, 1f);
        Dsp.applyFadeInPlace(down, 0, frames, 1, false);
        assertTrue("fade-out head=" + down[0], down[0] > 0.99f);
        assertTrue("fade-out tail=" + down[frames - 1],
                down[frames - 1] < 0.01f);
    }

    private File loudWithGap(int frames, int gapStart, int gapEnd)
            throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile("snap.wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, (long) frames * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
                buf[i] = (i >= gapStart && i < gapEnd) ? 0f
                        : (float) Math.sin(i * 0.3) * 0.9f;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void snapHoldsPositionInSilence() throws Exception {
        int frames = 4800;
        File f = loudWithGap(frames, 2000, 2800);
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            // Target inside the silent gap: every candidate has zero energy,
            // so the closest frame to the target must win.
            assertEquals(2400L,
                    Dsp.snapToZeroCrossing(r, 44L, 1, 2400L, frames, 240));
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void snapPrefersNearbyZeroCrossing() throws Exception {
        int frames = 4800;
        File f = loudWithGap(frames, 2000, 2800);
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            // Target just outside the gap: a true zero crossing 4 frames
            // away must beat the silent gap 100 frames away.
            long snapped = Dsp.snapToZeroCrossing(r, 44L, 1, 1900L,
                    frames, 240);
            assertTrue("snapped=" + snapped,
                    snapped >= 1660 && snapped <= 2140);
            r.seek(44L + snapped * 4);
            byte[] b = new byte[4];
            r.readFully(b);
            float v = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(b)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).getFloat();
            assertTrue("energy=" + v, Math.abs(v) < 0.1f);
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void snapClampsEdges() throws Exception {
        int frames = 4800;
        File f = loudWithGap(frames, 2000, 2800);
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            assertEquals(0, Dsp.snapToZeroCrossing(r, 44L, 1, 0, frames, 240));
            assertEquals(0, Dsp.snapToZeroCrossing(r, 44L, 1, -5, frames, 240));
            assertEquals(frames,
                    Dsp.snapToZeroCrossing(r, 44L, 1, frames, frames, 240));
            assertEquals(frames, Dsp.snapToZeroCrossing(r, 44L, 1,
                    frames + 100, frames, 240));
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.util.Locale;

public class DspTest {

    @Rule
    public TemporaryFolder tmp = new TemporaryFolder();

    // ---- sanitize ----

    @Test
    public void sanitizeBasics() {
        assertEquals("Take", Dsp.sanitize(null));
        assertEquals("Take", Dsp.sanitize("   "));
        // Every illegal char becomes its own underscore (no collapsing).
        assertEquals("a_b_c_______", Dsp.sanitize("a/b\\c:*?\"<>|"));
        assertEquals("Hello World", Dsp.sanitize("  Hello   World  "));
    }

    @Test
    public void sanitizeTruncates() {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) sb.append('x');
        assertTrue(Dsp.sanitize(sb.toString()).length() <= 60);
    }

    // ---- prettyFileTitle ----

    @Test
    public void prettyStripsStampAndExt() {
        assertEquals("Take My Song",
                Dsp.prettyFileTitle("Take_My_Song_20261011_101500.wav"));
        assertEquals("Take My Song",
                Dsp.prettyFileTitle("Take_My_Song_20261011_101500 (2).m4a"));
        assertEquals("Voice Memo", Dsp.prettyFileTitle("Voice_Memo.m4a"));
        assertEquals("Take", Dsp.prettyFileTitle(null));
    }

    // ---- sizeLabel ----

    @Test
    public void sizeLabelMatchesHistory() {
        assertEquals("0.1 MB", Dsp.sizeLabel(0));
        assertEquals("4.1 MB", Dsp.sizeLabel((long) (4.1 * 1024 * 1024)));
    }

    // ---- WAV headers ----

    private static int u16(byte[] h, int off) {
        return ByteBuffer.wrap(h).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).getShort(off) & 0xFFFF;
    }

    private static int s32(byte[] h, int off) {
        return ByteBuffer.wrap(h).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).getInt(off);
    }

    @Test
    public void floatHeaderFields() {
        byte[] h = Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, 1000);
        assertEquals('R', h[0]);
        assertEquals('W', h[8]);
        assertEquals('d', h[36]);
        assertEquals(3, u16(h, 20)); // IEEE float
        assertEquals(2, u16(h, 22));
        assertEquals(48000, s32(h, 24));
        assertEquals(32, u16(h, 34));
        assertEquals(1000, s32(h, 40));
        assertEquals(44, h.length);
    }

    @Test
    public void wav16HeaderFields() {
        byte[] h = Dsp.wav16Header(1, 16000, 500);
        assertEquals(1, u16(h, 20)); // PCM
        assertEquals(1, u16(h, 22));
        assertEquals(16000, s32(h, 24));
        assertEquals(16, u16(h, 34));
        assertEquals(500, s32(h, 40));
        // blockAlign = channels * bytesPerSample
        assertEquals(2, u16(h, 32));
    }

    @Test
    public void wav24HeaderFields() {
        byte[] h = Dsp.wav24Header(2, 48000, 900);
        assertEquals('R', h[0]);
        assertEquals('W', h[8]);
        assertEquals('d', h[36]);
        assertEquals(1, u16(h, 20)); // integer PCM, not float
        assertEquals(2, u16(h, 22));
        assertEquals(48000, s32(h, 24));
        assertEquals(24, u16(h, 34));
        // 2 channels * 3 bytes = 6 byte frames; byte rate = rate * align.
        assertEquals(6, u16(h, 32));
        assertEquals(48000 * 6, s32(h, 28));
        assertEquals(900, s32(h, 40));
        assertEquals(44, h.length);
    }

    @Test
    public void pcmHeaderRejectsOddDepth() {
        // Only 16 and 24 are writable; anything else would produce a header
        // no editor could open.
        try {
            Dsp.wavPcmHeader(1, 48000, 20, 100);
            org.junit.Assert.fail("expected rejection of 20-bit PCM");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) {
            // correct
        }
    }

    // ---- FIR ----

    @Test
    public void firUnityGainAndSymmetric() {
        float[] h = Dsp.firLowpass(3400.0 / 48000.0, 64);
        assertEquals(64, h.length);
        double sum = 0;
        for (float v : h) sum += v;
        assertEquals(1.0, sum, 1e-6);
        for (int i = 0; i < h.length / 2; i++) {
            assertEquals(h[i], h[h.length - 1 - i], 1e-6f);
        }
    }

    // ---- wavDurationMs ----

    private File writeWav(boolean isFloat, int ch, int sr, int frames) throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile(isFloat ? "a.wav" : "b.wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        byte[] hdr = isFloat ? Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, sr, (long) frames * ch * 4)
                : Dsp.wav16Header(ch, sr, (long) frames * ch * 2);
        w.write(hdr);
        w.write(new byte[frames * ch * (isFloat ? 4 : 2)]);
        w.close();
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void wavDurationFloatStereo() throws Exception {
        // 48000 frames stereo @48k = exactly 1 second.
        assertEquals(1000, Dsp.wavDurationMs(writeWav(true, 2, 48000, 48000)));
    }

    @Test
    public void wavDurationPcm16Mono8k() throws Exception {
        assertEquals(2000, Dsp.wavDurationMs(writeWav(false, 1, 8000, 16000)));
    }

    @Test
    public void wavDurationPcm24() throws Exception {
        // 24-bit must resolve to the same duration as the equivalent file,
        // or every WAV24 export would show a wrong length in the library.
        File f = tmp.newFile("c24.wav");
        int frames = 24000; // 0.5s @ 48 kHz stereo
        byte[] h = Dsp.wav24Header(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 3);
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(h);
            w.write(new byte[frames * 2 * 3]);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        assertEquals(500, Dsp.wavDurationMs(f));
    }

    @Test
    public void wavDurationRejectsGarbage() throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile("x.wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        w.write(new byte[10]);
        w.close();
        assertEquals(-1, Dsp.wavDurationMs(f));
        assertEquals(-1, Dsp.wavDurationMs(new File(tmp.getRoot(), "nope.wav")));
    }

    // ---- trash ----

    private File writeBytes(File f, int len) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        w.write(new byte[len]);
        w.close();
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void trashRoundTrip() throws Exception {
        File takes = tmp.newFolder("takes");
        File src = writeBytes(new File(takes, "song.wav"), 100);
        File trashed = Dsp.moveToTrash(takes, src);
        assertTrue(trashed != null && trashed.exists());
        assertTrue(!src.exists());
        assertEquals(100, trashed.length());
        File back = new File(takes, "song.wav");
        assertTrue(Dsp.restoreFromTrashOk(trashed, back));
        assertTrue(back.exists() && !trashed.exists());
    }

    @Test
    public void trashUniquifies() throws Exception {
        File takes = tmp.newFolder("takes2");
        File a = writeBytes(new File(takes, "same.wav"), 10);
        File t1 = Dsp.moveToTrash(takes, a);
        File b = writeBytes(new File(takes, "same.wav"), 10);
        File t2 = Dsp.moveToTrash(takes, b);
        assertTrue(t1 != null && t2 != null && !t1.equals(t2));
    }

    @Test
    public void trashMoveMissingIsNull() throws Exception {
        File takes = tmp.newFolder("takes3");
        assertTrue(Dsp.moveToTrash(takes, new File(takes, "ghost.wav")) == null);
        assertTrue(Dsp.moveToTrash(takes, null) == null);
        assertTrue(!Dsp.restoreFromTrashOk(new File(takes, "ghost.wav"),
                new File(takes, "x.wav")));
    }

    @Test
    public void pruneTrashKeepsFreshKillsOld() throws Exception {
        File trash = tmp.newFolder("trash");
        File fresh = writeBytes(new File(trash, "fresh.wav"), 1000);
        File old = writeBytes(new File(trash, "old.wav"), 2000);
        assertTrue(old.setLastModified(System.currentTimeMillis() - 8L * 24 * 3600_000L));
        long freed = Dsp.pruneTrash(trash, 7L * 24 * 3600_000L);
        assertEquals(2000, freed);
        assertTrue(fresh.exists());
        assertTrue(!old.exists());
        assertEquals(0, Dsp.pruneTrash(null, 1));
    }

    @Test
    public void sanitizeNullAndBlank() {
        assertEquals("Take", Dsp.sanitize(null));
        assertEquals("Take", Dsp.sanitize("   "));
        // Illegal-only names become underscores, not the fallback.
        assertEquals("___", Dsp.sanitize("///"));
    }

    @Test
    public void prettyFileTitleNull() {
        assertEquals("Take", Dsp.prettyFileTitle(null));
        // No basename before the extension survives as-is.
        assertEquals(".wav", Dsp.prettyFileTitle(".wav"));
    }

    @Test
    public void sizeLabelBoundaries() {
        assertEquals("0.1 MB", Dsp.sizeLabel(0));
        assertEquals("0.1 MB", Dsp.sizeLabel(1024));
        // 1 MiB = 1048576 bytes -> 10 tenths -> "1.0 MB".
        assertEquals("1.0 MB", Dsp.sizeLabel(1048576));
        assertEquals("5.6 MB", Dsp.sizeLabel(5824512L));
    }

    @Test
    public void wavDurationMissingFileIsNegative() {
        assertEquals(-1, Dsp.wavDurationMs(new File(tmp.getRoot(), "nope.wav")));
    }

    @Test
    public void firLengthMatchesTaps() {
        float[] fir = Dsp.firLowpass(0.1, 32);
        assertEquals(32, fir.length);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;
import static org.junit.Assert.fail;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Roadmap Phase 3 splice engine: trim keeps exactly the selection, cut
 * removes it with a crossfaded bridge, undo restores byte-identical audio,
 * and DSP range commits preserve file geometry.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class EditEngineTest {

    @Rule
    public TemporaryFolder tmp = new TemporaryFolder();

    /** DC 0.5 mono: every frame has identical energy, so zero-crossing snap
     * lands exactly on the requested frame and lengths are deterministic. */
    private File dcRaw(String name, int frames) throws Exception {
        File f = new File(tmp.getRoot(), name);
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, (long) frames * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(buf, 0.5f);
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    private static byte[] bytesOf(File f) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            byte[] b = new byte[(int) r.length()];
            r.readFully(b);
            return b;
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    private static float sampleAt(File f, int frame) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            r.seek(44L + (long) frame * 4);
            byte[] b = new byte[4];
            r.readFully(b);
            return java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(b)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).getFloat();
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void cropKeepsExactlyTheSelection() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("crop.wav", 48000);
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo =
                new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        long kept = EditEngine.cropToSelection(raw, 4800, 9600, undo);
        assertEquals(4800L * 4, kept);
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
        assertEquals(4800L * 4, info.dataBytes);
        assertEquals(4800, info.dataBytes / 4 / info.channels);
        // Interior untouched by the 5 ms edge fades stays at DC level.
        assertEquals(0.5f, sampleAt(raw, 2400), 0.01f);
        assertTrue(undo.canUndo());
    }

    @Test
    public void cropRejectsTooShortSelection() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("short.wav", 48000);
        try {
            EditEngine.cropToSelection(raw, 100, 200,
                    new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot()));
            fail("expected IllegalArgumentException");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) {
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void deleteRemovesSelectionWithBridge() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("cut.wav", 48000);
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo =
                new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        long kept = EditEngine.deleteSelection(raw, 4800, 9600, undo);
        // 4800 deleted frames + 240 crossfade-bridge frames are consumed.
        assertEquals((48000L - 4800 - Dsp.CROSSFADE_FRAMES) * 4, kept);
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
        assertEquals(kept, info.dataBytes);
        // DC spliced to DC stays DC across the cut boundary.
        assertEquals(0.5f, sampleAt(raw, 4700), 0.02f);
        assertTrue(undo.canUndo());
    }

    @Test
    public void deleteRejectsWholeTake() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("whole.wav", 48000);
        try {
            EditEngine.deleteSelection(raw, 0, 48000,
                    new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot()));
            fail("expected IllegalArgumentException");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) {
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void undoRestoresByteIdenticalAudio() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("undo.wav", 48000);
        byte[] before = bytesOf(raw);
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo =
                new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        EditEngine.cropToSelection(raw, 4800, 9600, undo);
        assertTrue(undo.canUndo());
        assertTrue(undo.undo(raw));
        assertFalse(undo.canUndo());
        byte[] after = bytesOf(raw);
        assertEquals(before.length, after.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < before.length; i++) {
            if (before[i] != after[i]) fail("byte differs at " + i);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void undoJournalIsBoundedToThreeSteps() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("bounded.wav", 48000);
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo =
                new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) undo.recordSnapshot(raw);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) assertTrue(undo.undo(raw));
        assertFalse(undo.canUndo());
    }

    @Test
    public void inactiveDspRangeIsNoOpWithoutSnapshot() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("noop.wav", 48000);
        byte[] before = bytesOf(raw);
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo =
                new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(raw, 0, 4800,
                new DspChain(1, new DspChain.Config()), undo);
        assertFalse(undo.canUndo());
        byte[] after = bytesOf(raw);
        assertEquals(before.length, after.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < before.length; i++) {
            if (before[i] != after[i]) fail("byte differs at " + i);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void activeDspRangeKeepsGeometry() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("dsp.wav", 48000);
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo =
                new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(raw, 0, 4800,
                new DspChain(1, DspChain.Config.voicePolish()), undo);
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
        assertEquals(48000L * 4, info.dataBytes);
        assertTrue(undo.canUndo());
        float mid = sampleAt(raw, 2400);
        assertTrue("non-finite " + mid, Float.isFinite(mid));
        assertTrue("unbounded " + mid, Math.abs(mid) <= 1.0f);
    }

    @Test
    public void variableLengthSelectAndReplaceHandlesShorterAndLongerSegments()
            throws Exception {
        // 1) Create 48,000-frame take (1.0s @ 48 kHz mono)
        File raw = dcRaw("replace_var.wav", 48000);
        File tail = new File(tmp.getRoot(), "replace_var.reptail");
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo = new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        undo.recordSnapshot(raw);

        // Save tail [30000, 48000) (18,000 frames) for replacing [10000, 30000)
        long savedTailFrames = EditEngine.saveTailFrom(raw, 30000, tail);
        assertEquals(18000L, savedTailFrames);

        // Case A: Shorter replacement — user records 5,000 frames starting at 10,000
        // (so replaceEndFrame = 15,000 instead of 30,000)
        long newBytesShort = EditEngine.spliceTailAfterReplace(raw, 15000, tail);
        long expectedFramesShort = 15000L + 18000L - Dsp.CROSSFADE_FRAMES;
        assertEquals(expectedFramesShort * 4L, newBytesShort);

        // Restore via Undo and test Case B: Longer replacement (35,000 frames
        // recorded from 10,000 -> replaceEndFrame = 45,000)
        assertTrue(undo.undo(raw));
        EditEngine.saveTailFrom(raw, 30000, tail);
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw")) {
            raf.seek(44L + 10000L * 4L);
            float[] longerRec = new float[35000];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(longerRec, 0.75f);
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(raf, longerRec, 0, longerRec.length);
            raf.seek(0);
            raf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 45000L * 4L));
        }
        long newBytesLong = EditEngine.spliceTailAfterReplace(raw, 45000, tail);
        long expectedFramesLong = 45000L + 18000L - Dsp.CROSSFADE_FRAMES;
        assertEquals(expectedFramesLong * 4L, newBytesLong);
        assertEquals(0.75f, sampleAt(raw, 25000), 0.01f);
        assertEquals(0.5f, sampleAt(raw, (int) expectedFramesLong - 1000), 0.01f);
    }

    @Test
    public void applyDspChangesOnlyTheCommittedRange() throws Exception {
        // 440 Hz sine: voice polish must audibly reshape it, but only
        // inside the committed range — the rest stays bit-identical.
        File f = new File(tmp.getRoot(), "sine.wav");
        int frames = 48000;
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, (long) frames * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
                buf[i] = (float) Math.sin(
                        i * 2 * Math.PI * 440 / 48000) * 0.7f;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        byte[] before = bytesOf(f);
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo =
                new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(f, 0, 4800,
                new DspChain(1, DspChain.Config.voicePolish()), undo);
        byte[] after = bytesOf(f);
        assertEquals(before.length, after.length);
        assertTrue(undo.canUndo());
        int changed = 0;
        for (int i = 44; i < 44 + 4800 * 4; i++) {
            if (before[i] != after[i]) changed++;
        }
        assertTrue("FX changed nothing in range", changed > 4800);
        for (int i = 44 + 4800 * 4; i < after.length; i++) {
            if (before[i] != after[i]) fail("touched outside range at " + i);
        }
    }
}
