package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * EditLink stash contract (NEW-06): both the studio pre-prompt and the
 * notification save path rely on save/match/id/title/clear.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class EditLinkTest {

    private android.content.Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    @Test
    public void saveMatchAndClearBehave() {
        EditLink.clear(ctx());
        assertFalse(EditLink.matches(ctx(), "/takes/a.wav"));
        EditLink.save(ctx(), 42L, "Original", "/takes/a.wav");
        assertTrue(EditLink.matches(ctx(), "/takes/a.wav"));
        assertFalse(EditLink.matches(ctx(), "/takes/b.wav"));
        assertFalse(EditLink.matches(ctx(), null));
        assertEquals(42L, EditLink.id(ctx()));
        assertEquals("Original", EditLink.title(ctx()));
        EditLink.clear(ctx());
        assertFalse(EditLink.matches(ctx(), "/takes/a.wav"));
        assertEquals(-1L, EditLink.id(ctx()));
    }
}


=================================================================================
FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/FlacHeaderTest.java
=================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;
import static org.junit.Assert.fail;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * FLAC stream-header correctness (FMT-01) and container validation (FMT-03).
 *
 * <p>The old writer emitted 0x90 (metadata block type 16, reserved) and
 * copied STREAMINFO from offset 0 of csd-0 even though Android's encoder
 * prefixes it with "fLaC" + a block header. The result was a file every
 * Android extractor rejected.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class FlacHeaderTest {

    /** 34-byte STREAMINFO describing 48 kHz / 2ch / 32-bit. */
    private static byte[] streamInfo(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        byte[] si = new byte[34];
        ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.wrap(si).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN);
        b.putShort((short) 4096);    // min block size
        b.putShort((short) 4096);    // max block size
        si[10] = (byte) ((sampleRate >>> 12) & 0xFF);
        si[11] = (byte) ((sampleRate >>> 4) & 0xFF);
        si[12] = (byte) (((sampleRate & 0x0F) << 4)
                | (((channels - 1) & 0x07) << 1));
        si[13] = (byte) (((channels - 1) & 0x01) << 7); // bps=0
        return si;
    }

    @Test
    public void writesStreamInfoHeaderNotReservedType() throws Exception {
        byte[] si = streamInfo(48000, 2);
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        FormatConverter.FlacHeader.write(out, si);
        byte[] f = out.toByteArray();

        assertEquals(42, f.length);
        assertEquals('f', f[0]);
        assertEquals('L', f[1]);
        assertEquals('a', f[2]);
        assertEquals('C', f[3]);
        // 0x80 = last-metadata-block set + type 0 (STREAMINFO). Never 0x90.
        assertEquals("metadata block header must be 0x80",
                (byte) 0x80, f[4]);
        assertEquals(0, f[5]);
        assertEquals(0, f[6]);
        assertEquals(34, f[7]);
        // The payload must not repeat the magic.
        assertFalse(f[8] == 'f' && f[9] == 'L' && f[10] == 'a'
                && f[11] == 'C');
        assertEquals(48000, FormatConverter.FlacHeader.sampleRate(
                java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(f, 8, 42)));
        assertTrue(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(f));
    }

    @Test
    public void extractsStreamInfoFromAllCsdShapes() {
        byte[] si = streamInfo(48000, 2);
        // Shape 1: bare STREAMINFO.
        ByteBuffer bare = ByteBuffer.allocate(34).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN);
        bare.put(si).flip();
        assertNotNull(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(bare));
        assertEquals(48000, FormatConverter.FlacHeader.sampleRate(
                FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(bare)));

        // Shape 2: block header + STREAMINFO (38 bytes).
        ByteBuffer hdr = ByteBuffer.allocate(38);
        hdr.put(new byte[]{(byte) 0x80, 0, 0, 34}).put(si).flip();
        byte[] got2 = FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(hdr);
        assertNotNull(got2);
        assertEquals(48000, FormatConverter.FlacHeader.sampleRate(got2));

        // Shape 3: "fLaC" + block header + STREAMINFO (42 bytes) — the
        // shape Android's C2 FLAC encoder actually emits.
        ByteBuffer full = ByteBuffer.allocate(42);
        full.put(new byte[]{'f', 'L', 'a', 'C', (byte) 0x80, 0, 0, 34})
                .put(si).flip();
        byte[] got3 = FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(full);
        assertNotNull("42-byte csd-0 was not understood", got3);
        assertEquals(48000, FormatConverter.FlacHeader.sampleRate(got3));
        // Crucially the sample rate must not be 0 (a 'fLaC'-prefixed buffer
        // read from offset 0 would decode garbage here).
        assertEquals(0, got3.length == 0 ? -1 : 0);
    }

    @Test
    public void csdPositionIsNotConsumed() {
        byte[] si = streamInfo(48000, 2);
        ByteBuffer full = ByteBuffer.allocate(42);
        full.put(new byte[]{'f', 'L', 'a', 'C', (byte) 0x80, 0, 0, 34})
                .put(si).flip();
        int before = full.position();
        FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(full);
        assertEquals("csd-0 position must be restored", before,
                full.position());
    }

    @Test
    public void totalSamplesIsPatchedIntoStreamInfo() throws Exception {
        File f = File.createTempFile("flac", ".flac");
        try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            FormatConverter.FlacHeader.write(out, streamInfo(48000, 2));
            try (RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw")) {
                w.write(out.toByteArray());
                FormatConverter.FlacHeader.patchTotalSamples(w, 96000L);
            }
            try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r")) {
                byte[] h = new byte[42];
                r.readFully(h);
                // 36-bit field: low nibble of file byte 21, then 22..25.
                long total = ((h[21] & 0x0FL) << 32)
                        | ((h[22] & 0xFFL) << 24)
                        | ((h[23] & 0xFFL) << 16)
                        | ((h[24] & 0xFFL) << 8)
                        | (h[25] & 0xFFL);
                assertEquals(96000L, total);
                // The rate must survive the patch.
                assertEquals(48000, ((h[18] & 0xFF) << 12)
                        | ((h[19] & 0xFF) << 4) | ((h[20] & 0xF0) >>> 4));
            }
        } finally {
            //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void validHeadRejectsReservedTypeAndZeroRate() {
        byte[] good;
        try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            FormatConverter.FlacHeader.write(out, streamInfo(48000, 2));
            good = out.toByteArray();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            fail(e.toString());
            return;
        }
        assertTrue(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(good));

        byte[] reserved = good.clone();
        reserved[4] = (byte) 0x90;
        assertFalse("0x90 must be rejected",
                FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(reserved));

        byte[] zeroRate = good.clone();
        zeroRate[18] = 0;
        zeroRate[19] = 0;
        zeroRate[20] &= (byte) 0x0F;
        assertFalse("0 Hz sample rate must be rejected",
                FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(zeroRate));

        byte[] shortLen = good.clone();
        shortLen[7] = 33;
        assertFalse(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(shortLen));

        assertFalse(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(new byte[10]));
        assertNull(null);
    }
}


=================================================================================
FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/FxCommitAndCrossfadeTest.java
=================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.RuntimeEnvironment;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Stage 1 FX-commit audit fixes: the seam crossfades must use GLOBAL frame
 * offsets so a multi-chunk range neither repeats the head fade on every 4096-
 * frame chunk nor drops a tail fade that straddles a chunk boundary, and they
 * must be skipped entirely at the file edges (a whole-take bake has nothing to
 * crossfade toward). Also covers dispatchSave() baking an unbaked chain when
 * the save arrives from the notification path.
 *
 * <p>The brickwall limiter at drive 100 is a deterministic per-sample gain
 * (fastDbToLin(10.5) ≈ 3.35x) with no clamping below the 0.82 ceiling, so the
 * tests can assert exact dry/wet blends instead of heuristics.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class FxCommitAndCrossfadeTest {

    /** Session rate the engine writes WAV headers at (48 kHz). */
    private static final int SR = 48000;

    /** Deterministic wet gain of the brickwall limiter at drive 100. */
    private static final float LIMITER_GAIN = DspChain.fastDbToLin(10.5f);

    private static File writeSineWav(File dir, String name, int frames,
                                     int channels, float amp) throws Exception {
        File f = new File(dir, name);
        long dataBytes = (long) frames * channels * 4L;
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw")) {
            raf.setLength(0);
            raf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(channels, SR, dataBytes));
            float[] buf = new float[frames * channels];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
                float s = (float) (amp
                        * Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 440.0 * i / SR));
                for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                    buf[i * channels + c] = s;
                }
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(raf, buf, 0, buf.length);
        }
        return f;
    }

    private static float[] readAllSamples(File wav, int frames, int channels)
            throws Exception {
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(wav);
        byte[] raw = new byte[frames * channels * 4];
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(wav, "r")) {
            raf.seek(info.dataStart);
            raf.readFully(raw);
        }
        float[] out = new float[frames * channels];
        ByteBuffer.wrap(raw).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                .asFloatBuffer().get(out);
        return out;
    }

    /** Limiter-only chain: a pure per-sample gain, no filter or AGC state. */
    private static DspChain limiterChain() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER, true, 100, false));
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        return new DspChain(1, cfg);
    }

    @Test
    public void fullRangeApplyProcessesEntireFileWithoutBoundaryFadeArtifacts()
            throws Exception {
        File dir = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication().getCacheDir();
        int totalFrames = 2400;
        File wav = writeSineWav(dir, "fx_full.wav", totalFrames, 1, 0.25f);
        float[] before = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.VOICE_POLISH);
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);

        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(wav, 0, totalFrames, chain, null);
        float[] after = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        double diffEnergy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < totalFrames; i++) {
            double d = after[i] - before[i];
            diffEnergy += d * d;
        }
        assertTrue("Full-take FX bake should modify audio samples",
                diffEnergy > 1e-3);
    }

    @Test
    public void subRangeApplyCrossfadesCleanlyAtBothBoundaries() throws Exception {
        File dir = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication().getCacheDir();
        int totalFrames = 4000;
        File wav = writeSineWav(dir, "fx_sub.wav", totalFrames, 1, 0.20f);
        float[] before = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        DspChain chain = limiterChain();

        int start = 1000;
        int end = 3000;
        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(wav, start, end, chain, null);
        float[] after = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < start; i++) {
            assertEquals("Pre-selection sample mutated at " + i,
                    before[i], after[i], 1e-6f);
        }
        for (int i = end; i < totalFrames; i++) {
            assertEquals("Post-selection sample mutated at " + i,
                    before[i], after[i], 1e-6f);
        }
        // The first/last frames of an interior range sit at the dry end of
        // their raised-cosine fades (u=0 and u=1), so they must be untouched.
        assertEquals("Start seam frame must start at dry level",
                before[start], after[start], 1e-5f);
        assertEquals("End seam frame must land at dry level",
                before[end - 1], after[end - 1], 1e-5f);

        float stepStart = Math.abs(after[start] - after[start - 1]);
        float stepEnd = Math.abs(after[end] - after[end - 1]);
        assertTrue("Start boundary step too large: " + stepStart,
                stepStart < 0.05f);
        assertTrue("End boundary step too large: " + stepEnd,
                stepEnd < 0.05f);
    }

    @Test
    public void multiChunkSelectionDoesNotRepeatHeadFadeOrDropStraddledTailFade()
            throws Exception {
        File dir = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication().getCacheDir();
        // Selection length 8292 = 4096 * 2 + 100: spans three chunks, and the
        // final chunk holds only 100 frames so the 240-frame tail fade
        // straddles chunk 1 (140 frames) and chunk 2 (100 frames).
        int totalFrames = 12000;
        int start = 1000;
        int end = start + 8292;
        File wav = writeSineWav(dir, "fx_multichunk.wav", totalFrames, 1, 0.20f);
        float[] before = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(wav, start, end, limiterChain(), null);
        float[] after = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        // 1. Chunk 1's head must be pure wet. The old local-index loop re-ran
        //    the head fade on every chunk, stamping origHead[0] (= before[start])
        //    over chunk 1's first 240 frames; the fixed global-offset code
        //    touches only [start, start + 240).
        int chunk1Start = start + 4096;
        assertEquals("Chunk 1 head must be pure wet (no repeated head fade)",
                LIMITER_GAIN * before[chunk1Start], after[chunk1Start], 2e-3f);
        assertTrue("Head fade must not stamp the original head onto chunk 1",
                Math.abs(after[chunk1Start] - before[start]) > 0.2f);

        // 2. The straddled tail fade must keep blending on the final chunk
        //    instead of being dropped: frame end-120 sits at u = 120/239 of the
        //    fade, so it must be an exact dry/wet blend, not pure wet.
        int fMid = 120;
        float uMid = fMid / 239f;
        float gDryMid = 0.5f * (1f - (float) Math.cos(Math.PI * uMid));
        float expectedMid = before[end - 240 + fMid] * gDryMid
                + LIMITER_GAIN * before[end - 240 + fMid] * (1f - gDryMid);
        assertEquals("Straddled tail fade must blend mid-window, not drop",
                expectedMid, after[end - 240 + fMid], 2e-3f);

        // 3. The very last frame of the range lands at the dry end of the fade.
        assertEquals("Straddled tail seam must land at dry level at end - 1",
                before[end - 1], after[end - 1], 1e-5f);
        float stepEnd = Math.abs(after[end] - after[end - 1]);
        assertTrue("End boundary step across straddled tail fade too large: "
                + stepEnd, stepEnd < 0.05f);

        // 4. Everything outside the selection is bit-identical.
        for (int i = 0; i < start; i++) {
            assertEquals("Pre-selection sample mutated at " + i,
                    before[i], after[i], 1e-6f);
        }
        for (int i = end; i < totalFrames; i++) {
            assertEquals("Post-selection sample mutated at " + i,
                    before[i], after[i], 1e-6f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void veryShortSelectionShrinksFadesAndKeepsGeometry() throws Exception {
        File dir = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication().getCacheDir();
        int totalFrames = 6000;
        File wav = writeSineWav(dir, "fx_short.wav", totalFrames, 1, 0.20f);
        float[] before = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        // 100 frames is below one crossfade window: the fades must shrink to
        // half the range instead of reading past it or writing outside it.
        int start = 2000;
        int end = 2100;
        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(wav, start, end, limiterChain(), null);
        float[] after = readAllSamples(wav, totalFrames, 1);

        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(wav);
        assertEquals("Geometry must be untouched",
                (long) totalFrames * 4L, info.dataBytes);
        assertEquals("Audio before a short range must not move",
                before[start - 1], after[start - 1], 1e-6f);
        assertEquals("Audio after a short range must not move",
                before[end], after[end], 1e-6f);
        // A 50-frame fade still lands dry at the range edges.
        assertEquals("Short-range head edge stays dry",
                before[start], after[start], 1e-5f);
        assertEquals("Short-range tail edge stays dry",
                before[end - 1], after[end - 1], 1e-5f);
    }

    @Test
    public void fxBakeRequiredFlagInvalidatesStreamingAdoptionAndBakesRawOnSave()
            throws Exception {
        android.content.Context ctx = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication();
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();

        // Persist an active chain exactly as the studio would, so
        // dispatchSave()'s notification-path bake sees it via Config.load().
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER, true, 100, false));
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        cfg.save(ctx);

        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "FxBakeTest", 1);
        assertFalse("fresh session has no pending FX bake",
                engine.isFxBakeRequired());

        int frames = 2400;
        float[] rawSamples = new float[frames];
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            rawSamples[i] = (float) (0.15
                    * Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 440.0 * i / SR));
        }
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(engine.rawFile, "rw")) {
            raf.setLength(0);
            raf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, SR, (long) frames * 4L));
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(raf, rawSamples, 0, rawSamples.length);
        }
        engine.dataBytes = (long) frames * 4L;
        float[] before = readAllSamples(engine.rawFile, frames, 1);

        engine.setFxBakeRequired(true);
        assertTrue(engine.isFxBakeRequired());

        ConversionJobs.SaveResult res = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                ctx, RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV24, null);
        assertFalse("Unbaked FX must not adopt a dry streaming .part",
                res.adopted);
        assertFalse("dispatchSave must clear fxBakeRequired after baking raw",
                engine.isFxBakeRequired());

        float[] after = readAllSamples(engine.rawFile, frames, 1);
        double diffEnergy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            double d = after[i] - before[i];
            diffEnergy += d * d;
        }
        assertTrue("dispatchSave must bake the active chain into raw when "
                + "fxBakeRequired (notification-save path)", diffEnergy > 1e-2);

        if (res.job != null) {
            ConversionJobs.cancel(res.job.jobId, true);
        }
        engine.abortAndDelete();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * Stage 2 modular-rack contract: the refactored {@link FxRackChain} must
 * reproduce the legacy {@code DspChain} engine bit-for-bit, reorder/bypass/wet
 * -dry must behave exactly as documented, and multi-parameter state must
 * survive JSON and SharedPreferences round-trips.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class FxRackChainTest {

    private static float[] tone(int frames, int ch, float amp, float step) {
        float[] buf = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) Math.sin(f * step) * amp;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return buf;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- parity

    @Test
    public void rackIsBitIdenticalToLegacyEngineOnEveryStage() {
        // Podcast preset exercises all 8 effect types (warmth+presence share
        // the tone stage), so every legacy stage runs in one pass.
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.PODCAST_BROADCAST);
        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE);
        // 4801 frames is not divisible by the 16-frame stage block, so the
        // final partial block (1 frame) is compared too.
        final int frames = 4801;
        final int ch = 2;

        LegacyRef ref = new LegacyRef();
        ref.updateConfig(cfg);
        float[] a = tone(frames, ch, 0.85f, 0.017f);
        // Sprinkle sibilance so the de-esser sidechain actually engages.
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f += 7) {
            float s = (float) Math.sin(f * 1.9) * 0.6f;
            a[f * ch] = s;
            a[f * ch + 1] = s;
        }
        float[] b = a.clone();
        ref.process(a, frames, ch);

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(ch, cfg);
        assertTrue(chain.isActive());
        chain.processInPlace(b, frames);

        assertEquals("different length", a.length, b.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            assertEquals("bit divergence @" + i,
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(a[i]),
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(b[i]));
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void rackMatchesLegacyAfterLiveConfigUpdate() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.VOICE_POLISH);
        final int frames = 1023;
        final int ch = 2;

        LegacyRef ref = new LegacyRef();
        ref.updateConfig(cfg);
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(ch, cfg);

        float[] a = tone(frames, ch, 0.7f, 0.031f);
        float[] b = a.clone();
        ref.process(a, frames, ch);
        chain.processInPlace(b, frames);
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            assertEquals("block 1 diverged @" + i,
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(a[i]),
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(b[i]));
        }

        // Live edit: push a new cutoff/amounts into BOTH engines mid-stream
        // (this is what the FX panel's TeleValue scrub does).
        DspChain.Config live = new DspChain.Config();
        live.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.NOISY_ROOM);
        ref.updateConfig(live);
        chain.updateConfig(live);

        float[] c = tone(frames, ch, 0.4f, 0.021f);
        float[] d = c.clone();
        ref.process(c, frames, ch);
        chain.processInPlace(d, frames);
        for (int i = 0; i < c.length; i++) {
            assertEquals("block 2 diverged @" + i,
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(c[i]),
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(d[i]));
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void inactiveLegacyConfigLeavesBufferUntouched() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        FxRackChain rack = chain.getRack();
        assertNotNull(rack);
        assertFalse(rack.isActive());
        float[] buf = tone(777, 2, 0.9f, 0.05f);
        float[] before = buf.clone();
        rack.processInPlace(buf, 777);
        for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
            assertEquals(before[i], buf[i], 0.0f);
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------- rack mechanics

    @Test
    public void moveProcessorReordersRackAndGuardsBounds() {
        FxRackChain rack = new FxRackChain(2);
        rack.addProcessor(new LegacyHpfProcessor());
        rack.addProcessor(new LegacyNoiseProcessor());
        rack.addProcessor(new LegacyGateProcessor());
        assertEquals("hpf", rack.getProcessor(0).getId());
        assertEquals("noise", rack.getProcessor(1).getId());
        assertEquals("gate", rack.getProcessor(2).getId());

        assertTrue(rack.moveProcessor(0, 2));
        assertEquals("noise", rack.getProcessor(0).getId());
        assertEquals("gate", rack.getProcessor(1).getId());
        assertEquals("hpf", rack.getProcessor(2).getId());
        assertEquals(0, rack.indexOf("noise"));
        assertEquals(2, rack.indexOf("hpf"));

        assertFalse(rack.moveProcessor(0, 0));
        assertFalse(rack.moveProcessor(-1, 0));
        assertFalse(rack.moveProcessor(0, 99));
        assertFalse(rack.moveProcessor(2, 99));
        assertEquals(3, rack.size());

        assertEquals("hpf", rack.removeProcessor(2).getId());
        assertEquals(2, rack.size());
        assertNull(rack.removeProcessor(5));
    }

    @Test
    public void bypassedProcessorLeavesSignalBitIdentical() {
        final int frames = 512;
        float[] input = tone(frames, 2, 0.8f, 0.04f);

        LegacyNoiseProcessor noise = new LegacyNoiseProcessor();
        noise.setLegacyAmount(80);
        assertTrue(noise.isAudible());

        FxRackChain rack = new FxRackChain(2);
        rack.addProcessor(noise);
        assertTrue(rack.isActive());

        float[] wet = input.clone();
        rack.processInPlace(wet, frames);
        boolean changed = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < wet.length; i++) {
            if (Float.compare(wet[i], input[i]) != 0) {
                changed = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        assertTrue("enabled noise stage did nothing", changed);

        noise.setEnabled(false);
        assertFalse(noise.isAudible());
        assertFalse(rack.isActive());
        float[] dry = input.clone();
        rack.processInPlace(dry, frames);
        for (int i = 0; i < dry.length; i++) {
            assertEquals("bypassed stage touched @" + i,
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(input[i]),
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(dry[i]));
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void wetDryMixBlendsExactlyHalfAndHalf() {
        final int frames = 256;
        float[] input = tone(frames, 2, 0.9f, 0.037f);

        LegacyToneProcessor wetProc = new LegacyToneProcessor();
        wetProc.setLegacyAmounts(70, 60);
        FxRackChain wetRack = new FxRackChain(2);
        wetRack.addProcessor(wetProc);
        float[] wet = input.clone();
        wetRack.processInPlace(wet, frames);

        LegacyToneProcessor halfProc = new LegacyToneProcessor();
        halfProc.setLegacyAmounts(70, 60);
        halfProc.setWetDryMix(0.5f);
        FxRackChain halfRack = new FxRackChain(2);
        halfRack.addProcessor(halfProc);
        float[] half = input.clone();
        halfRack.processInPlace(half, frames);

        for (int i = 0; i < half.length; i++) {
            float expected = input[i] * 0.5f + wet[i] * 0.5f;
            assertEquals("blend mismatch @" + i,
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(expected),
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(half[i]));
        }

        // A zero mix is a pure dry pass.
        LegacyToneProcessor offProc = new LegacyToneProcessor();
        offProc.setLegacyAmounts(70, 60);
        offProc.setWetDryMix(0f);
        FxRackChain offRack = new FxRackChain(2);
        offRack.addProcessor(offProc);
        float[] off = input.clone();
        offRack.processInPlace(off, frames);
        for (int i = 0; i < off.length; i++) {
            assertEquals("zero mix touched @" + i,
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(input[i]),
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(off[i]));
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void jsonRoundTripPreservesOrderEnableMixAndParams() throws Exception {
        FxRackChain rack = FxRackChain.fromLegacyConfig(2,
                DspChain.Config.voicePolish());
        AudioProcessor hpf = rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("hpf"));
        AudioProcessor noise = rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("noise"));
        assertNotNull(hpf);
        assertNotNull(noise);
        hpf.setWetDryMix(0.25f);
        noise.setEnabled(false);
        noise.getParam("amt").setCurrentRaw(77);
        rack.addProcessor(FxRackChain.createProcessor("limiter"));

        JSONObject json = rack.toJson();
        FxRackChain back = FxRackChain.fromJson(2, json);

        assertEquals(rack.size(), back.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < rack.size(); i++) {
            AudioProcessor a = rack.getProcessor(i);
            AudioProcessor b = back.getProcessor(i);
            assertNotNull("missing " + a.getId(), b);
            assertEquals(a.getId(), b.getId());
            assertEquals("enabled " + a.getId(),
                    a.isEnabled(), b.isEnabled());
            assertEquals("mix " + a.getId(),
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(a.getWetDryMix()),
                    Float.floatToRawIntBits(b.getWetDryMix()));
            for (FxParameter pa : a.getParameters()) {
                FxParameter pb = b.getParam(pa.id);
                assertNotNull("missing param " + pa.id, pb);
                assertEquals("raw " + pa.id,
                        pa.getCurrentRaw(), pb.getCurrentRaw());
            }
        }
        assertEquals(0.25f,
                back.getProcessor(back.indexOf("hpf")).getWetDryMix(), 0.0f);
        assertFalse(back.getProcessor(back.indexOf("noise")).isEnabled());
        assertEquals(77, back.getProcessor(back.indexOf("noise"))
                .getParam("amt").getCurrentRaw());
    }

    }

    @Test
    public void slotWetDryAndExtraParamsPersist() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.VOICE_POLISH);
        DspChain.EffectSlot noise = null;

    @Test
    public void slotWetDryDrivesProcessorMixThroughUpdateConfig() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.VOICE_POLISH);
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION) {
                s.wetDry = 0.25f;
            }
        }
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        AudioProcessor noise =
                chain.getRack().getProcessor(chain.getRack().indexOf("noise"));
        assertEquals(0.25f, noise.getWetDryMix(), 0.0f);

        // Live edit path: the FX inspector mutates the slot and calls
        // updateConfig, which must re-push the mix.
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION) {
                s.wetDry = 0.75f;
            }
        }
        chain.updateConfig(cfg);
        assertEquals(0.75f, noise.getWetDryMix(), 0.0f);
    }

    @Test
    public void warmthAndPresenceShareOneToneProcessorWithoutSlotMix() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.WARM_VOCAL);
        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE);
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        FxRackChain rack = chain.getRack();

        // Both slots map to the single combined tone stage, which stays fully
        // wet regardless of slot mixes.
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            s.wetDry = 0.1f;
        }
        chain.updateConfig(cfg);
        AudioProcessor toneProc = rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("tone"));
        assertEquals(1.0f, toneProc.getWetDryMix(), 0.0f);
        assertTrue(toneProc.isAudible());
    }

    @Test
    public void limiterActsAsSafetyCeilingForGainStagesAlone() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        FxRackChain rack = chain.getRack();
        AudioProcessor limiter =
                rack.getProcessor(rack.indexOf("limiter"));
        assertNotNull(limiter);
        // Compressor alone must arm the safety limiter even at drive 0.
        assertTrue(limiter.isEnabled());
        assertTrue(limiter.isAudible());

        // A loud tone is soft-clipped by the 0.82 ceiling after makeup gain.
        float[] buf = new float[960];
        for (int f = 0; f < buf.length; f++) {
            buf[f] = 0.95f * (float) Math.sin(f * 0.11);
        }
        chain.processInPlace(buf, 960);
        for (float v : buf) {
            assertTrue(Float.isFinite(v));
            assertTrue("unbounded " + v, Math.abs(v) < 1.02f);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ live state

    @Test
    public void liveConfigUpdatePreservesFilterState() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.VOICE_POLISH);
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        float[] warm = tone(2048, 1, 0.8f, 0.043f);
        chain.processInPlace(warm, 2048);

        // Change the HPF cutoff live: coefficients update, but the biquad's
        // z-history must survive (the original engine never reset state).
        DspChain.Config next = new DspChain.Config();
        next.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        next.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF);
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : next.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.LOW_CUT_HPF) s.value = 150;
        }
        chain.updateConfig(next);

        float[] hot = tone(256, 1, 0.8f, 0.043f);
        float[] carried = hot.clone();
        chain.processInPlace(carried, 256);

        DspChain fresh = new DspChain(1, next);
        float[] cold = hot.clone();
        fresh.processInPlace(cold, 256);

        // Fresh chain starts from zero z-state, so a live update that kept
        // state MUST differ (unless the signal is silent, which it is not).
        boolean anyDiff = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < carried.length; i++) {
            if (Float.compare(carried[i], cold[i]) != 0) {
                anyDiff = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        assertTrue("live update reset the filter state", anyDiff);
        for (float v : carried) assertTrue(Float.isFinite(v));
    }


    // ----------------------------------------- Stage 2 audit regression tests

    @Test
    public void slotReorderingChangesRackExecutionOrderAndAudioOutput() {
        // BUG-01 regression: reordering cfg.slots must reorder rack processors
        // and produce distinct audio when nonlinear stages change order.
        DspChain.Config cfgA = new DspChain.Config();
        cfgA.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        cfgA.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY);
        cfgA.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfgA.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY) s.value = 85;
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR) s.value = 85;
        }
        DspChain chainA = new DspChain(1, cfgA);
        assertTrue(chainA.getRack().indexOf("tone")
                < chainA.getRack().indexOf("comp"));

        // Swap slot order in-place (Compressor BEFORE Warmth) and call updateConfig
        DspChain.Config cfgB = new DspChain.Config();
        cfgB.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        cfgB.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        cfgB.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY);
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfgB.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY) s.value = 85;
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR) s.value = 85;
        }
        DspChain chainB = new DspChain(1, cfgB);
        assertTrue(chainB.getRack().indexOf("comp")
                < chainB.getRack().indexOf("tone"));

        float[] sigA = tone(1024, 1, 0.6f, 0.05f);
        float[] sigB = sigA.clone();
        chainA.processInPlace(sigA, 1024);
        chainB.processInPlace(sigB, 1024);

        boolean diff = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < sigA.length; i++) {
            if (Math.abs(sigA[i] - sigB[i]) > 1e-4f) {
                diff = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        assertTrue("Reordering compressor before tone had no effect on audio", diff);
    }

    @Test
    public void primarySlotParamCannotBeOverwrittenByStaleExtraParams() {
        // BUG-02 regression: LegacyLimiterProcessor's primary "drive" param
        // must be driven by slot.value and never clobbered by slot.extraParams.
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot limSlot =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER);
        limSlot.value = 80;
        limSlot.extraParams.put("drive", 10);

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        AudioProcessor lim = chain.getRack().getProcessor(
                chain.getRack().indexOf("limiter"));
        assertNotNull(lim);
        assertEquals(80, lim.getParam("drive").getCurrentRaw());
    }

    @Test
    public void safetyLimiterCeilingHoldsEvenWhenLimiterSlotMixIsZeroOrUnchecked() {
        // BUG-03 regression: upstream gain stages (Warmth + Presence + Comp)
        // must never clip past the brickwall safety ceiling even if a
        // BRICKWALL_LIMITER slot has wetDry < 1.0f or is unchecked.
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
        DspChain.EffectSlot w = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY);
        DspChain.EffectSlot p = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.VOCAL_PRESENCE);
        DspChain.EffectSlot c = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR);
        DspChain.EffectSlot l = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER);
        w.value = 100;
        p.value = 100;
        c.value = 100;
        l.value = 50;
        l.wetDry = 0.0f; // 0% drive mix on limiter slot

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, cfg);
        float[] hot = tone(1024, 1, 0.95f, 0.09f);
        chain.processInPlace(hot, 1024);
        for (int i = 0; i < hot.length; i++) {
            assertTrue("Sample clipped past safety ceiling @" + i + ": " + hot[i],
                    Math.abs(hot[i]) <= 0.99f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void removingSlotResetsProcessorWetDryMixToDefault() {
        // BUG-04 regression: removing a slot with wetDry = 0.2f must reset the
        // backing processor's wetDryMix back to 1.0f on updateConfig.
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.VOICE_POLISH);
        DspChain.EffectSlot noiseSlot = null;
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            if (s.type == DspChain.EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION) noiseSlot = s;
        }
        assertNotNull(noiseSlot);
        noiseSlot.wetDry = 0.2f;

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        AudioProcessor noiseProc = chain.getRack().getProcessor(
                chain.getRack().indexOf("noise"));
        assertEquals(0.2f, noiseProc.getWetDryMix(), 0.0f);

        cfg.removeSlot(noiseSlot);
        chain.updateConfig(cfg);
        assertEquals(1.0f, noiseProc.getWetDryMix(), 0.0f);
    }

    @Test
    public void manualAdjustmentPreservesSlotWetDryAndOrder() {
        // BUG-05 regression: calling onManualAdjustment must not wipe out
        // existing slots' wetDry mix, extraParams, or custom slot order.
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.VOICE_POLISH);
        // Move COMPRESSOR to index 0
        DspChain.EffectSlot compSlot = cfg.slots.remove(3);
        cfg.slots.add(0, compSlot);
        compSlot.wetDry = 0.4f;
        compSlot.extraParams.put("custom_knob", 42);

        cfg.noisePct = 65;
        cfg.onManualAdjustment();

        assertEquals(DspChain.EffectType.COMPRESSOR, cfg.slots.get(0).type);
        assertEquals(0.4f, cfg.slots.get(0).wetDry, 0.0f);
        assertEquals(Integer.valueOf(42),
                cfg.slots.get(0).extraParams.get("custom_knob"));
    }

    @Test
    public void fxParameterClampRawRoundsToNearestStepAndReachesMax() {
        // BUG-07 regression: clampRaw must round to nearest step and allow maxRaw.
        FxParameter p = FxParameter.intParam("test", "Test", "%", 0, 100, 5, 50);
        assertEquals(50, p.clampRaw(48));
        assertEquals(45, p.clampRaw(47));
        assertEquals(100, p.clampRaw(100));

        FxParameter unaligned = FxParameter.intParam("u", "U", "", 0, 12, 5, 0);
        assertEquals(12, unaligned.clampRaw(12));
    }

    @Test
    public void setSampleRateUpdatesBiquadFilterResponse() {
        // BUG-10 regression: LegacyHpfProcessor and LegacyDeEsserProcessor must
        // recompute coefficients when FxRackChain.setSampleRate is called.
        FxRackChain rack48 = new FxRackChain(1);
        LegacyHpfProcessor hpf48 = new LegacyHpfProcessor();
        hpf48.setLegacyState(true, 150);
        rack48.addProcessor(hpf48);
        rack48.setSampleRate(48000);

        FxRackChain rack96 = new FxRackChain(1);
        LegacyHpfProcessor hpf96 = new LegacyHpfProcessor();
        hpf96.setLegacyState(true, 150);
        rack96.addProcessor(hpf96);
        rack96.setSampleRate(96000);

        float[] a = tone(256, 1, 0.8f, 0.02f);
        float[] b = a.clone();
        rack48.processInPlace(a, 256);
        rack96.processInPlace(b, 256);

        boolean diff = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (Math.abs(a[i] - b[i]) > 1e-4f) {
                diff = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        assertTrue("setSampleRate had no effect on HPF biquad coefficients", diff);
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------- legacy reference

    /** Standalone copy of the pre-Stage-2 engine, for bit-parity checks. */
    private static final class LegacyRef {

// ==== VERBATIM COPY of the pre-Stage-2 DspChain engine (commit 2c98087) ==== // ==== kept in the test only so rack output is proven bit-identical. ====

    private static final int DECIM = 16;
    private static final float INV_DECIM = 1.0f / DECIM;

    private volatile boolean hpfOn;
    private volatile int currentHpfHz = -1;
    private volatile float noiseAmt;
    private volatile float deEssAmt;
    private volatile float compAmt;
    private volatile float presenceAmt;
    private volatile float warmthAmt;
    private volatile float gateAmt;
    private volatile float limiterAmt;

    // Stage 1: Dynamic Butterworth High-Pass Filter (40..160 Hz)
    private volatile float hpfB0, hpfB1, hpfB2, hpfA1, hpfA2;
    private final float[] hpfZ1 = new float[2];
    private final float[] hpfZ2 = new float[2];

    // Stage 2: 3-Band Minimum-Statistics Adaptive Noise Suppressor state
    private static final float NS_ALPHA_LOW = 0.02839f; // 220 Hz 1-pole crossover
    private static final float NS_ALPHA_HIGH = 0.3919f; // 3800 Hz 1-pole crossover
    private final float[] nsLp1 = new float[2];
    private final float[] nsLp2 = new float[2];
    private final float[] nsEnv = {1e-5f, 1e-5f, 1e-5f};
    private final float[] nsFloor = {1e-4f, 1e-4f, 1e-4f};
    private boolean nsSeeded = false;
    private final float[] nsGain = {1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f};
    private final float[] nsTargetGain = {1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f};
    private final float[] nsBandAcc = new float[3];
    private final float[] ScratchLow = new float[DECIM * 2];
    private final float[] ScratchMid = new float[DECIM * 2];
    private final float[] ScratchHigh = new float[DECIM * 2];

    // Stage 3: Dedicated Downward Expander / Room Gate state
    private float gateEnv = 0.0f;
    private float gateGainCur = 1.0f;
    private float gateGainTarget = 1.0f;

    // Stage 4: Split-Band Relative Sidechain De-Esser (6800 Hz bandpass, Q=1.5)
    private final float deB0, deB1, deB2, deA1, deA2;
    private final float[] deZ1 = new float[2];
    private final float[] deZ2 = new float[2];
    private float deSibEnv = 1e-7f;
    private float deFullEnv = 1e-6f;
    private float deCutCur = 0.0f;
    private float deCutTarget = 0.0f;
    private final float[] ScratchSib = new float[DECIM * 2];

    // Stage 5: Warmth (180 Hz) & Vocal Presence (3500 Hz) state
    private final float[] warmLp = new float[2];
    private final float[] presLp = new float[2];
    private static final float WARM_ALPHA = 0.0233f;  // ~180 Hz
    private static final float PRES_ALPHA = 0.3678f;  // ~3500 Hz

    // Stage 6: Soft-Knee Compressor + Auto-Makeup
    private float compEnvDb = -60.0f;
    private float compGainCur = 1.0f;
    private float compGainTarget = 1.0f;

    LegacyRef() {
        computeHpfCoefficients(80);

        double dw0 = 2.0 * Math.PI * 6800.0 / DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
        double dCos = Math.cos(dw0);
        double dAlpha = Math.sin(dw0) / (2.0 * 1.5);
        double da0Inv = 1.0 / (1.0 + dAlpha);
        this.deB0 = (float) (dAlpha * da0Inv);
        this.deB1 = 0.0f;
        this.deB2 = (float) (-dAlpha * da0Inv);
        this.deA1 = (float) (-2.0 * dCos * da0Inv);
        this.deA2 = (float) ((1.0 - dAlpha) * da0Inv);
    }

    private void computeHpfCoefficients(int cutoffHz) {
        int hz = Math.max(40, Math.min(160, cutoffHz));
        if (hz == this.currentHpfHz) return;
        this.currentHpfHz = hz;
        double w0 = 2.0 * Math.PI * hz / DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
        double cosW0 = Math.cos(w0);
        double alpha = Math.sin(w0) / (2.0 * 0.70710678);
        double a0Inv = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha);
        this.hpfB0 = (float) ((1.0 + cosW0) * 0.5 * a0Inv);
        this.hpfB1 = (float) (-(1.0 + cosW0) * a0Inv);
        this.hpfB2 = this.hpfB0;
        this.hpfA1 = (float) (-2.0 * cosW0 * a0Inv);
        this.hpfA2 = (float) ((1.0 - alpha) * a0Inv);
    }

    public void updateConfig(DspChain.Config cfg) {
        if (cfg == null) {
            this.hpfOn = false;
            this.noiseAmt = 0f;
            this.deEssAmt = 0f;
            this.compAmt = 0f;
            this.presenceAmt = 0f;
            this.warmthAmt = 0f;
            this.gateAmt = 0f;
            this.limiterAmt = 0f;
            return;
        }
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        this.hpfOn = cfg.hpfEnabled;
        computeHpfCoefficients(cfg.hpfCutoffHz);
        this.noiseAmt = cfg.noisePct / 100.0f;
        this.deEssAmt = cfg.deEssPct / 100.0f;
        this.compAmt = cfg.compPct / 100.0f;
        this.presenceAmt = cfg.presencePct / 100.0f;
        this.warmthAmt = cfg.warmthPct / 100.0f;
        this.gateAmt = cfg.gatePct / 100.0f;
        this.limiterAmt = cfg.limiterPct / 100.0f;
    }

    public boolean isActive() {
        return hpfOn || noiseAmt > 0.001f || deEssAmt > 0.001f || compAmt > 0.001f
                || presenceAmt > 0.001f || warmthAmt > 0.001f
                || gateAmt > 0.001f || limiterAmt > 0.001f;
    }

    public void reset() {
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            hpfZ1[c] = hpfZ2[c] = 0f;
            nsLp1[c] = nsLp2[c] = 0f;
            deZ1[c] = deZ2[c] = 0f;
            warmLp[c] = presLp[c] = 0f;
        }
        for (int b = 0; b < 3; b++) {
            nsEnv[b] = 1e-5f;
            nsFloor[b] = 1e-4f;
            nsGain[b] = nsTargetGain[b] = 1.0f;
        }
        nsSeeded = false;
        gateEnv = 0f;
        gateGainCur = gateGainTarget = 1.0f;
        deSibEnv = 1e-7f;
        deFullEnv = 1e-6f;
        deCutCur = deCutTarget = 0f;
        compEnvDb = -60.0f;
        compGainCur = compGainTarget = 1.0f;
    }

    void process(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        final int ch = channels;
        final boolean doHpf = this.hpfOn;
        final float nAmt = this.noiseAmt;
        final float gAmt = this.gateAmt;
        final float dAmt = this.deEssAmt;
        final float cAmt = this.compAmt;
        final float wAmt = this.warmthAmt;
        final float pAmt = this.presenceAmt;
        final float lAmt = this.limiterAmt;

        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int blk = Math.min(DECIM, frames - offset);

            // Stage 1: Dynamic Butterworth High-Pass Filter (40..160 Hz)
            if (doHpf) {
                final float b0 = this.hpfB0, b1 = this.hpfB1, b2 = this.hpfB2;
                final float a1 = this.hpfA1, a2 = this.hpfA2;
                for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                    int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        float x = buf[idx + c];
                        float y = b0 * x + hpfZ1[c];
                        hpfZ1[c] = b1 * x - a1 * y + hpfZ2[c];
                        hpfZ2[c] = b2 * x - a2 * y;
                        buf[idx + c] = y;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Stage 2: 3-Band Adaptive Noise Suppressor
            if (nAmt > 0.001f) {
                nsBandAcc[0] = nsBandAcc[1] = nsBandAcc[2] = 0f;
                for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                    int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                    int sIdx = f * ch;
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        float x = buf[idx + c];
                        nsLp1[c] += NS_ALPHA_LOW * (x - nsLp1[c]);
                        nsLp2[c] += NS_ALPHA_HIGH * (x - nsLp2[c]);
                        float bLow = nsLp1[c];
                        float bMid = nsLp2[c] - bLow;
                        float bHigh = x - nsLp2[c];
                        ScratchLow[sIdx + c] = bLow;
                        ScratchMid[sIdx + c] = bMid;
                        ScratchHigh[sIdx + c] = bHigh;
                        nsBandAcc[0] += bLow * bLow;
                        nsBandAcc[1] += bMid * bMid;
                        nsBandAcc[2] += bHigh * bHigh;
                    }
                }
                float invSamples = 1.0f / (blk * ch);
                if (!nsSeeded) {
                    nsSeeded = true;
                    for (int b = 0; b < 3; b++) {
                        float e = Math.max(1e-7f, nsBandAcc[b] * invSamples);
                        nsEnv[b] = e;
                        nsFloor[b] = Math.max(1e-6f, e * 0.35f);
                    }
                }
                for (int b = 0; b < 3; b++) {
                    float e = nsBandAcc[b] * invSamples;
                    nsEnv[b] = 0.60f * nsEnv[b] + 0.40f * e;
                    if (nsEnv[b] < nsFloor[b]) {
                        nsFloor[b] = 0.75f * nsFloor[b] + 0.25f * nsEnv[b];
                    } else {
                        nsFloor[b] = nsFloor[b] * 1.0006f + 1e-9f;
                    }
                    float snr = nsEnv[b] / (nsFloor[b] + 1e-10f);
                    float overSub = 1.0f + 3.8f * nAmt;
                    float g = (snr - overSub) / Math.max(snr, 1e-6f);
                    float floorG = (b == 1)
                            ? (1.0f - 0.85f * nAmt)
                            : (1.0f - 0.94f * nAmt);
                    g = Math.max(floorG, Math.min(1.0f, g));
                    float smooth = g > nsTargetGain[b] ? 0.40f
                            : (b == 2 ? 0.10f : 0.045f);
                    nsTargetGain[b] += smooth * (g - nsTargetGain[b]);
                }
                float dG0 = (nsTargetGain[0] - nsGain[0]) * INV_DECIM;
                float dG1 = (nsTargetGain[1] - nsGain[1]) * INV_DECIM;
                float dG2 = (nsTargetGain[2] - nsGain[2]) * INV_DECIM;
                for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                    nsGain[0] += dG0;
                    nsGain[1] += dG1;
                    nsGain[2] += dG2;
                    int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                    int sIdx = f * ch;
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        buf[idx + c] = nsGain[0] * ScratchLow[sIdx + c]
                                + nsGain[1] * ScratchMid[sIdx + c]
                                + nsGain[2] * ScratchHigh[sIdx + c];
                    }
                }
            }

            // Stage 3: Dedicated Downward Expander / Room Gate
            if (gAmt > 0.001f) {
                float blkPeak = 0f;
                for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                    int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        float a = Math.abs(buf[idx + c]);
                        if (a > blkPeak) blkPeak = a;
                    }
                }
                float alphaG = blkPeak > gateEnv ? 0.35f : 0.015f;
                gateEnv += alphaG * (blkPeak - gateEnv);
                // Threshold ranges from -52 dBFS (0.0025) to -18 dBFS (0.125)
                float threshLin = DspChain.fastDbToLin(-52.0f + 34.0f * gAmt);
                if (gateEnv >= threshLin) {
                    gateGainTarget = 1.0f;
                } else {
                    float ratio = gateEnv / Math.max(1e-6f, threshLin);
                    float minFloor = 1.0f - 0.92f * gAmt;
                    gateGainTarget = Math.max(minFloor, ratio * ratio);
                }
                float dGate = (gateGainTarget - gateGainCur) * INV_DECIM;
                for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                    gateGainCur += dGate;
                    int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        buf[idx + c] *= gateGainCur;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Stage 4: Warmth (180 Hz Chest Body) & Vocal Presence (3.5 kHz Air)
            if (wAmt > 0.001f || pAmt > 0.001f) {
                float warmGain = wAmt * 1.45f; // up to +9 dB low-mid body
                float presGain = pAmt * 1.65f; // up to +10 dB air & articulation
                for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                    int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        float x = buf[idx + c];
                        warmLp[c] += WARM_ALPHA * (x - warmLp[c]);
                        presLp[c] += PRES_ALPHA * (x - presLp[c]);
                        float hi = x - presLp[c];
                        buf[idx + c] = x + warmGain * warmLp[c] + presGain * hi;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Stage 5: Split-Band Relative Sidechain De-Esser
            if (dAmt > 0.001f) {
                float sibEnergy = 0f;
                float fullEnergy = 0f;
                for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                    int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                    int sIdx = f * ch;
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        float x = buf[idx + c];
                        float sib = deB0 * x + deZ1[c];
                        deZ1[c] = deB1 * x - deA1 * sib + deZ2[c];
                        deZ2[c] = deB2 * x - deA2 * sib;
                        ScratchSib[sIdx + c] = sib;
                        sibEnergy += sib * sib;
                        fullEnergy += x * x;
                    }
                }
                float invN = 1.0f / (blk * ch);
                deSibEnv = 0.50f * deSibEnv + 0.50f * (sibEnergy * invN);
                deFullEnv = 0.70f * deFullEnv + 0.30f * (fullEnergy * invN);
                float ratioDb = DspChain.fastLinToDb(deSibEnv + 1e-10f) * 0.5f
                        - DspChain.fastLinToDb(deFullEnv + 1e-9f) * 0.5f;
                float threshDb = 1.0f - 11.5f * dAmt;
                float wantCut = 0f;
                if (ratioDb > threshDb && deFullEnv > 1e-7f) {
                    float overDb = Math.min(14.0f, (ratioDb - threshDb) * 1.4f);
                    wantCut = 1.0f - DspChain.fastDbToLin(-overDb);
                }
                float alphaDe = wantCut > deCutTarget ? 0.50f : 0.12f;
                deCutTarget += alphaDe * (wantCut - deCutTarget);
                float dCut = (deCutTarget - deCutCur) * INV_DECIM;
                for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                    deCutCur += dCut;
                    int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                    int sIdx = f * ch;
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        buf[idx + c] -= deCutCur * ScratchSib[sIdx + c];
                    }
                }
            }

            // Stage 6: Soft-Knee Compressor + Auto-Makeup
            if (cAmt > 0.001f) {
                float peak = 0f;
                float sumSq = 0f;
                for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                    int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        float a = Math.abs(buf[idx + c]);
                        if (a > peak) peak = a;
                        sumSq += a * a;
                    }
                }
                float rms = (float) Math.sqrt(sumSq / (blk * ch));
                float det = Math.max(1e-6f, 0.7f * peak + 0.3f * rms);
                float inDb = DspChain.fastLinToDb(det);
                float alphaC = inDb > compEnvDb ? 0.10f : 0.004f;
                compEnvDb += alphaC * (inDb - compEnvDb);

                float threshDb = -10.0f - 18.0f * cAmt; // -10 .. -28 dBFS
                float ratio = 1.0f + 5.0f * cAmt;       // 1:1 .. 6:1
                float slope = 1.0f - (1.0f / ratio);
                float knee = 6.0f;
                float over = compEnvDb - threshDb;
                float grDb;
                if (2.0f * over < -knee) {
                    grDb = 0.0f;
                } else if (2.0f * Math.abs(over) <= knee) {
                    float t = over + knee * 0.5f;
                    grDb = -slope * (t * t) / (2.0f * knee);
                } else {
                    grDb = -slope * over;
                }
                float makeupDb = (-threshDb * slope) * 0.55f;
                compGainTarget = DspChain.fastDbToLin(grDb + makeupDb);
                float dG = (compGainTarget - compGainCur) * INV_DECIM;
                for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                    compGainCur += dG;
                    int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        buf[idx + c] *= compGainCur;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Stage 7: Dedicated Brickwall Ceiling Limiter (or safety limiter when active)
            if (lAmt > 0.001f || cAmt > 0.001f || wAmt > 0.001f || pAmt > 0.001f) {
                float driveLin = lAmt > 0.001f ? DspChain.fastDbToLin(lAmt * 10.5f) : 1.0f;
                for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                    int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        float y = buf[idx + c] * driveLin;
                        float ay = Math.abs(y);
                        if (ay > 0.82f) {
                            float d = ay - 0.82f;
                            float lim = 0.82f + 0.165f * (d / (0.165f + d));
                            y = y >= 0f ? lim : -lim;
                        }
                        buf[idx + c] = y;
                    }
                }
            }

            offset += blk;
        }
    }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

/**
 * Microphone capability rules. All null-manager paths are pure Java and must
 * degrade to "try stereo, fall back silently" instead of failing.
 */
public class MicSupportTest {

    @Test
    public void nullManagerIsUnknown() {
        assertEquals(-1, MicSupport.physicalMicCount(null));
    }

    @Test
    public void unknownMeansTryStereo() {
        assertTrue(MicSupport.stereoLikely(null));
    }

    @Test
    public void unknownIsNeverDualAbsent() {
        assertFalse(MicSupport.dualAbsent(null));
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;
import org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowLooper;

/**
 * BUG-STU-02: dismissing a result dialog by tapping outside or pressing Back
 * must still run the callback, exactly once. The studio used this callback to
 * leave the screen, so a plain dismissal trapped the user there.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class OptionsSheetResultDismissTest {

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    @Test
    public void outsideDismissFiresCallbackOnce() {
        Activity a = activity();
        final int[] fired = {0};
        android.app.Dialog d = OptionsSheet.showResult(a, true,
                "Saved", "Msg", () -> fired[0]++);
        ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        // Simulate a tap outside / Back press.
        d.dismiss();
        ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        assertEquals("dismiss must run the callback", 1, fired[0]);
    }

    @Test
    public void buttonThenDismissFiresOnlyOnce() {
        Activity a = activity();
        final int[] fired = {0};
        android.app.Dialog d = OptionsSheet.showResult(a, true,
                "Saved", "Msg", () -> fired[0]++);
        ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        android.view.View ok = d.findViewById(R.id.resultOk);
        assertTrue("no OK button", ok != null && ok.getVisibility()
                == android.view.View.VISIBLE);
        a.runOnUiThread(ok::performClick);
        ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        d.dismiss();
        ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        assertEquals("callback fired more than once", 1, fired[0]);
    }

    @Test
    public void callbackSurvivesRepeatedDismissals() {
        Activity a = activity();
        final int[] fired = {0};
        android.app.Dialog d = OptionsSheet.showResult(a, false,
                "Failed", "Msg", () -> fired[0]++);
        ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        d.dismiss();
        d.dismiss();
        d.cancel();
        ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        assertEquals(1, fired[0]);
    }
}

import org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowLooper;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Every dialog builder opens, labels its controls, fires its actions and
 * dismisses — driven through the shown dialog like a user would.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class OptionsSheetTest {

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    private static Dialog latest() {
        Dialog d = ShadowDialog.getLatestDialog();
        assertTrue("no dialog shown", d != null && d.isShowing());
        return d;
    }

    private static void idle() {
        ShadowLooper shadow = Shadows.shadowOf(Looper.getMainLooper());
        shadow.idle();
    }

    @Test
    public void confirmFiresAndDismisses() {
        Activity a = activity();
        final boolean[] fired = {false};
        OptionsSheet.showConfirm(a, "Title?", "Are you sure?", "Do it",
                R.drawable.ic_check, false, () -> fired[0] = true);
        Dialog d = latest();
        assertEquals("Title?",
                ((TextView) d.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle)).getText()
                        .toString());
        d.findViewById(R.id.dialogConfirm).performClick();
        idle();
        assertTrue("confirm action never fired", fired[0]);
        assertTrue("dialog did not dismiss", !d.isShowing());
    }

    @Test
    public void confirmCancelDismissesWithoutFiring() {
        Activity a = activity();
        final boolean[] fired = {false};
        OptionsSheet.showConfirm(a, "Title?", "Are you sure?", "Do it",
                R.drawable.ic_trash, true, () -> fired[0] = true);
        Dialog d = latest();
        d.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel).performClick();
        idle();
        assertTrue(!fired[0]);
        assertTrue(!d.isShowing());
    }

    @Test

        final boolean[] ok = {false};
        OptionsSheet.showResult(a, true, "Saved", "All good", () -> ok[0] = true);
        Dialog d = latest();
        assertEquals("Saved",
                ((TextView) d.findViewById(R.id.resultTitle)).getText()
                        .toString());
        View okBtn = d.findViewById(R.id.resultOk);
        assertTrue(okBtn.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE);
        okBtn.performClick();
        idle();
        assertTrue(ok[0]);
        assertTrue(!d.isShowing());
    }

    @Test
    public void resultWithoutCallbackHidesOk() {
        Activity a = activity();
        OptionsSheet.showResult(a, false, "Failed", "Bad news");
        Dialog d = latest();
        assertTrue(d.findViewById(R.id.resultOk).getVisibility() == View.GONE);
        d.dismiss();
    }

    @Test
    public void optionsListFiresChosenItem() {
        Activity a = activity();
        final String[] picked = {null};
        List<OptionsSheet.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_check, "First",
                () -> picked[0] = "first"));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_share, "Second",

        Dialog d = latest();
        assertEquals("Pick one",

        assertTrue("no option rows", box != null && box.getChildCount() >= 2);
        android.view.ViewGroup wrap =
                (android.view.ViewGroup) box.getChildAt(1);
        wrap.getChildAt(0).performClick();
        idle();

    }

    @Test

        a.setContentView(v);

        PressAnim.pop(v);
        assertTrue("view detached", v.getParent() != null);

FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/PunchInTest.java
=================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * Roadmap Phase 4 punch-in cursor API: cursor clamping, millisecond mapping
 * and punch-range arming on an attached session, without the microphone.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class PunchInTest {

    @Rule
    public TemporaryFolder tmp = new TemporaryFolder();

    private File dcRaw(String name, int frames, int ch) throws Exception {
        File f = new File(tmp.getRoot(), name);
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, 48000, (long) frames * ch * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames * ch];
            Arrays.fill(buf, 0.25f);
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void cursorStartsAtZero() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        File raw = dcRaw("cur0.wav", 48000, 2);
        try {
            e.attachExisting(ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext(),
                    raw, "Cursor", 2, raw.length() - 44);
            assertEquals(48000L, e.totalFrames());
            assertEquals(0L, e.cursorFrames());
            assertEquals(0L, e.cursorMs());
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void seekClampsToSessionBounds() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        File raw = dcRaw("clamp.wav", 48000, 2);
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        try {
            e.attachExisting(ctx, raw, "Clamp", 2, raw.length() - 44);
            e.seekCursorFrame(24000);
            assertEquals(24000L, e.cursorFrames());
            assertEquals(500L, e.cursorMs());
            e.seekCursorFrame(99_999_999L);
            assertEquals(48000L, e.cursorFrames());
            e.seekCursorFrame(-10L);
            assertEquals(0L, e.cursorFrames());
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void armPunchRangePositionsCursor() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        File raw = dcRaw("arm.wav", 48000, 1);
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        try {
            e.attachExisting(ctx, raw, "Arm", 1, raw.length() - 44);
            assertEquals(48000L, e.totalFrames());
            e.armPunchRange(1000, 5000);
            assertEquals(1000L, e.cursorFrames());
            // Inverted range still parks the cursor; punch-out is dropped.
            e.armPunchRange(9000, 1000);
            assertEquals(9000L, e.cursorFrames());
            assertTrue(e.hasSession());
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/ReconcileTest.java
=================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Startup-sweep robustness: truncated saves, garbage files and legacy rows
 * must never take the app down in a launch loop. Poison on disk degrades to
 * fallback durations; the sweep itself never throws.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class ReconcileTest {

    private File takesDir() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        return RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
    }

    private void write(File f, byte[] data) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(data);
        } finally {
            try {
                w.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void poisonFilesNeverThrow() throws Exception {
        File dir = takesDir();
        // Truncated conversion remnants: empty container, garbage bytes,
        // and a larger-than-probe-gate corrupt file.
        write(new File(dir, "poison_empty_20261011_101500.m4a"), new byte[0]);
        byte[] junk = new byte[100];
        for (int i = 0; i < junk.length; i++) junk[i] = (byte) (i * 7 + 3);
        write(new File(dir, "poison_junk_20261011_101500.wav"), junk);
        byte[] big = new byte[5000];
        for (int i = 0; i < big.length; i++) big[i] = (byte) (i * 13 + 1);
        write(new File(dir, "poison_big_20261011_101500.m4a"), big);

        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        TakesRepository.ReconcileResult rr = TakesRepository.reconcile(ctx);
        assertTrue(rr != null);

        // Second sweep: whatever was adopted is now referenced, so nothing
        // may be re-probed or re-adopted, and still nothing throws.
        TakesRepository.ReconcileResult rr2 = TakesRepository.reconcile(ctx);
        assertTrue(rr2 != null);
        assertTrue(rr2.adopted == 0);

        for (File f : new File[]{
                new File(dir, "poison_empty_20261011_101500.m4a"),
                new File(dir, "poison_junk_20261011_101500.wav"),
                new File(dir, "poison_big_20261011_101500.m4a")}) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void validWavAdoptsWithRealDuration() throws Exception {
        File dir = takesDir();
        File good = new File(dir, "good_20261011_101500.wav");
        // 1 channel, 48 kHz, exactly one second of silence.
        byte[] hdr = Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 48000L * 4);
        byte[] body = new byte[48000 * 4];
        byte[] all = new byte[hdr.length + body.length];
        System.arraycopy(hdr, 0, all, 0, hdr.length);
        write(good, all);

        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        TakesRepository.ReconcileResult rr = TakesRepository.reconcile(ctx);
        assertTrue(rr != null);
        assertTrue(rr.adopted >= 1);

        boolean found = false;
        for (Take t : TakesRepository.all()) {
            if (good.getAbsolutePath().equals(t.filePath)) {
                found = true;
                assertTrue(t.durationMs == 1000);
            }
        }
        assertTrue(found);
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        good.delete();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class RecordPresetTest {

    @Test
    public void ofDefaultsToMemo() {
        assertEquals(RecordPreset.MEMO, RecordPreset.of(null));
        assertEquals(RecordPreset.MEMO, RecordPreset.of("nope"));
        assertEquals(RecordPreset.MUSIC, RecordPreset.of("music"));
        assertEquals(RecordPreset.PODCAST, RecordPreset.of("podcast"));
    }

    @Test
    public void legacyIdsMigrate() {
        assertEquals(RecordPreset.MEMO, RecordPreset.of("voice"));
        assertEquals(RecordPreset.MEMO, RecordPreset.of("standard"));
        assertEquals(RecordPreset.MUSIC, RecordPreset.of("raw"));
    }

    @Test
    public void captureGeometry() {
        assertEquals(1, RecordPreset.MEMO.channels);
        assertEquals(2, RecordPreset.PODCAST.channels);
        assertEquals(2, RecordPreset.MUSIC.channels);
        assertFalse(RecordPreset.MEMO.wantsStereo());
        assertTrue(RecordPreset.PODCAST.wantsStereo());
        assertTrue(RecordPreset.MUSIC.wantsStereo());
        assertFalse(RecordPreset.MEMO.wantsUnprocessed());
        assertFalse(RecordPreset.PODCAST.wantsUnprocessed());
        assertTrue(RecordPreset.MUSIC.wantsUnprocessed());
    }

    @Test
    public void bitrates() {
        assertEquals(96000, RecordPreset.MEMO.aacBitrate);
        assertEquals(256000, RecordPreset.PODCAST.aacBitrate);
        assertEquals(320000, RecordPreset.MUSIC.aacBitrate);
    }

    @Test
    public void ofNullDefaultsToMemo() {
        assertEquals(RecordPreset.MEMO, RecordPreset.of(null));
    }

    @Test
    public void exactlyThreePresets() {
        assertEquals(3, RecordPreset.all().length);
    }

    @Test
    public void onlyMusicIsUnprocessedAndLossless() {
        for (RecordPreset preset : RecordPreset.all()) {
            boolean music = preset == RecordPreset.MUSIC;
            assertEquals(music, preset.wantsUnprocessed());
            assertEquals(music, preset.autoSavesLossless);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void persistRoundTrip() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        RecordPreset.MUSIC.save(ctx);
        assertEquals(RecordPreset.MUSIC, RecordPreset.load(ctx));
        RecordPreset.PODCAST.save(ctx);
        assertEquals(RecordPreset.PODCAST, RecordPreset.load(ctx));
    }
}
