package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * Capture session lifecycle on real files: create, measure, rename, attach,
 * abort — all without touching the microphone.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class RecordingEngineTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    @Test
    public void startCreatesRawAndPending() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        e.startNewSession(ctx(), "  Hello World!  ", 2);
        try {
            assertNotNull(e.rawFile);
            assertTrue(e.rawFile.exists());
            assertTrue(new File(e.rawFile.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending")
                    .exists());
            assertEquals("Hello World!", e.takeName);
            assertTrue(e.hasSession());
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void duplicateStartThrows() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        e.startNewSession(ctx(), "One", 2);
        try {
            boolean threw = false;
            try {
                e.startNewSession(ctx(), "Two", 2);
            } catch (IllegalStateException expected) {
                threw = true;
            }
            assertTrue("second session must throw", threw);
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void durationTracksWrittenBytes() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        e.startNewSession(ctx(), "Dur", 2);
        try {
            // 48000 frames stereo float = exactly 1 second.
            java.io.RandomAccessFile w =
                    new java.io.RandomAccessFile(e.rawFile, "rw");
            try {
                w.seek(w.length());
                w.write(new byte[48000 * 2 * 4]);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            e.dataBytes = e.rawFile.length() - 44;
            assertEquals(1000, e.durationMs());
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void abortDeletesEverything() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        e.startNewSession(ctx(), "Gone", 1);
        File raw = e.rawFile;
        assertTrue(e.abortAndDelete());
        assertTrue(!raw.exists());
        assertTrue(!new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").exists());
        assertFalse(e.hasSession());
        assertNull(e.rawFile);
    }

    @Test
    public void renameMovesFilesWhenIdle() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        e.startNewSession(ctx(), "Old Name", 2);
        try {
            e.renameSession(ctx(), "New Name");
            assertEquals("New Name", e.takeName);
            assertTrue(e.rawFile.getName().startsWith("New Name"));
            assertTrue(new File(e.rawFile.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending")
                    .exists());
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void attachExistingAdoptsUnfinished() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        e.startNewSession(ctx(), "Adopted", 2);
        File raw = e.rawFile;
        long bytes = 48000L * 2 * 4;
        e.abortAndDelete();
        // Simulate a crash leftover: raw without engine state.
        java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw");
        try {
            w.seek(w.length());
            w.write(new byte[(int) bytes]);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        RecordingEngine.writePendingMarker(raw, "Adopted", 2);
        try {
            e.attachExisting(ctx(), raw, "Adopted", 2, bytes);
            assertTrue(e.hasSession());
            assertEquals(bytes, e.dataBytes);
        } finally {
            e.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void streamingWithoutSessionIsNoop() {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        e.abortAndDelete();
        e.beginStreaming(ctx(), RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A);
        assertNull(e.streaming());
        assertNull(e.endStreamingDetach());
    }

    @Test
    public void payloadBytesOfMissingIsZero() {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "missing-payload.wav");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        f.delete();
        assertEquals(0, RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(f));
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class SaveFormatTest {

    @Test
    public void ofDefaultsToAuto() {
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.AUTO, SaveFormat.of(null));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.AUTO, SaveFormat.of("nope"));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.FLAC, SaveFormat.of("flac"));
    }

    @Test
    public void autoPicksTheAppropriateContainer() {
        // Speech: AAC is transparent and far smaller — that is the point.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A,
                SaveFormat.AUTO.effective(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A,
                SaveFormat.AUTO.effective(RecordPreset.PODCAST));
        // Music: an unprocessed stereo master, so Auto stays lossless — but
        // compressed, because the next step is loading this into an editor.
        // Either lossless outcome is correct: FLAC when the device has an
        // encoder, pure-Java WAV24 when it does not.
        SaveFormat musicEff = SaveFormat.AUTO.effective(RecordPreset.MUSIC);
        assertTrue("expected lossless, got " + musicEff,
                musicEff == SaveFormat.FLAC || musicEff == SaveFormat.WAV24);
        // An explicit choice always wins.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A,
                SaveFormat.M4A.effective(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.WAV16,
                SaveFormat.WAV16.effective(RecordPreset.MEMO));
    }

    @Test
    public void onlyMusicDefaultsToLossless() {
        assertTrue(RecordPreset.MUSIC.autoSavesLossless);
        assertFalse(RecordPreset.MEMO.autoSavesLossless);
        assertFalse(RecordPreset.PODCAST.autoSavesLossless);
    }

    @Test
    public void extensions() {
        assertEquals("m4a", SaveFormat.M4A.extension());
        assertEquals("wav", SaveFormat.WAV16.extension());
        assertEquals("wav", SaveFormat.WAV24.extension());
        assertEquals("3gp", SaveFormat.AMR_NB.extension());
        assertEquals("flac", SaveFormat.FLAC.extension());
        assertEquals("webm", SaveFormat.OPUS.extension());
    }

    @Test
    public void alwaysAvailable() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.AUTO.available(ctx));
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.M4A.available(ctx));
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.WAV16.available(ctx));
        // Pure-Java lossless path: never gated on a platform encoder.
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.WAV24.available(ctx));
    }

    @Test
    public void probingNeverCrashes() {
        // Under Robolectric there are no real encoders; the point is the
        // probe degrades gracefully instead of throwing.
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        for (SaveFormat f : SaveFormat.values()) {
            f.available(ctx);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void persistRoundTrip() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        SaveFormat.OPUS.save(ctx);
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.OPUS, SaveFormat.load(ctx));
        SaveFormat.AUTO.save(ctx);
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.AUTO, SaveFormat.load(ctx));
    }

    @Test
    public void takeSaverLabels() {
        assertEquals("M4A", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.AUTO));
        assertEquals("M4A", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.PODCAST, SaveFormat.AUTO));
        assertEquals("FLAC", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.AUTO));
        assertEquals("WAV", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.WAV16));
        assertEquals("WAV24", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.WAV24));
        assertEquals("AMR", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.AMR_NB));
    }

    @Test
    public void wav24SurvivesItsOwnValidation() throws Exception {
        java.io.File f = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy24", ".wav");
        try {
            int frames = 480;
            byte[] hdr = Dsp.wav24Header(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 3);
            byte[] all = new byte[hdr.length + frames * 2 * 3];
            System.arraycopy(hdr, 0, all, 0, hdr.length);
            java.io.FileOutputStream w = new java.io.FileOutputStream(f);
            try {
                w.write(all);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(f, SaveFormat.WAV24);
            // 24-bit must be understood by the duration reader too, or the
            // library and orphan adoption would show 00:00 for these files.
            assertTrue(Dsp.wavDurationMs(f) > 0);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void storageEstimatesTrackChannelsAndClamp() {
        // WAV is exact and scales with the preset's channel count.
        assertEquals(48000L * 2 * 2 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals(48000L * 1 * 2 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        assertEquals(48000L * 2 * 3 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV24.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        // Music's Opus clamps 320k -> 256k, and the estimate must match the
        // file rather than the nominal preset bitrate.
        assertEquals(256000L / 8 * 60,
                SaveFormat.OPUS.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals(320000L / 8 * 60,
                SaveFormat.M4A.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        // AMR always decimates to mono, so it is preset-independent.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.AMR_NB.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC),
                SaveFormat.AMR_NB.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        // Auto reports whatever it resolves to.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MEMO),
                SaveFormat.AUTO.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.FLAC.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC),
                SaveFormat.AUTO.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        // FLAC must actually be smaller than the PCM it replaces.
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.FLAC.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC)
                < SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
    }

    @Test
    public void sizeLabelsAreCompactAndMarkEstimates() {
        assertEquals("17 MB/min",
                SaveFormat.WAV24.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals("11 MB/min",
                SaveFormat.WAV16.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals("0.7 MB/min",
                SaveFormat.M4A.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        assertEquals("0.1 MB/min",
                SaveFormat.AMR_NB.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        // Content-dependent sizes are flagged so they never read as exact.
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.FLAC.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MUSIC)
                .startsWith("~"));
        assertFalse(SaveFormat.WAV16.sizeIsApproximate());
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.FLAC.sizeIsApproximate());
    }

    @Test
    public void fallbackLadder() {
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A, SaveFormat.OPUS.fallbackAfterCrash());
        // FLAC must never silently degrade to lossy AAC when pure-Java WAV24
        // is available.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.WAV24, SaveFormat.FLAC.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A, SaveFormat.AMR_NB.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A, SaveFormat.AMR_WB.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.WAV16, SaveFormat.M4A.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.WAV16, SaveFormat.AUTO.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(null, SaveFormat.WAV16.fallbackAfterCrash());
    }

    @Test
    public void validateFinalAcceptsHealthyContainers() throws Exception {
        // WAV: real header + payload.
        java.io.File wav = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy", ".wav");
        try {
            byte[] hdr = Dsp.wav16Header(1, 48000, 200);
            byte[] all = new byte[hdr.length + 200];
            System.arraycopy(hdr, 0, all, 0, hdr.length);
            java.io.FileOutputStream w = new java.io.FileOutputStream(wav);
            try {
                w.write(all);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(wav, SaveFormat.WAV16);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            wav.delete();
        }
        // MP4: ftyp up front, moov somewhere inside.
        java.io.File mp4 = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy", ".m4a");
        try {
            byte[] body = new byte[200];
            body[4] = 'f';
            body[5] = 't';
            body[6] = 'y';
            body[7] = 'p';
            body[100] = 'm';
            body[101] = 'o';
            body[102] = 'o';
            body[103] = 'v';
            java.io.FileOutputStream w = new java.io.FileOutputStream(mp4);
            try {
                w.write(body);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(mp4, SaveFormat.M4A);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            mp4.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void validateFinalRejectsTornContainers() throws Exception {
        // Too small.
        java.io.File tiny = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy", ".m4a");
        try {
            boolean thrown = false;
            try {
                FormatConverter.validateFinal(tiny, SaveFormat.M4A);
            } catch (IllegalStateException e) {
                thrown = true;
            }
            assertTrue(thrown);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            tiny.delete();
        }
        // ftyp present but no moov: teardown never finished.
        java.io.File torn = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy", ".m4a");
        try {
            byte[] body = new byte[200];
            body[4] = 'f';
            body[5] = 't';
            body[6] = 'y';
            body[7] = 'p';
            java.io.FileOutputStream w = new java.io.FileOutputStream(torn);
            try {
                w.write(body);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            boolean thrown = false;
            try {
                FormatConverter.validateFinal(torn, SaveFormat.M4A);
            } catch (IllegalStateException e) {
                thrown = true;
            }
            assertTrue(thrown);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            torn.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void encoderMimes() {
        assertEquals(android.media.MediaFormat.MIMETYPE_AUDIO_AAC,
                SaveFormat.M4A.encoderMime());
        assertEquals("audio/flac", SaveFormat.FLAC.encoderMime());
        assertEquals("audio/opus", SaveFormat.OPUS.encoderMime());
        assertEquals("audio/3gpp", SaveFormat.AMR_NB.encoderMime());
        assertEquals("audio/amr-wb", SaveFormat.AMR_WB.encoderMime());
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.WAV16.encoderMime() == null);
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.WAV24.encoderMime() == null);
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.AUTO.encoderMime() == null);
    }

    @Test
    public void nonAutoEffectiveIsIdentity() {
        for (SaveFormat f : SaveFormat.values()) {
            if (f == SaveFormat.AUTO) continue;
            assertEquals(f, f.effective(RecordPreset.MEMO));
            assertEquals(f, f.effective(null));
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void wav16BytesAreExact() {
        // Null preset defaults to stereo: 48000 * 2ch * 2B * 60.
        assertEquals(48000L * 2 * 2 * 60, SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(null));
        assertEquals(48000L * 2 * 2 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.PODCAST));
        assertEquals(48000L * 1 * 2 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MEMO));
    }

    @Test

        assertEquals(12200L / 8 * 60, SaveFormat.AMR_NB.bytesPerMinute(null));
        assertEquals(23850L / 8 * 60, SaveFormat.AMR_WB.bytesPerMinute(null));
    }

    @Test
    public void sizeApproximationFlags() {
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.FLAC.sizeIsApproximate());
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.AUTO.sizeIsApproximate());
        assertTrue(!SaveFormat.M4A.sizeIsApproximate());
        assertTrue(!SaveFormat.WAV16.sizeIsApproximate());
    }

FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/SavePipelineTest.java

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.After;
import org.junit.Before;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * End-to-end execution of the real stop/save pipeline: engine session ->
 * float capture on disk -> finalize -> convert -> library add -> the startup
 * sweep that runs on the next launch. The WAV16 path is pure Java, so it runs
 * identically off-device, which makes it the one honest test of the whole
 * tail after the progress bar completes.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class SavePipelineTest {

    private Context ctx;
    private RecordingEngine engine;

    @Before
    public void setUp() {
        ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.clearSession();
        for (File f : RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx).listFiles() != null
                ? RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx).listFiles()
                : new File[0]) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
    }

    @After
    public void tearDown() {
        engine.clearSession();
    }

    /** Writes real float samples into the live session file, like capLoop. */
    private void writeCaptureSeconds(double seconds) throws Exception {
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        assertNotNull("no session file", raw);
        int frames = (int) (RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE * seconds);
        float[] buf = new float[frames * 2];
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            float v = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.05);
            buf[i * 2] = v;
            buf[i * 2 + 1] = v;
        }
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw");
        try {
            w.seek(w.length());
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void fullStopSaveLibraryAndRelaunch() throws Exception {
        // 1) Session opens, raw float file exists with a pending marker.
        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "E2E Take", 2);
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        assertTrue(raw.exists());
        assertTrue(new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").exists());

        // 2) Capture lands on disk.
        writeCaptureSeconds(1.0);

        // 3) Stop -> convert -> validate. This is the tail that used to kill
        //    the app; it must run to completion and report progress.
        final int[] lastPct = {-1};
        TakeSaver.Result r = TakeSaver.finalizeAndConvert(ctx,
                RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16,
                pct -> lastPct[0] = pct);

        assertEquals(100, lastPct[0]);
        assertNotNull(r.file);
        assertTrue("converted file missing", r.file.exists());
        assertEquals("WAV", r.label);
        assertEquals("E2E Take", r.title);
        // One second of stereo 48 kHz capture.
        assertTrue("duration off: " + r.durationMs,
                Math.abs(r.durationMs - 1000) < 60);
        // The final file is a real, playable 16-bit WAV.
        assertTrue(Dsp.wavDurationMs(r.file) > 0);
        // The raw was cleaned up after a successful conversion.
        assertFalse("raw not deleted", raw.exists());
        // The pending marker is gone.
        assertFalse(new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").exists());

        // 4) Library add (what the save button does next).
        int before = TakesRepository.all().size();
        TakesRepository.addRecording(r.file, r.durationMs, r.title, r.label);
        assertEquals(before + 1, TakesRepository.all().size());

        // 5) Next launch: the sweep must not throw, must not re-adopt the
        //    take we just added, and must keep the file.
        TakesRepository.ReconcileResult rr = TakesRepository.reconcile(ctx);
        assertNotNull(rr);
        assertEquals(0, rr.adopted);
        assertTrue(r.file.exists());
        assertEquals(before + 1, TakesRepository.all().size());
    }

    @Test
    public void convertedOutputSurvivesItsOwnValidation() throws Exception {
        // Every container we can produce must pass the gate we run before
        // handing a file to the library. WAV16 is the only pure-Java path
        // that produces real bytes off-device; the encoder-backed ones are
        // covered by validateFinalAcceptsHealthyContainers/RejectsTorn.
        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "Validate", 1);
        writeCaptureSeconds(0.5);
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        TakeSaver.Result r = TakeSaver.finalizeAndConvert(ctx,
                RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16, null);
        FormatConverter.validateFinal(r.file, SaveFormat.WAV16);
        assertFalse(raw.exists());
    }

    @Test
    public void ineffectiveFlacIsDetected() {
        // A FLAC save that is no smaller than the float source means the
        // encoder passed frames through. Real music must not trigger this;
        // a pass-through encoder must. (Auto->FLAC end-to-end needs a real
        // encoder, so that assertion lives in the on-device suite.)
        assertFalse(TakeSaver.flacLooksIneffective(6_000_000L, 23_000_000L));
        assertFalse(TakeSaver.flacLooksIneffective(1L, 100L));
        assertTrue(TakeSaver.flacLooksIneffective(23_000_000L, 23_000_000L));
        assertTrue(TakeSaver.flacLooksIneffective(22_000_000L, 23_000_000L));
        // Degenerate source must not divide by zero.
        assertFalse(TakeSaver.flacLooksIneffective(100L, 0L));
    }

    @Test
    public void wav24ConversionKeepsFullDuration() throws Exception {
        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "Master 24", 2);
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        writeCaptureSeconds(0.5);
        TakeSaver.Result r = TakeSaver.finalizeAndConvert(ctx,
                RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.WAV24, null);
        assertEquals("WAV24", r.label);
        assertTrue(r.file.getName().endsWith(".wav"));
        assertFalse("raw should be cleaned up", raw.exists());
        // Half a second in, ~half a second out: a byte-count mistake in the
        // 3-byte sample assembly would show up here as a wrong duration.
        long dur = Dsp.wavDurationMs(r.file);
        assertTrue("duration off: " + dur, dur >= 450 && dur <= 550);
        FormatConverter.validateFinal(r.file, SaveFormat.WAV24);
    }

    @Test
    public void repeatedSavesLeaveNoOrphans() throws Exception {
        // The reported symptom was "a few saves then dead": repeated cycles
        // must not leak raw files or pending markers. (WAV16 explicitly:
        // under Robolectric the platform encoders are no-ops.)
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            engine.clearSession();
            engine.startNewSession(ctx, "Take " + i, 1);
            writeCaptureSeconds(0.2);
            TakeSaver.Result r = TakeSaver.finalizeAndConvert(ctx,
                    RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16, null);
            assertTrue(r.file.exists());
            TakesRepository.addRecording(r.file, r.durationMs, r.title,
                    r.label);
        }
        engine.clearSession();

        // No unfinished raw or pending marker survives a completed save.
        File[] files = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx).listFiles();
        int raws = 0;
        for (File f : files != null ? files : new File[0]) {
            if (f.getName().endsWith(".pending")) raws++;
        }
        assertEquals("pending markers leaked", 0, raws);

        // And the startup sweep stays happy afterwards.
        assertNotNull(TakesRepository.reconcile(ctx));
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.Uri;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry;
import java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream;

/**
 * Script import: plain text passthrough, minimal .docx extraction with
 * paragraph breaks, and graceful failure on garbage.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class ScriptImporterTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    private File scratch(String name, String content) throws Exception {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), name);
        OutputStreamWriter w = new OutputStreamWriter(
                new FileOutputStream(f), "UTF-8");
        try {
            w.write(content);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void plainTextPassesThrough() throws Exception {
        File f = scratch("script.txt", "hello world\nsecond line");
        ScriptImporter.Result r =
                ScriptImporter.read(ctx(), Uri.fromFile(f));
        assertTrue("ok=" + r.error, r.ok());
        assertFalse(r.docx);
        assertEquals("hello world\nsecond line", r.text);
    }

    @Test
    public void tinyFileKeepsEveryByte() throws Exception {
        // Shorter than the 4-byte sniff header: nothing may be lost.
        File f = scratch("tiny.txt", "hi");
        ScriptImporter.Result r =
                ScriptImporter.read(ctx(), Uri.fromFile(f));
        assertTrue("ok=" + r.error, r.ok());
        assertEquals("hi", r.text);
    }

    @Test
    public void blankFileIsNotOk() throws Exception {
        File f = scratch("blank.txt", "   \n\n  ");
        ScriptImporter.Result r =
                ScriptImporter.read(ctx(), Uri.fromFile(f));
        assertFalse(r.ok());
    }

    @Test
    public void missingFileFailsGracefully() {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "nope-missing.txt");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        f.delete();
        ScriptImporter.Result r =
                ScriptImporter.read(ctx(), Uri.fromFile(f));
        assertFalse(r.ok());
        assertTrue(r.error != null && !r.error.isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    public void minimalDocxExtractsParagraphs() throws Exception {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "script.docx");
        ZipOutputStream zip = new ZipOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(f));
        try {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("word/document.xml"));
            String xml = "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>"
                    + "<document><body>"
                    + "<p><r><t>Hello</t></r><r><t> world</t></r></p>"
                    + "<p><r><t>Second line</t></r></p>"
                    + "</body></document>";
            zip.write(xml.getBytes("UTF-8"));
            zip.closeEntry();
        } finally {
            zip.close();
        }
        ScriptImporter.Result r =
                ScriptImporter.read(ctx(), Uri.fromFile(f));
        assertTrue("ok=" + r.error, r.ok());
        assertTrue(r.docx);
        assertTrue("text=" + r.text, r.text.contains("Hello world"));
        assertTrue("text=" + r.text, r.text.contains("Second line"));
        assertTrue("paragraph break lost: " + r.text,
                r.text.contains("\n"));
    }

    @Test
    public void blankDocxParagraphsSurviveAsBlankLines() throws Exception {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "blanks.docx");
        ZipOutputStream zip = new ZipOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(f));
        try {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("word/document.xml"));
            String xml = "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>"
                    + "<document><body>"
                    + "<p><r><t>First</t></r></p>"
                    + "<p></p>"
                    + "<p><r><t>Third</t></r></p>"
                    + "</body></document>";
            zip.write(xml.getBytes("UTF-8"));
            zip.closeEntry();
        } finally {
            zip.close();
        }
        ScriptImporter.Result r =
                ScriptImporter.read(ctx(), Uri.fromFile(f));
        assertTrue("ok=" + r.error, r.ok());
        assertTrue("blank paragraph collapsed: " + r.text,
                r.text.contains("First\n\nThird"));
    }

    @Test
    public void zipWithoutDocumentFailsGracefully() throws Exception {        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "empty.docx");
        ZipOutputStream zip = new ZipOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(f));
        try {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("other.txt"));
            zip.write("nope".getBytes("UTF-8"));
            zip.closeEntry();
        } finally {
            zip.close();
        }
        ScriptImporter.Result r =
                ScriptImporter.read(ctx(), Uri.fromFile(f));
        assertFalse(r.ok());
        assertTrue(r.docx);
    }
}

        assertEquals(0f, ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.telePauseBtn)).getTextSize(), 0.01f);

    // Resource qualifier order is fixed: available width, available height,
    // orientation, then density — "land-w800dp-..." is rejected by Robolectric.
    @Config(qualifiers = "w800dp-h360dp-land-xhdpi")
    public void landscapeDialogsAreBoundedAndEditorKeepSaveImportVisible() {
        Activity a = activity();
        float density = a.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;

        // 1) Teleprompter script editor in landscape must cap input height so
        //    Save and Import buttons stay visible inside a 360dp-tall screen.
        Dialog ed = TeleDialogs.showEditor(a, "line 1\nline 2", 120, s -> {}, () -> {});
        EditText input = ed.findViewById(R.id.teleEditorInput);
        View saveBtn = ed.findViewById(R.id.teleSaveBtn);
        View importBtn = ed.findViewById(R.id.teleImportBtn);
        assertNotNull(input);
        assertNotNull(saveBtn);
        assertNotNull(importBtn);
        assertEquals(View.VISIBLE, saveBtn.getVisibility());
        assertEquals(View.VISIBLE, importBtn.getVisibility());
        assertTrue("editor input height in landscape must fit screen: " + input.getLayoutParams().height,
                input.getLayoutParams().height <= Math.round(140 * density));
        ed.dismiss();

        // 2) Standard save/discard/confirm dialogs must be width-capped in landscape.
        OptionsSheet.showConfirm(a, "Save?", "Msg", "Save", false, () -> {});
        Dialog confirm = ShadowDialog.getLatestDialog();
        assertNotNull(confirm);
        int winW = confirm.getWindow().getAttributes().width;
        assertTrue("confirm dialog too wide in landscape: " + winW,
                winW > 0 && winW <= Math.round(OptionsSheet.MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP * density) + 2);
        confirm.dismiss();

        // 3) Recording settings dialog splits horizontally (left = presets, right = formats) in landscape.
        OptionsSheet.showRecordingSettings(a, "Recording settings", "Preset", "Hint",
                "Save as", new OptionsSheet.SettingsState() {
                    @Override public List<OptionsSheet.Item> presets() {
                        return Collections.singletonList(
                                OptionsSheet.Item.detail("Voice Memo", "96k", true, () -> {}));
                    }
                    @Override public List<OptionsSheet.Chip> formats() {
                        List<OptionsSheet.Chip> c = new ArrayList<>();
                        c.add(OptionsSheet.Chip.of("Auto", "0.7 MB/min", true, () -> {}));
                        return c;
                    }
                    @Override public String formatHint() { return "Auto"; }
                }, "Done");
        Dialog settings = ShadowDialog.getLatestDialog();
        assertNotNull(settings);
        LinearLayout split = settings.findViewById(R.id.dialogOptions);
        assertNotNull(split);
        assertEquals("landscape preset selector should split horizontally",
                LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL, split.getOrientation());
        settings.dismiss();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.util.DisplayMetrics;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;

import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * The studio must keep its recording strip above the floating record button
 * while keeping the preset/teleprompter pills equal, compact, and aligned.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class StudioLayoutTest {

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    @Test
    public void recordingStripStaysAboveFloatingRecordControls() {
        Activity a = activity();
        DisplayMetrics metrics = a.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();

        View activityRoot = LayoutInflater.from(a)
                .inflate(R.layout.activity_main, null, false);
        View fab = activityRoot.findViewById(R.id.fabWrap);
        assertTrue("record button missing", fab != null);
        ViewGroup recordBar = (ViewGroup) fab.getParent();
        int fabHeightPx = fab.getLayoutParams().height;
        int barMarginPx = ((ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams) recordBar
                .getLayoutParams()).bottomMargin;
        int clearancePx = Math.round(8f * metrics.density);

        View studioRoot = LayoutInflater.from(a)
                .inflate(R.layout.fragment_studio, null, false);
        assertTrue("studio root lost its record-button clearance (padding="
                        + studioRoot.getPaddingBottom() + ", need>="
                        + (fabHeightPx + barMarginPx + clearancePx) + ")",
                studioRoot.getPaddingBottom()
                        >= fabHeightPx + barMarginPx + clearancePx);
    }

    @Test
    public void recordingStripUsesRestoredMeterAndTimerSizes() {
        Activity a = activity();
        DisplayMetrics metrics = a.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(a)
                .inflate(R.layout.fragment_studio, null, false);

        View meter = root.findViewById(R.id.dbMeter);
        assertEquals("dB meter height changed",
                Math.round(168f * metrics.density),
                meter.getLayoutParams().height);
        TextView timer = root.findViewById(R.id.timerText);
        assertEquals("timer size changed",
                38f * metrics.scaledDensity, timer.getTextSize(), 0.5f);
    }

    @Test
    public void presetAndTeleprompterPillsAreEqualCompactAndAligned() {
        Activity a = activity();
        DisplayMetrics metrics = a.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(a)
                .inflate(R.layout.fragment_studio, null, false);
        LinearLayout preset = root.findViewById(R.id.settingsRow);
        LinearLayout toggle = root.findViewById(R.id.teleToggle);

        int pill = Math.round(40f * metrics.density);
        assertEquals("preset pill height changed", pill,
                preset.getLayoutParams().height);
        assertEquals("teleprompter pill height changed", pill,
                toggle.getLayoutParams().height);
        assertEquals("pills are not aligned", Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL,
                preset.getGravity() & Gravity.VERTICAL_GRAVITY_MASK);
        assertEquals("pills are not aligned", Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL,
                toggle.getGravity() & Gravity.VERTICAL_GRAVITY_MASK);
        assertEquals("pills have different widths",
                preset.getLayoutParams().width, toggle.getLayoutParams().width);
    }

    @Test
    public void zoomControlStacksVertically() {
        Activity a = activity();
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(a)
                .inflate(R.layout.fragment_studio, null, false);
        TeleValue zoom = root.findViewById(R.id.zoomValue);
        assertTrue("zoom control missing", zoom != null);

        zoom.setStacked(true);
        assertTrue("zoom control is not stacked", zoom.isStacked());
        ViewGroup row = (ViewGroup) zoom.getChildAt(1);
        assertEquals("zoom controls are not vertical",
                LinearLayout.VERTICAL, ((LinearLayout) row).getOrientation());
        assertEquals("stacked row is still locked to the horizontal height",
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                row.getLayoutParams().height);
        assertTrue("zoom control is too wide for the waveform rail",
                zoom.getLayoutParams().width
                        <= Math.round(48f * a.getResources()
                                .getDisplayMetrics().density));
    }

    @Test
    public void prompterChromeOverlaysScript() {
        Activity a = activity();
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(a)
                .inflate(R.layout.fragment_studio, null, false);
        FrameLayout panel = root.findViewById(R.id.telePanel);
        assertTrue("prompter panel missing", panel != null);
        assertTrue("script is not the bottom overlay layer",
                panel.getChildAt(0) instanceof TeleprompterView);
        assertTrue("controls do not overlay the script",
                panel.getChildCount() >= 2);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.After;
import org.junit.Before;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class TakeDaoTest {

    private TakeDatabase db;

    @Before
    public void open() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        db = TakeDatabase.inMemory(ctx);
    }

    @After
    public void close() {
        try {
            db.close();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private TakeEntity row(long id, String title) {
        TakeEntity e = new TakeEntity();
        e.id = id;
        e.title = title;
        e.durationMs = 1000;
        e.timestamp = id;
        e.dateLabel = "d";
        e.sizeLabel = "0.1 MB";
        e.format = "M4A";
        e.favorite = false;
        e.filePath = null;
        e.origin = "recorded";
        e.lastPositionMs = 0;
        e.markersJson = null;
        return e;
    }

    @Test
    public void upsertAndReadBack() {
        db.takes().upsert(row(1, "Hello"));
        TakeEntity got = db.takes().byId(1);
        assertEquals("Hello", got.title);
        assertEquals("recorded", got.origin);
    }

    @Test
    public void replaceOnConflict() {
        db.takes().upsert(row(1, "Old"));
        db.takes().upsert(row(1, "New"));
        assertEquals("New", db.takes().byId(1).title);
        assertEquals(1, db.takes().count());
    }

    @Test
    public void orderedNewestFirst() {
        db.takes().upsertAll(Arrays.asList(row(1, "Old"), row(2, "New")));
        List<TakeEntity> all = db.takes().allOrdered();
        assertEquals(2, all.size());
        assertEquals(2, all.get(0).id);
    }

    @Test
    public void updatePosition() {
        db.takes().upsert(row(5, "Long"));
        db.takes().updatePosition(5, 12345);
        assertEquals(12345, db.takes().byId(5).lastPositionMs);
    }

    @Test
    public void deleteByIds() {
        db.takes().upsertAll(Arrays.asList(row(1, "A"), row(2, "B")));
        db.takes().deleteByIds(Arrays.asList(1L));
        assertNull(db.takes().byId(1));
        assertEquals("B", db.takes().byId(2).title);
    }

    @Test
    public void takeRoundTripKeepsPhase0Fields() {
        Take t = new Take(9, "T", 2000, 1000, "0.2 MB", "WAV", true, "/x.wav");
        t.origin = "edited";
        t.lastPositionMs = 500;
        t.markersJson = "{\"m\":[]}";
        db.takes().upsert(TakeEntity.fromTake(t));
        Take back = db.takes().byId(9).toTake();
        assertEquals("edited", back.origin);
        assertEquals(500, back.lastPositionMs);
        assertEquals("{\"m\":[]}", back.markersJson);
        assertTrue(back.favorite);
    }

    @Test
    public void entityDefaultsAreSane() {
        Take t = new Take(3, "T", 1, 1, "s", "M4A", false, null);
        TakeEntity e = TakeEntity.fromTake(t);
        assertEquals("recorded", e.origin);
        assertFalse(e.favorite);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Save-pipeline file rules: unique output names and duration fallbacks.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class TakeSaverTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    @Test
    public void uniqueFinalCollisionsNumberUp() throws Exception {
        File dir = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "uniq");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        dir.mkdirs();
        File raw = new File(dir, "Take.wav");
        new RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw").close();
        File first = TakeSaver.uniqueFinal(raw, "m4a");
        assertEquals("Take.m4a", first.getName());
        // Occupy the first name: the next call must uniquify.
        new RandomAccessFile(first, "rw").close();
        File second = TakeSaver.uniqueFinal(raw, "m4a");
        assertEquals("Take (2).m4a", second.getName());
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        first.delete();
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        raw.delete();
    }

    @Test
    public void durationOfGarbageFallsBack() throws Exception {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "nodur.bin");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.write(new byte[100]);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        assertEquals(1000, TakeSaver.durationOf(f));
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        f.delete();
    }

    @Test
    public void durationOfMissingFallsBack() {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "missing.wav");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        f.delete();
        assertEquals(1000, TakeSaver.durationOf(f));
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

public class TakeTest {

    @Test
    public void formatDuration() {
        assertEquals("00:00", Take.formatDuration(0));
        assertEquals("00:44", Take.formatDuration(44_000));
        assertEquals("04:12", Take.formatDuration(252_000));
        assertEquals("12:05", Take.formatDuration(725_000));
    }

    @Test
    public void formatDateNeverEmpty() {
        String d = Take.formatDate(System.currentTimeMillis());
        assertTrue(d != null && !d.isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    public void defaults() {
        Take t = new Take(7, "X", 1000, 0, "0.1 MB", "M4A", false, null);
        assertEquals("recorded", t.origin);
        assertEquals(0, t.lastPositionMs);
        assertTrue(t.markersJson == null);
    }

    @Test
    public void hasFileReflectsDisk() throws Exception {
        java.io.File f = new java.io.File(
                System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"), "hasfile.bin");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        f.delete();
        Take missing = new Take(1, "X", 0, 0, "", "M4A", false,
                f.getAbsolutePath());
        assertFalse(missing.hasFile());
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f, "rw").close();
        try {
            assertTrue(missing.hasFile());
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
        Take nopath = new Take(2, "X", 0, 0, "", "M4A", false, null);
        assertFalse(nopath.hasFile());
    }

    @Test
    public void convertingDefaultsOff() {
        Take t = new Take(3, "X", 0, 0, "", "M4A", false, null);
        assertFalse(t.converting);
        assertEquals(0, t.convProgress);
        assertEquals("", t.convFormat);
        assertEquals("", t.convJobId);
        assertEquals("", t.convRawPath);
    }

    @Test
    public void entityNullsNormalize() {
        // Legacy rows can hold null columns; the library dereferences
        // title/format on the main thread, so toTake must never pass nulls.
        TakeEntity e = new TakeEntity();
        e.id = 99;
        e.title = null;
        e.format = null;
        Take t = e.toTake();
        assertTrue(t.title != null && !t.title.isEmpty());
        assertTrue(t.format != null && !t.format.isEmpty());
        // Lower-casing (filter) and comparison (sort) must not throw.
        assertTrue(t.title.toLowerCase().length() >= 0);
        assertTrue(t.title.compareToIgnoreCase("zzz") != 0);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.view.View;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * Opens the teleprompter dialogs for real.
 *
 * <p>This exists because a dialog that inflates and binds fine can still
 * throw the moment it shows — the framework rejects
 * {@code requestWindowFeature()} once content is attached, which is exactly
 * how the tuner and editor were crashing.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class TeleDialogsTest {

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    @Test
    public void inlineSettingsSurviveFullRangeSweep() {
        // The dead tuner sheet is gone; its replacement is the inline
        // TeleValue controls, which commit through these setters. Sweep the
        // full ranges the way a scrub would, including the extreme ends.
        android.app.Activity a = activity();
        for (int wpm = TeleSettings.MIN_WPM; wpm <= TeleSettings.MAX_WPM;
                wpm += 40) {
            TeleSettings.setWordsPerMinute(a, wpm);
        }
        for (int sp = TeleMath.MIN_TEXT_SP; sp <= TeleMath.MAX_TEXT_SP;
                sp += 4) {
            TeleSettings.setTextSize(a, sp);
        }
        for (int wpl = TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE;
                wpl <= TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE; wpl++) {
            TeleSettings.setWordsPerLine(a, wpl);
        }
        TeleSettings got = TeleSettings.load(a);
        assertEquals(TeleSettings.MAX_WPM, got.wordsPerMinute);
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MAX_TEXT_SP, got.textSizeSp);
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE, got.wordsPerLine);
    }

    @Test
    public void wplControlSpansFullRangeLive() {
        TeleValue tv = new TeleValue(activity());
        tv.configure(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE,
                TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE, 1, 5, "");
        final int[] seen = {-1};
        tv.setOnValueChanged(v -> seen[0] = v);
        tv.setValue(TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE, true);
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE, seen[0]);
        tv.setValue(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE, true);
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE, seen[0]);
    }

    @Test
    public void editorOpensImportAndSaves() {
        final boolean[] imported = {false};
        final String[] saved = {null};
        android.app.Dialog d = TeleDialogs.showEditor(activity(),
                "hello world\nsecond line", 120,
                text -> saved[0] = text,
                () -> imported[0] = true);

        // The import button must actually fire the hook when tapped.
        View importBtn = d.findViewById(R.id.teleImportBtn);
        assertTrue("no import button", importBtn != null);
        importBtn.performClick();
        assertTrue("import hook never fired", imported[0]);

        // Save commits explicitly.
        View saveBtn = d.findViewById(R.id.teleSaveBtn);
        assertTrue("no save button", saveBtn != null);
        saveBtn.performClick();
        assertEquals("saved=" + saved[0], "hello world\nsecond line", saved[0]);
        // Closing without saving keeps whatever was last committed.
        d.dismiss();
    }

    @Test
    public void editorSavesEmptyScriptOnceToClear() {
        // A4-10: an empty script is a legitimate state — it clears the
        // prompter. The old code refused to commit it, so a script could
        // never be cleared once set.
        final String[] saved = {null};
        final int[] calls = {0};
        android.app.Dialog d = TeleDialogs.showEditor(activity(), "   ", 120,
                text -> {
                    if (calls[0] == 0) saved[0] = text;
                    calls[0]++;
                }, null);
        d.findViewById(R.id.teleSaveBtn).performClick();
        org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        assertEquals("empty script must commit", 1, calls[0]);
        assertEquals("", saved[0]);
    }

    @Test
    public void editorHandlesEmptyAndHugeScripts() {
        TeleDialogs.showEditor(activity(), "", 120, text -> { }, null);
        StringBuilder big = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < 20000; i++) {
            big.append("word").append(i).append(' ');
        }
        TeleDialogs.showEditor(activity(), big.toString(), 120,
                text -> { }, null);
        assertEquals(20000, TeleMath.wordCount(big.toString()));
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

/**
 * The teleprompter's layout and pacing rules. These are the ones that must
 * hold: text can never overflow its column, and the fade has to be linear
 * and symmetric about the centre.
 */
public class TeleMathTest {

    // ---- words per line ----

    @Test
    public void bigTextForcesFewerWords() {
        int width = 1000;
        float small = 12f * 3f; // 36px
        float big = 48f * 3f;   // 144px
        int want = 8;
        int atSmall = TeleMath.wordsPerLine(width, small, want);
        int atBig = TeleMath.wordsPerLine(width, big, want);
        assertEquals("small text should fit the request", want, atSmall);
        assertTrue("large text must clamp: " + atBig, atBig < want);
    }

    @Test
    public void neverExceedsTheRequest() {
        float[] sizes = {36f, 60f, 90f, 120f, 168f};
        for (float s : sizes) {
            for (int want = 2; want <= 14; want++) {
                int got = TeleMath.wordsPerLine(1200, s, want);
                assertTrue("s=" + s + " want=" + want + " got=" + got,
                        got <= want);
                assertTrue(got >= TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE);
                assertTrue(got <= TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE);
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void clampIsReported() {
        // Big text in a narrow panel must be visibly clamped, not silently.
        assertTrue(TeleMath.wordsPerLineWasClamped(300, 120f, 8));
        assertFalse(TeleMath.wordsPerLineWasClamped(1400, 40f, 8));
    }

    @Test
    public void degenerateSpaceFallsBackSafely() {
        // No width or no text size (view not laid out yet): return the
        // floor rather than dividing by zero. This is reported as clamped,
        // which is honest - the request genuinely could not be honoured.
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE,
                TeleMath.wordsPerLine(0, 40f, 6));
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE,
                TeleMath.wordsPerLine(800, 0f, 6));
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE,
                TeleMath.wordsPerLine(0, 0f, 6));
        assertTrue(TeleMath.wordsPerLineWasClamped(0, 0f, 6));
    }

    // ---- pacing ----

    @Test
    public void fasterReadingScrollsFaster() {
        float slow = TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(90, 5, 48f);
        float fast = TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(200, 5, 48f);
        assertTrue("slow=" + slow + " fast=" + fast, fast > slow);
        assertTrue(slow > 0f);
    }

    @Test
    public void biggerTextScrollsFasterPerLine() {
        float small = TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(120, 5, 24f);
        float large = TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(120, 5, 72f);
        assertTrue("small=" + small + " large=" + large, large > small);
    }

    @Test
    public void zeroSpeedScrollsNowhere() {
        assertEquals(0f, TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(0, 5, 48f), 0.0001f);
        assertEquals(0f, TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(120, 0, 48f), 0.0001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void scrollSpeedMatchesRenderedLineMotion() {
        // 120 wpm is two words/second. On two-word lines, that is exactly one
        // rendered line-height per second.
        assertEquals(72f, TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(120, 2, 48f), 0.001f);
        // Halving the effective words per line doubles the required line rate.
        assertEquals(144f, TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(120, 1, 48f), 0.001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void charsPerSecondIsExact() {
        // 5 words/line * 5.8 chars * 2 words/sec at 120wpm.
        assertEquals(58f, TeleMath.charsPerSecond(5, 120), 0.0001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void estimatedSecondsIsExact() {
        // 10 words at 60wpm = 10 seconds.
        assertEquals(10, TeleMath.estimatedSeconds("a b c d e f g h i j", 60));
    }

    @Test
    public void wordsPerLineExactTable() {
        // 1200px / (48px * 0.52) = 48 chars / 5.8 = 8 words, request honored.
        assertEquals(8, TeleMath.wordsPerLine(1200, 48f, 8));
        // Request above the maximum is still capped.
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE,
                TeleMath.wordsPerLine(100000, 10f, 500));
    }

    @Test
    public void fadeRespectsExplicitFadeHeight() {
        // 5px from the top with a 10px fade: fully transparent.
        assertEquals(0f, TeleMath.fadeAlpha(5f, 300f, 10f), 0.0001f);
        // 5px off-centre with a 10px fade: half faded.
        assertEquals(0.5f, TeleMath.fadeAlpha(145f, 300f, 10f), 0.0001f);
        // Non-positive fade falls back to half the panel.
        assertEquals(1f - 145f / 150f, TeleMath.fadeAlpha(5f, 300f, 0f),
                0.0001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void charsPerSecondScalesWithLineLength() {
        assertTrue(TeleMath.charsPerSecond(8, 120)
                > TeleMath.charsPerSecond(4, 120));
    }

    // ---- script metrics ----

    @Test
    public void wordCounting() {
        assertEquals(0, TeleMath.wordCount(null));
        assertEquals(0, TeleMath.wordCount("   \n\n  "));
        assertEquals(3, TeleMath.wordCount("one two three"));
        assertEquals(3, TeleMath.wordCount("  one   two \n\n three  "));
    }

    @Test
    public void estimateGrowsWithLengthAndFallsWithSpeed() {
        String script = "a b c d e f g h i j";
        int slow = TeleMath.estimatedSeconds(script, 60);
        int fast = TeleMath.estimatedSeconds(script, 300);
        assertTrue("slow=" + slow + " fast=" + fast, slow > fast);
        assertEquals(10, TeleMath.wordCount(script));
        assertEquals(0, TeleMath.estimatedSeconds(script, 0));
    }

    // ---- fade ----

    @Test
    public void fadeIsStrongestAtTheCentre() {
        float h = 400f;
        float fade = h * 0.46f;
        float centre = TeleMath.fadeAlpha(h / 2f, h, fade);
        float upper = TeleMath.fadeAlpha(h * 0.25f, h, fade);
        float lower = TeleMath.fadeAlpha(h * 0.75f, h, fade);
        assertEquals(1f, centre, 0.0001f);
        assertTrue(centre > upper);
        assertTrue(centre > lower);
    }

    @Test
    public void fadeIsSymmetricAboutTheCentre() {
        float h = 600f;
        float fade = h * 0.46f;
        for (float y = 10f; y < h; y += 17f) {
            float a = TeleMath.fadeAlpha(y, h, fade);
            float b = TeleMath.fadeAlpha(h - y, h, fade);
            assertEquals("asymmetry at y=" + y, a, b, 0.0001f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void fadeDecreasesMonotonicallyOutward() {
        // Linear, not stepped: each step outward must not increase.
        float h = 500f;
        float fade = h * 0.46f;
        float prev = 2f;
        for (float y = h / 2f; y >= 0f; y -= 3f) {
            float a = TeleMath.fadeAlpha(y, h, fade);
            assertTrue("rise at y=" + y, a <= prev + 0.0001f);
            prev = a;
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void fadeEndsFullyTransparentAndNeverInverts() {
        float h = 300f;
        assertEquals(0f, TeleMath.fadeAlpha(0f, h, h * 0.46f), 0.0001f);
        assertEquals(0f, TeleMath.fadeAlpha(h, h, h * 0.46f), 0.0001f);
        assertEquals(1f, TeleMath.fadeAlpha(150f, h, 0f), 0.0001f);
        assertEquals(1f, TeleMath.fadeAlpha(150f, 0f, 10f), 0.0001f);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * Teleprompter preference rules: defaults, clamping, persistence and the
 * inline-control setters that must never race a stale snapshot.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class TeleSettingsTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    @Test
    public void defaultsAreSane() {
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        TeleSettings s = TeleSettings.load(ctx());
        assertEquals(120, s.wordsPerMinute);
        assertEquals(5, s.wordsPerLine);
        assertEquals(26, s.textSizeSp);
        assertFalse(s.mirror);
        assertTrue(s.autoScroll);
    }

    @Test
    public void loadClampsCorruptPrefs() {
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        ctx().getSharedPreferences("takeone", Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit()
                .putInt("tele_wpm", 9999)
                .putInt("tele_wpl", -4)
                .putInt("tele_size", 0)
                .putInt("tele_count", 99)
                .apply();
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        TeleSettings s = TeleSettings.load(ctx());
        assertEquals(TeleSettings.MAX_WPM, s.wordsPerMinute);
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE, s.wordsPerLine);
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MIN_TEXT_SP, s.textSizeSp);
        assertTrue("countdown must clamp into range",
                s.countdownSec >= 0 && s.countdownSec <= 10);
    }

    @Test
    public void settersClampAndPersist() {
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        TeleSettings.setTextSize(ctx(), 500);
        TeleSettings.setWordsPerMinute(ctx(), 1);
        TeleSettings.setWordsPerLine(ctx(), 100);
        TeleSettings s = TeleSettings.load(ctx());
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MAX_TEXT_SP, s.textSizeSp);
        assertEquals(TeleSettings.MIN_WPM, s.wordsPerMinute);
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE, s.wordsPerLine);
    }

    @Test
    public void settersRoundTripThroughPrefs() {
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        TeleSettings.setTextSize(ctx(), 33);
        TeleSettings.setWordsPerMinute(ctx(), 200);
        TeleSettings.setWordsPerLine(ctx(), 7);
        TeleSettings.toggleMirror(ctx(), true);
        // Drop the cache: values must survive on disk alone.
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        TeleSettings s = TeleSettings.load(ctx());
        assertEquals(33, s.textSizeSp);
        assertEquals(200, s.wordsPerMinute);
        assertEquals(7, s.wordsPerLine);
        assertTrue(s.mirror);
    }

    @Test
    public void toggleMirrorFlipsBothWays() {
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        TeleSettings.toggleMirror(ctx(), true);
        assertTrue(TeleSettings.load(ctx()).mirror);
        TeleSettings.toggleMirror(ctx(), false);
        assertFalse(TeleSettings.load(ctx()).mirror);
    }

    @Test
    public void loadReturnsSameCachedInstance() {
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        assertTrue(TeleSettings.load(ctx()) == TeleSettings.load(ctx()));
    }

    @Test
    public void saveRefreshesCache() {
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        TeleSettings s = new TeleSettings();
        s.wordsPerMinute = 150;
        s.save(ctx());
        assertEquals(150, TeleSettings.load(ctx()).wordsPerMinute);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Context;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The four value-control behaviours must not leak into each other: a scrub
 * adjusts and finishes without opening the picker or keyboard, while taps and
 * holds retain their own entry points.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class TeleValueGestureTest {

    private static class RecordingTeleValue extends TeleValue {
        int pickers;
        int keyboards;
        final List<Integer> live = new ArrayList<>();
        int finished = -1;
        int discrete = -1;

        RecordingTeleValue(Context context) {
            super(context);
            setOnScrubListener(new OnScrubListener() {
                @Override public void onScrubValueChanged(int value) {
                    live.add(value);
                }

                @Override public void onScrubFinished(int value) {
                    finished = value;
                }
            });
            setOnValueChanged(value -> discrete = value);
        }

        @Override protected void showValuePicker() {
            pickers++;
        }

        @Override protected void showKeyboardInput() {
            keyboards++;
        }
    }

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    private RecordingTeleValue control() {
        Activity a = activity();
        RecordingTeleValue tv = new RecordingTeleValue(a);
        a.setContentView(tv);
        tv.configure(10, 100, 1, 50, "");
        tv.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(300, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(80, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        tv.layout(0, 0, 300, 80);
        return tv;
    }

    private static View findValueLabel(View root) {
        CharSequence description = root.getContentDescription();
        if (root instanceof android.widget.TextView
                && description != null
                && "value".contentEquals(description)) {
            return root;
        }
        if (root instanceof android.view.ViewGroup) {
            android.view.ViewGroup group = (android.view.ViewGroup) root;
            for (int i = 0; i < group.getChildCount(); i++) {
                View found = findValueLabel(group.getChildAt(i));
                if (found != null) return found;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static float[] centerOf(View root, View v) {
        float x = v.getLeft() + v.getWidth() / 2f;
        float y = v.getTop() + v.getHeight() / 2f;
        android.view.ViewParent parent = v.getParent();
        while (parent != null && parent != root && parent instanceof View) {
            View parentView = (View) parent;
            x += parentView.getLeft();
            y += parentView.getTop();
            parent = parentView.getParent();
        }
        return new float[]{x, y};
    }

    private static MotionEvent event(int action, float x, float y) {
        long now = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        return MotionEvent.obtain(now, now, action, x, y, 0);
    }

    @Test
    public void scrubReportsLiveAndFinishWithoutDialogs() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        View label = findValueLabel(tv);
        assertTrue("value label not found", label != null);
        float[] c = centerOf(tv, label);

        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, c[0], c[1]));
        for (float x = c[0] + 8f; x <= c[0] + 130f; x += 8f) {
            tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, x, c[1]));
        }
        assertTrue("scrub did not report live values: " + tv.live,
                !tv.live.isEmpty());
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, c[0] + 130f, c[1]));

        assertEquals("scrub did not finish", tv.getValue(), tv.finished);
        assertEquals("scrub leaked into the discrete listener", -1, tv.discrete);
        assertEquals("scrub opened the picker", 0, tv.pickers);
        assertEquals("scrub opened the keyboard", 0, tv.keyboards);
    }

    @Test
    public void verticalScrubDrivesValueWhenEnabled() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        tv.setVerticalScrub(true);
        View label = findValueLabel(tv);
        float[] c = centerOf(tv, label);

        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, c[0], c[1]));
        // Drag upward: the value must climb, like the waveform's own gesture.
        for (float y = c[1] - 8f; y >= c[1] - 80f; y -= 8f) {
            tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, c[0], y));
        }
        assertTrue("vertical scrub did not report live values: " + tv.live,
                !tv.live.isEmpty());
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, c[0], c[1] - 80f));

        assertEquals(tv.getValue(), tv.finished);
        assertTrue("vertical scrub moved the value down", tv.getValue() > 50);
        assertEquals(0, tv.pickers);
        assertEquals(0, tv.keyboards);
    }

    @Test
    public void verticalMoveIsConsumedWithoutValueOrDialogs() {        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        View label = findValueLabel(tv);
        float[] c = centerOf(tv, label);

        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, c[0], c[1]));
        for (float y = c[1] + 8f; y <= c[1] + 80f; y += 8f) {
            tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, c[0], y));
        }
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, c[0], c[1] + 80f));

        assertEquals(50, tv.getValue());
        assertTrue("vertical move reported live values", tv.live.isEmpty());
        assertEquals(-1, tv.finished);
        assertEquals(0, tv.pickers);
        assertEquals(0, tv.keyboards);
    }

    @Test
    public void secondTouchCancelsPendingPicker() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        View label = findValueLabel(tv);
        float[] c = centerOf(tv, label);

        // A clean tap schedules the picker through the label callback; the
        // next touch must cancel it before it can appear during a gesture.
        ((android.widget.TextView) label).performClick();
        assertTrue("clean tap did not schedule the picker",
                tv.hasPendingPickerForTest());

        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, c[0], c[1]));
        assertFalse("second touch left the picker scheduled",
                tv.hasPendingPickerForTest());
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL, c[0], c[1]));
        assertEquals(0, tv.pickers);
        assertEquals(0, tv.keyboards);
    }

    @Test
    public void doubleTapOpensKeyboardDirectly() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        View label = findValueLabel(tv);

        ((android.widget.TextView) label).performClick();
        ((android.widget.TextView) label).performClick();

        assertEquals(1, tv.keyboards);
        assertEquals(0, tv.pickers);
    }

    @Test
    public void movementCancelsPendingHold() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        View label = findValueLabel(tv);
        float[] c = centerOf(tv, label);

        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, c[0], c[1]));
        for (float x = c[0] + 8f; x <= c[0] + 80f; x += 8f) {
            tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, x, c[1]));
        }
        tv.runPendingLongPressForTest();
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, c[0] + 80f, c[1]));

        assertEquals("a moved hold still summoned the keyboard",
                0, tv.keyboards);
        assertEquals(0, tv.pickers);
    }

    @Test
    public void stationaryHoldOpensKeyboard() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        View label = findValueLabel(tv);
        float[] c = centerOf(tv, label);

        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, c[0], c[1]));
        tv.runPendingLongPressForTest();
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, c[0], c[1]));

        assertEquals(1, tv.keyboards);
        assertEquals(0, tv.pickers);
    }

    @Test
    public void stackedZoomKeepsScrubBehaviour() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        tv.setStacked(true);
        assertTrue("stacked mode was not retained", tv.isStacked());
        tv.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(80, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(180, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        tv.layout(0, 0, 80, 180);

        View label = findValueLabel(tv);
        float[] c = centerOf(tv, label);
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, c[0], c[1]));
        for (float x = c[0] + 8f; x <= c[0] + 60f; x += 8f) {
            tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, x, c[1]));
        }
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, c[0] + 60f, c[1]));

        assertTrue("stacked scrub did not report live values",
                !tv.live.isEmpty());
        assertEquals(tv.getValue(), tv.finished);
        assertEquals(0, tv.pickers);
        assertEquals(0, tv.keyboards);
    }

    @Test
    public void configureClampsInitialValue() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        tv.configure(10, 20, 1, 999, "");
        assertEquals(20, tv.getValue());
        tv.configure(10, 20, 1, -999, "");
        assertEquals(10, tv.getValue());
        assertEquals(10, tv.getMin());
    }

    @Test
    public void captionShowsAndHides() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        tv.setCaption("Size");
        android.view.View caption = null;
        android.view.ViewGroup root = tv;
        for (int i = 0; i < root.getChildCount(); i++) {
            android.view.View c = root.getChildAt(i);
            if (c instanceof android.widget.TextView
                    && "Size".contentEquals(
                            ((android.widget.TextView) c).getText())) {
                caption = c;
            }
        }
        assertTrue(caption != null
                && caption.getVisibility() == android.view.View.VISIBLE);
        tv.setCaption("");
        assertTrue(caption.getVisibility() == android.view.View.GONE);
        tv.setCaption(null);
        assertTrue(caption.getVisibility() == android.view.View.GONE);
    }

    @Test
    public void plusMinusStepDiscretely() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        android.view.View plus = null;
        android.view.View minus = null;
        android.view.ViewGroup row =
                (android.view.ViewGroup) tv.getChildAt(1);
        for (int i = 0; i < row.getChildCount(); i++) {
            android.view.View c = row.getChildAt(i);
            CharSequence d = c.getContentDescription();
            if (d != null && "increase".contentEquals(d)) plus = c;
            if (d != null && "decrease".contentEquals(d)) minus = c;
        }
        assertTrue(plus != null && minus != null);
        plus.performClick();
        assertEquals(51, tv.getValue());
        assertEquals(51, tv.discrete);
        minus.performClick();
        minus.performClick();
        assertEquals(49, tv.getValue());
    }

    @Test
    public void unchangedValueDoesNotNotify() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        tv.setValue(50, true);
        assertEquals(-1, tv.discrete);
        tv.setValue(51, true);
        assertEquals(51, tv.discrete);
    }

    @Test
    public void stackedDefaultsOff() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        assertTrue(!tv.isStacked());
    }
}
